refs.text_big5: 桌子、桌子的一切器具、和陳設餅，
refs.text_en: The table, all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;

refs.text_gb: 纯金的灯台、摆列的灯盏、灯台的一切器具、和点灯的油，
refs.text_big5: 純金的燈臺、擺列的燈盞、燈臺的一切器具、和點燈的油，
refs.text_en: The pure lampstand, its lamps, even the lamps set in order, and all its utensils, and the oil for the light;

refs.text_gb: 金坛，膏油和馨香的香，并会幕门口的帘子，
refs.text_big5: 金壇，膏油和馨香的香，並會幕門口的簾子，
refs.text_en: And the golden altar and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense and the screen for the entrance of the tent;

refs.text_gb: 铜坛、坛的铜网、坛的杠和坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
refs.text_big5: 銅壇、壇的銅網、壇的槓和壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
refs.text_en: The bronze altar, and its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils; the laver and its base;

refs.text_gb: 院子的帷子、帷子的柱子和卯座，院子的门帘、绳子、橛子，并会幕之帐幕一切供事奉使用的器具，
refs.text_big5: 院子的帷子、帷子的柱子和卯座，院子的門簾、繩子、橛子，並會幕之帳幕一切供事奉使用的器具，
refs.text_en: The hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets; and the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, and its pegs; and all the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting;

refs.text_gb: 在圣所供职用的精工作的衣服，就是祭司亚伦的圣衣，和他儿子们用以作祭司事奉的衣服。
refs.text_big5: 在聖所供職用的精工作的衣服，就是祭司亞倫的聖衣，和他兒子們用以作祭司事奉的衣服。
refs.text_en: The finely worked garments for ministering in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for them to serve as priests.

refs.text_gb: 这一切工作，耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就照样作。
refs.text_big5: 這一切工作，耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就照樣作。
refs.text_en: According to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

refs.text_gb: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦作衣服，使他分别为圣，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的靈所充滿的，給亞倫作衣服，使他分別為聖，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall speak to all who are wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron's garments to sanctify him, that he may serve Me as a priest.

verses.text_gb: 就是[Cra]会幕、[Crb]见证的柜和其上的[Crc]遮罪盖、会幕的一切器具，
verses.text_big5: 就是[Cra]會幕、[Crb]見證的櫃和其上的[Crc]遮罪蓋、會幕的一切器具，
verses.text_en: The Tent of Meeting, and the Ark of the Testimony and the expiation cover that is on it, and all the utensils of the tent,
verses.text_gb_plain: 就是会幕、见证的柜和其上的遮罪盖、会幕的一切器具，
verses.text_big5_plain: 就是會幕、見證的櫃和其上的遮罪蓋、會幕的一切器具，

refs.text_gb: 他们中间，凡心里有智慧作工的，用十幅幕幔作帐幕；这些幕幔是比撒列用捻的细麻，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线制造的，并用巧匠的手工，绣上基路伯。
refs.text_big5: 他們中間，凡心裏有智慧作工的，用十幅幕幔作帳幕；這些幕幔是比撒列用撚的細麻，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線製造的，並用巧匠的手工，繡上基路伯。
refs.text_en: And all the wise in heart among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains, of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet strands, with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman. Bezalel made them.

refs.text_gb: 每幅幕幔长二十八肘，宽四肘，幕幔都是一样的尺寸。
refs.text_big5: 每幅幕幔長二十八肘，寬四肘，幕幔都是一樣的尺寸。
refs.text_en: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain, four cubits; all the curtains had the same measurement.

refs.text_gb: 他使五幅幕幔幅幅相连，又使另五幅幕幔幅幅相连。
refs.text_big5: 他使五幅幕幔幅幅相連，又使另五幅幕幔幅幅相連。
refs.text_en: And he joined five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he joined to one another.

refs.text_gb: 在这相连幕幔的末幅边缘，作蓝色的钮眼；在那相连幕幔的末幅边缘内，也照样作。
refs.text_big5: 在這相連幕幔的末幅邊緣，作藍色的鈕眼；在那相連幕幔的末幅邊緣內，也照樣作。
refs.text_en: And he made loops of blue strands upon the edge of the one curtain at the end in the set; likewise he made them in the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.

refs.text_gb: 在这相连的幕幔上，作五十个钮眼；在那相连幕幔的边缘，也作五十个钮眼，都是两两相对。
refs.text_big5: 在這相連的幕幔上，作五十個鈕眼；在那相連幕幔的邊緣，也作五十個鈕眼，都是兩兩相對。
refs.text_en: He made fifty loops on the one curtain, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was in the second set; the loops were opposite one another.

refs.text_gb: 又作五十个金扣钩，用扣钩使幕幔彼此相连，成为一整个帐幕。
refs.text_big5: 又作五十個金扣鉤，用扣鉤使幕幔彼此相連，成為一整個帳幕。
refs.text_en: And he made fifty clasps of gold and joined the curtains to one another with the clasps; so the tabernacle became one.

refs.text_gb: 他用山羊毛织十一幅幕幔，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。
refs.text_big5: 他用山羊毛織十一幅幕幔，作為帳幕以上的罩棚。
refs.text_en: And he made curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains he made in all.

refs.text_gb: 每幅幕幔长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幕幔都是一样的尺寸。
refs.text_big5: 每幅幕幔長三十肘，寬四肘；十一幅幕幔都是一樣的尺寸。
refs.text_en: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain, four cubits; the eleven curtains had the same measurement.

refs.text_gb: 他把五幅幕幔连成一幅，又把六幅幕幔连成一幅。
refs.text_big5: 他把五幅幕幔連成一幅，又把六幅幕幔連成一幅。
refs.text_en: And he joined five of the curtains by themselves, and six of the curtains by themselves.

refs.text_gb: 在这相连幕幔的末幅边缘，作五十个钮眼；在那相连幕幔的末幅边缘，也作五十个钮眼。
refs.text_big5: 在這相連幕幔的末幅邊緣，作五十個鈕眼；在那相連幕幔的末幅邊緣，也作五十個鈕眼。
refs.text_en: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the set, and fifty loops he made upon the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second set.

refs.text_gb: 又作五十个铜扣钩，使罩棚连成一整个。
refs.text_big5: 又作五十個銅扣鉤，使罩棚連成一整個。
refs.text_en: And he made fifty clasps of bronze to join the tent together, that it might become one.

refs.text_gb: 并用染红的公羊皮作罩棚的盖；再用海狗皮作罩棚上的顶盖。
refs.text_big5: 並用染紅的公羊皮作罩棚的蓋；再用海狗皮作罩棚上的頂蓋。
refs.text_en: And he made a covering for the tent, of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of porpoise skins above it.

refs.text_gb: 他用皂荚木作帐幕的竖板。
refs.text_big5: 他用皂莢木作帳幕的豎板。
refs.text_en: And he made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

refs.text_gb: 每块长十肘，宽一肘半。
refs.text_big5: 每塊長十肘，寬一肘半。
refs.text_en: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and one and a half cubits, the width of each board.

refs.text_gb: 每块有两榫相接；帐幕一切的板都是这样作。
refs.text_big5: 每塊有兩榫相接；帳幕一切的板都是這樣作。
refs.text_en: Each board had two tenons joined to one another; thus he did for all the boards of the tabernacle.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕的南面，作二十块板。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕的南面，作二十塊板。
refs.text_en: And he made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

refs.text_gb: 在这二十块板下，又作四十个银卯座；这块板下有两个卯座接板上的两榫，那块板下也有两个卯座接板上的两榫。
refs.text_big5: 在這二十塊板下，又作四十個銀卯座；這塊板下有兩個卯座接板上的兩榫，那塊板下也有兩個卯座接板上的兩榫。
refs.text_en: And he made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards, two sockets under one board for its two tenons and two sockets under the next board for its two tenons.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕第二面，就是北面，也作二十块板，
refs.text_big5: 帳幕第二面，就是北面，也作二十塊板，
refs.text_en: And for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

refs.text_gb: 和四十个银卯座；这块板下有两个卯座，那块板下也有两个卯座。
refs.text_big5: 和四十個銀卯座；這塊板下有兩個卯座，那塊板下也有兩個卯座。
refs.text_en: And their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under one board and two sockets under the next board.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，作六块板。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕的後面，就是西面，作六塊板。
refs.text_en: And for the rear of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕后面的拐角，作两块板。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕後面的拐角，作兩塊板。
refs.text_en: And two boards he made for the corners of the tabernacle in the rear.

refs.text_gb: 板下方是双的，板顶端完全连于一个环子；两个拐角的板，都是这样作。
refs.text_big5: 板下方是雙的，板頂端完全連於一個環子；兩個拐角的板，都是這樣作。
refs.text_en: And they were double below, and at its top they were completely joined to a single ring; thus he did to both of them for the two corners.

refs.text_gb: 有八块板和十六个银卯座，每块板下有两个卯座。
refs.text_big5: 有八塊板和十六個銀卯座，每塊板下有兩個卯座。
refs.text_en: And there were eight boards with their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets, two sockets under every board.

refs.text_gb: 他用皂荚木作闩，为帐幕这面的板作五条闩，
refs.text_big5: 他用皂莢木作閂，為帳幕這面的板作五條閂，
refs.text_en: And he made bars of acacia wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle

refs.text_gb: 为帐幕那面的板作五条闩，又为帐幕后面朝西的板作五条闩。
refs.text_big5: 為帳幕那面的板作五條閂，又為帳幕後面朝西的板作五條閂。
refs.text_en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle at the rear westward.

refs.text_gb: 他使板腰间的中闩，从这一头通到那一头。
refs.text_big5: 他使板腰間的中閂，從這一頭通到那一頭。
refs.text_en: And he made the middle bar to pass through in the center of the boards from end to end.

refs.text_gb: 用金将板包裹，又作板上的金环，用以套闩；闩也用金包裹。
refs.text_big5: 用金將板包裹，又作板上的金環，用以套閂；閂也用金包裹。
refs.text_en: And he overlaid the boards with gold and made their rings of gold as holders for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

refs.text_gb: 他用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
refs.text_big5: 他用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
refs.text_en: And he made the veil of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen; he made it with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

refs.text_gb: 为幔子作四根皂荚木柱子，用金包裹；柱子上有金钩；又为柱子铸了四个银卯座。
refs.text_big5: 為幔子作四根皂莢木柱子，用金包裹；柱子上有金鉤；又為柱子鑄了四個銀卯座。
refs.text_en: And he made for it four pillars of acacia and overlaid them with gold; their hooks were of gold. And he cast for them four sockets of silver.

refs.text_gb: 他拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘。
refs.text_big5: 他拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織帳幕的門簾。
refs.text_en: And he made a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer,

refs.text_gb: 又为帘子作五根柱子和柱子上的钩子，用金包裹柱顶和柱子上的横杆。柱子的五个卯座，是用铜作的。
refs.text_big5: 又為簾子作五根柱子和柱子上的鉤子，用金包裹柱頂和柱子上的橫杆。柱子的五個卯座，是用銅作的。
refs.text_en: And its five pillars with their hooks. And he overlaid their capitals and their connecting rods with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

refs.text_gb: 他们要用皂荚木作一个柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。
refs.text_big5: 他們要用皂莢木作一個櫃，長二肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘半。
refs.text_en: And they shall make an ark of acacia wood: two and a half cubits shall be its length; and one and a half cubits, its width; and one and a half cubits, its height.

refs.text_gb: 你要把柜里外包上纯金，四围镶上金牙边。
refs.text_big5: 你要把櫃裏外包上純金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
refs.text_en: And you shall overlay it with pure gold; inside and outside you shall overlay it; and you shall make a rim of gold upon it all around.

refs.text_gb: 也要铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上；这边两环，那边两环。
refs.text_big5: 也要鑄四個金環，安在櫃的四腳上；這邊兩環，那邊兩環。
refs.text_en: And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them on its four feet; and two rings shall be on one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

refs.text_gb: 要用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹。
refs.text_big5: 要用皂莢木作兩根槓，用金包裹。
refs.text_en: And you shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

refs.text_gb: 要把杠穿在柜旁的环内，用以抬柜。
refs.text_big5: 要把槓穿在櫃旁的環內，用以抬櫃。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the Ark to carry the Ark with them.

refs.text_gb: 杠要常在柜的环内，不可抽出来。
refs.text_big5: 槓要常在櫃的環內，不可抽出來。
refs.text_en: The poles shall be in the rings of the Ark; they shall not be taken from it.

refs.text_gb: 必将我所要赐给你的见证版，放在柜里。
refs.text_big5: 必將我所要賜給你的見證版，放在櫃裏。
refs.text_en: And you shall put into the Ark the Testimony which I shall give you.

refs.text_gb: 比撒列用皂荚木作柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半；
refs.text_big5: 比撒列用皂莢木作櫃，長二肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘半；
refs.text_en: And Bezalel made the Ark of acacia wood: two and a half cubits was its length; and one and a half cubits, its width; and one and a half cubits, its height.

refs.text_gb: 里外包上纯金，四围镶上金牙边。
refs.text_big5: 裏外包上純金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
refs.text_en: And he overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a rim of gold around it.

refs.text_gb: 又铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上；这边两环，那边两环。
refs.text_big5: 又鑄四個金環，安在櫃的四腳上；這邊兩環，那邊兩環。
refs.text_en: And he cast four rings of gold for it, on its four feet; and two rings were on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

refs.text_gb: 用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹。
refs.text_big5: 用皂莢木作兩根槓，用金包裹。
refs.text_en: And he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

refs.text_gb: 把杠穿在柜旁的环内，用以抬柜。
refs.text_big5: 把槓穿在櫃旁的環內，用以抬櫃。
refs.text_en: And he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the Ark to carry the Ark.

refs.text_gb: 要用纯金作遮罪盖，长二肘半，宽一肘半。
refs.text_big5: 要用純金作遮罪蓋，長二肘半，寬一肘半。
refs.text_en: And you shall make an expiation cover of pure gold: two and a half cubits shall be its length, and one and a half cubits, its width.

refs.text_gb: 要用金子锤出两个基路伯，安在遮罪盖的两端。
refs.text_big5: 要用金子錘出兩個基路伯，安在遮罪蓋的兩端。
refs.text_en: And you shall make two cherubim of gold; of beaten work you shall make them, at the two ends of the expiation cover.

refs.text_gb: 这端作一个基路伯，那端作一个基路伯，两端的基路伯要与遮罪盖接连一块。
refs.text_big5: 這端作一個基路伯，那端作一個基路伯，兩端的基路伯要與遮罪蓋接連一塊。
refs.text_en: And make one cherub at one end and one cherub at the other end; of one piece with the expiation cover you shall make the cherubim on its two ends.

refs.text_gb: 两个基路伯要在盖上展开翅膀，遮掩遮罪盖；基路伯要脸对脸，朝着遮罪盖。
refs.text_big5: 兩個基路伯要在蓋上展開翅膀，遮掩遮罪蓋；基路伯要臉對臉，朝著遮罪蓋。
refs.text_en: And the cherubim shall spread out their wings above the cover, covering the expiation cover with their wings, with their faces toward one another; the faces of the cherubim shall be toward the expiation cover.

refs.text_gb: 要将遮罪盖安在柜的上边，又将我所要赐给你的见证版放在柜里。
refs.text_big5: 要將遮罪蓋安在櫃的上邊，又將我所要賜給你的見證版放在櫃裏。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the expiation cover upon the Ark above it, and into the Ark you shall put the Testimony that I shall give you.

refs.text_gb: 我要在那里与你相会，又要从见证的柜遮罪盖上两个基路伯中间，和你说我所要吩咐你传给以色列人的一切事。
refs.text_big5: 我要在那裏與你相會，又要從見證的櫃遮罪蓋上兩個基路伯中間，和你說我所要吩咐你傳給以色列人的一切事。
refs.text_en: And there I will meet with you, and I will speak with you from above the expiation cover, from between the two cherubim which are upon the Ark of the Testimony, of everything which I will give you in commandment to the children of Israel.

refs.text_en: And he made an expiation cover of pure gold: two and a half cubits was its length, and one and a half cubits, its width.

refs.text_en: And he made two cherubim of gold; of beaten work he made them, at the two ends of the expiation cover,

refs.text_gb: 这端作一个基路伯，那端作一个基路伯，两端的基路伯与遮罪盖接连一块。
refs.text_big5: 這端作一個基路伯，那端作一個基路伯，兩端的基路伯與遮罪蓋接連一塊。
refs.text_en: One cherub at the one end and one cherub at the other end; of one piece with the expiation cover he made the cherubim at its two ends.

refs.text_gb: 两个基路伯在盖上展开翅膀，遮掩遮罪盖；基路伯是脸对脸，朝着遮罪盖。
refs.text_big5: 兩個基路伯在蓋上展開翅膀，遮掩遮罪蓋；基路伯是臉對臉，朝著遮罪蓋。
refs.text_en: And the cherubim spread out their wings above the cover, covering the expiation cover with their wings, with their faces toward one another; the faces of the cherubim were toward the expiation cover.

refs.text_big5: 你要用皂莢木作一張桌子，長二肘，寬一肘，高一肘半。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a table of acacia wood: two cubits shall be its length, and a cubit its width, and one and a half cubits its height.

refs.text_gb: 要包上纯金，四围镶上金牙边。
refs.text_big5: 要包上純金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
refs.text_en: And you shall overlay it with pure gold and make a rim of gold around it.

refs.text_gb: 桌子的四围，要作一掌宽的框子，框子的四围镶着金牙边。
refs.text_big5: 桌子的四圍，要作一掌寬的框子，框子的四圍鑲著金牙邊。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a frame of a handbreadth around it; and you shall make a rim of gold for its frame around it.

refs.text_gb: 要作四个金环，安在桌子四个脚的四角上。
refs.text_big5: 要作四個金環，安在桌子四個腳的四角上。
refs.text_en: And you shall make for it four rings of gold and put the rings on the four corners that are on its four feet.

refs.text_gb: 环子要靠近框子，可以穿杠抬桌子。
refs.text_big5: 環子要靠近框子，可以穿槓抬桌子。
refs.text_en: The rings shall be close to the frame as holders for the poles to carry the table.

refs.text_gb: 要用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。
refs.text_big5: 要用皂莢木作兩根槓，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。
refs.text_en: And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be carried with them.

refs.text_gb: 要作桌子上的盘子、调羹、并奠酒的壶和杯；这些都要用纯金制作。
refs.text_big5: 要作桌子上的盤子、調羹、並奠酒的壺和杯；這些都要用純金製作。
refs.text_en: And you shall make its plates and its cups and its pitchers and its bowls with which to pour out drink offerings; of pure gold you shall make them.

refs.text_en: And he cast for it four rings of gold and put the rings on the four corners that were on its four feet.

refs.text_big5: 你要用純金作一個燈臺。燈臺的座和榦，與杯、花萼、花苞，都要接連一塊錘出來。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand with its base and its shaft shall be made of beaten work; its cups, its calyxes, and its blossom buds shall be of one piece with it.

refs.text_gb: 灯台两边要杈出六个枝子，这边三个，那边三个。
refs.text_big5: 燈臺兩邊要杈出六個枝子，這邊三個，那邊三個。
refs.text_en: And there shall be six branches going out of its sides; three branches of the lampstand out of one of its sides, and three branches of the lampstand out of its other side;

refs.text_en: And there shall be on the lampstand four cups made like almond blossoms, its calyxes and its blossom buds;

refs.text_big5: 燈臺每兩個枝子以下有花萼，與燈臺接連一塊；從燈臺杈出來的六個枝子，都是如此；
refs.text_en: And a calyx under two branches of one piece with it, and a calyx under two branches of one piece with it, and a calyx under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lampstand.

refs.text_en: Their calyxes and their branches shall be of one piece with it; all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

refs.text_gb: 要作灯台的七个灯盏；要把灯盏放上，使灯光对照。

refs.text_en: And you shall make its lamps, seven; and set up its lamps to give light to the area in front of it.

refs.text_big5: 燈臺的燈剪和燈花盤，也是要純金的。
refs.text_en: And its tongs and its firepans shall be of pure gold.

refs.text_big5: 作燈臺和這一切的器具，要用純金一他連得。
refs.text_en: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these utensils.

refs.text_big5: 你要謹慎，照著在山上指示你的樣式去作。

refs.text_big5: 要作收灰的盆、鏟子、盤子、肉叉、火盆；壇的一切器具都要用銅作。
refs.text_en: And you shall make its pots to remove its ashes, and its shovels and its basins and its forks and its firepans; all its utensils you shall make of bronze.

refs.text_en: And you shall put it below, under the ledge of the altar so that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

refs.text_big5: 又要用皂莢木為壇作兩根槓，用銅包裹。
refs.text_en: And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

refs.text_gb: 杠要穿在坛两边的环内，用以抬坛。
refs.text_big5: 槓要穿在壇兩邊的環內，用以抬壇。
refs.text_en: And its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.

refs.text_big5: 壇要用板作，壇是空的；在山上怎樣指示你，他們就怎樣作。
refs.text_en: You shall make it hollow with boards; as it was shown to you in the mountain, so shall they make it.

refs.text_gb: 燔祭坛和坛的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座。
refs.text_big5: 燔祭壇和壇的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座。
refs.text_en: And the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the laver and its base.

refs.text_gb: 他用皂荚木作燔祭坛，是四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘。
refs.text_big5: 他用皂莢木作燔祭壇，是四方的，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘。
refs.text_en: And he made the altar of burnt offering, of acacia wood; five cubits was its length, and five cubits, its width, square; and three cubits, its height.

refs.text_gb: 在坛的四拐角上作四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。
refs.text_big5: 在壇的四拐角上作四個角，與壇接連一塊，用銅把壇包裹。
refs.text_en: And he made its horns upon its four corners; its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

refs.text_gb: 他作坛的一切器具，就是收灰的盆、铲子、盘子、肉叉、火盆；这一切器具，都是用铜作的。
refs.text_big5: 他作壇的一切器具，就是收灰的盆、鏟子、盤子、肉叉、火盆；這一切器具，都是用銅作的。
refs.text_en: And he made all the utensils of the altar: the pots and the shovels and the basins, the forks and the firepans; all its utensils he made of bronze.

refs.text_gb: 又为坛作一个铜网，安在坛四面的围腰板以下，从下达到坛的半腰。

refs.text_en: And he made a grating of network of bronze for the altar, under its ledge beneath, reaching halfway up.

refs.text_gb: 为铜网的四角铸四个环子，可以穿杠。
refs.text_big5: 為銅網的四角鑄四個環子，可以穿槓。
refs.text_en: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grating of bronze, as holders for the poles.

refs.text_gb: 用皂荚木作两根杠，用铜包裹。
refs.text_big5: 用皂莢木作兩根槓，用銅包裹。
refs.text_en: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.

refs.text_gb: 把杠穿在坛两边的环内，用以抬坛；坛是用板作的，是中空的。
refs.text_big5: 把槓穿在壇兩邊的環內，用以抬壇；壇是用板作的，是中空的。
refs.text_en: And he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it; he made it hollow, with boards.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华告诉摩西说，
refs.text_big5: 耶和華告訴摩西說，
refs.text_en: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

refs.text_gb: 你要用铜作洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要将盆放在会幕和祭坛之间，在盆里盛水。
refs.text_big5: 你要用銅作洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要將盆放在會幕和祭壇之間，在盆裏盛水。
refs.text_en: You shall also make a laver of bronze, with its base of bronze, for washing. And you shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦和他的儿子们，要用这盆里的水洗手洗脚。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫和他的兒子們，要用這盆裏的水洗手洗腳。
refs.text_en: And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet with water from it;

refs.text_gb: 他们进会幕的时候，要用水洗濯，免得死亡；或是他们就近坛前供职，给耶和华献火祭的时候，
refs.text_big5: 他們進會幕的時候，要用水洗濯，免得死亡；或是他們就近壇前供職，給耶和華獻火祭的時候，
refs.text_en: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they may not die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering by fire to Jehovah,

refs.text_gb: 必要洗手洗脚，免得死亡。这要作亚伦和他后裔，世世代代永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 必要洗手洗腳，免得死亡。這要作亞倫和他後裔，世世代代永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: They shall wash their hands and their feet, that they may not die. And it shall be a perpetual statute to them, for him and for his seed throughout their generations.

refs.text_gb: 他用铜作洗濯盆和盆座，是用会幕门前服事之妇人的铜镜作的。
refs.text_big5: 他用銅作洗濯盆和盆座，是用會幕門前服事之婦人的銅鏡作的。
refs.text_en: And he made the laver of bronze and its base of bronze from the mirrors of the serving women who served at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.text_gb: 精工作的[Cra]衣服，就是祭司亚伦的圣衣，和他儿子们用以作祭司事奉的衣服，
verses.text_big5: 精工作的[Cra]衣服，就是祭司亞倫的聖衣，和他兒子們用以作祭司事奉的衣服，
verses.text_en: And the finely worked garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for them to serve as priests,
verses.text_gb_plain: 精工作的衣服，就是祭司亚伦的圣衣，和他儿子们用以作祭司事奉的衣服，
verses.text_big5_plain: 精工作的衣服，就是祭司亞倫的聖衣，和他兒子們用以作祭司事奉的衣服，

refs.text_gb: 你要从以色列人中，使你的哥哥亚伦，和他的儿子拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛，一同就近你，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 你要從以色列人中，使你的哥哥亞倫，和他的兒子拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪，一同就近你，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And bring near to yourself Aaron your brother and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may serve Me as a priest-Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.

refs.text_gb: 你要给你哥哥亚伦作圣衣，为荣耀为华美。
refs.text_big5: 你要給你哥哥亞倫作聖衣，為榮耀為華美。
refs.text_en: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

refs.text_gb: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦作衣服，使他分别为圣，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的靈所充滿的，給亞倫作衣服，使他分別為聖，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall speak to all who are wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron's garments to sanctify him, that he may serve Me as a priest.

refs.text_gb: 他们要作这些衣服：胸牌、以弗得、外袍、编织的内袍、顶冠、腰带；要为你哥哥亚伦和他儿子们作这圣衣，使他们可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 他們要作這些衣服：胸牌、以弗得、外袍、編織的內袍、頂冠、腰帶；要為你哥哥亞倫和他兒子們作這聖衣，使他們可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate and an ephod and a robe and a tunic of checkered work, a turban and a girding sash. So they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and for his sons that he may serve Me as a priest.

refs.text_gb: 因此，他们要把金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并细麻拿来。
refs.text_big5: 因此，他們要把金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並細麻拿來。
refs.text_en: They therefore shall take the gold and the blue and the purple and the scarlet strands and the fine linen,

refs.text_gb: 他们要用金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻，以巧匠的手工作以弗得。
refs.text_big5: 他們要用金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻，以巧匠的手工作以弗得。
refs.text_en: And they shall make the ephod of gold thread, of blue and purple and scarlet strands, and fine twined linen, the work of a skillful workman.

refs.text_gb: 以弗得当有两条肩带，接在以弗得两端，使以弗得相连。
refs.text_big5: 以弗得當有兩條肩帶，接在以弗得兩端，使以弗得相連。
refs.text_en: It shall have two shoulder pieces joined to its two edges, so that it may be joined together.

refs.text_gb: 以弗得上巧工织的带子，要和以弗得一样的作法，用以系住，与以弗得接连一块；要用金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻作成。
refs.text_big5: 以弗得上巧工織的帶子，要和以弗得一樣的作法，用以繫住，與以弗得接連一塊；要用金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻作成。
refs.text_en: And the skillfully woven band, which is on it for its fastening, shall be like it in workmanship, of one piece with it; of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen.

refs.text_gb: 要取两块红玛瑙，刻上以色列儿子们的名字；
refs.text_big5: 要取兩塊紅瑪瑙，刻上以色列兒子們的名字；
refs.text_en: And you shall take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel,

refs.text_gb: 六个名字在这块宝石上，其余六个名字在那块宝石上，都照他们出生的次序。
refs.text_big5: 六個名字在這塊寶石上，其餘六個名字在那塊寶石上，都照他們出生的次序。
refs.text_en: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the remaining six on the other stone, according to their birth.

refs.text_gb: 要用刻宝石的手工，仿佛刻图章，按着以色列儿子们的名字，刻这两块宝石，镶嵌在金框内。
refs.text_big5: 要用刻寶石的手工，彷彿刻圖章，按著以色列兒子們的名字，刻這兩塊寶石，鑲嵌在金框內。
refs.text_en: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the sons of Israel; you shall make them enclosed in settings of gold.

refs.text_gb: 要将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人作记念石。亚伦要在两肩上担他们的名字，在耶和华面前作为记念。
refs.text_big5: 要將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人作記念石。亞倫要在兩肩上擔他們的名字，在耶和華面前作為記念。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel. And Aaron shall bear their names before Jehovah on his two shoulders for a memorial.

refs.text_gb: 你要用金作两个框，
refs.text_big5: 你要用金作兩個框，
refs.text_en: And you shall make settings of gold,

refs.text_gb: 又要用纯金，以拧绳子的手工，作两条链子，把这拧成的链子接在两框上。
refs.text_big5: 又要用純金，以擰繩子的手工，作兩條鍊子，把這擰成的鍊子接在兩框上。
refs.text_en: And two chains of pure gold; you shall make them twisted, a corded work, and you shall put the chains of cords on the settings.

refs.text_gb: 你要用巧匠的手工，作一个决断的胸牌；要和以弗得一样的作法，用金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻作成。
refs.text_big5: 你要用巧匠的手工，作一個決斷的胸牌；要和以弗得一樣的作法，用金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻作成。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of a skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet strands, and of fine twined linen you shall make it.

refs.text_gb: 这胸牌要四方的，叠为两层，长一虎口，宽一虎口。
refs.text_big5: 這胸牌要四方的，疊為兩層，長一虎口，寬一虎口。
refs.text_en: It shall be square and doubled; a span its length and a span its width.

refs.text_gb: 要在上面镶嵌四行宝石：第一行是红宝石、黄玉、绿宝石，
refs.text_big5: 要在上面鑲嵌四行寶石：第一行是紅寶石、黃玉、綠寶石，
refs.text_en: And you shall enclose in it enclosures of stones, four rows of stones: the first row shall be a row of a sardius, a topaz, and an emerald;

refs.text_gb: 第二行是红玉、蓝宝石、金钢石，
refs.text_big5: 第二行是紅玉、藍寶石、金鋼石，
refs.text_en: And the second row, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a diamond;

refs.text_gb: 第三行是紫玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶，
refs.text_big5: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶，
refs.text_en: And the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

refs.text_gb: 第四行是黄璧玺、红玛瑙、碧玉；这些都要镶嵌在金框内。
refs.text_big5: 第四行是黃璧璽、紅瑪瑙、碧玉；這些都要鑲嵌在金框內。
refs.text_en: And the fourth row, a chrysolite, and an onyx, and a jasper; they shall be set in gold in their enclosures.

refs.text_gb: 这些宝石，按着以色列儿子们的名字，要有十二块；每块刻一个名字，仿佛刻图章，代表十二个支派。
refs.text_big5: 這些寶石，按著以色列兒子們的名字，要有十二塊；每塊刻一個名字，彷彿刻圖章，代表十二個支派。
refs.text_en: And the stones shall be according to the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names; they shall be like the engravings of a signet, each according to its name, for the twelve tribes.

refs.text_gb: 要在胸牌上，用纯金以拧绳子的手工作链子。
refs.text_big5: 要在胸牌上，用純金以擰繩子的手工作鍊子。
refs.text_en: And you shall make on the breastplate twisted chains, a corded work of pure gold.

refs.text_gb: 在胸牌上也要作两个金环，安在胸牌的两端。
refs.text_big5: 在胸牌上也要作兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩端。
refs.text_en: And you shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

refs.text_gb: 要把那两条拧成的金链子，穿在胸牌两端的环子里。
refs.text_big5: 要把那兩條擰成的金鍊子，穿在胸牌兩端的環子裏。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

refs.text_gb: 又要把链子的另外两端，接在两框上，安在以弗得前面的肩带上。
refs.text_big5: 又要把鍊子的另外兩端，接在兩框上，安在以弗得前面的肩帶上。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the two other ends of the two cords on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front of it.

refs.text_gb: 要作两个金环，安在胸牌两端里面的边上，贴近以弗得。
refs.text_big5: 要作兩個金環，安在胸牌兩端裏面的邊上，貼近以弗得。
refs.text_en: And you shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them upon the two ends of the breastplate upon its edge, which is toward the ephod on the inside.

refs.text_gb: 又要作两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，靠近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。
refs.text_big5: 又要作兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，靠近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。
refs.text_en: And you shall make two rings of gold and shall put them on the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod on the front of it, close to the place where it is joined, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

refs.text_gb: 要用蓝细带子，把胸牌的环子与以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不至从以弗得松开。
refs.text_big5: 要用藍細帶子，把胸牌的環子與以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不至從以弗得鬆開。
refs.text_en: And they shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue strands, that it may be upon the skillfully woven band of the ephod and that the breastplate may not come loose from the ephod.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦进圣所的时候，要将决断胸牌上以色列儿子们的名字，带在胸前，在耶和华面前常作记念。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫進聖所的時候，要將決斷胸牌上以色列兒子們的名字，帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常作記念。
refs.text_en: So Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart when he goes into the sanctuary, for a memorial before Jehovah continually.

refs.text_gb: 你又要将乌陵和土明放在决断的胸牌里；亚伦进到耶和华面前的时候，要带在胸前，在耶和华面前常将以色列人的决断牌带在胸前。
refs.text_big5: 你又要將烏陵和土明放在決斷的胸牌裏；亞倫進到耶和華面前的時候，要帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常將以色列人的決斷牌帶在胸前。
refs.text_en: And you shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron's heart when he goes in before Jehovah, and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Jehovah continually.

refs.text_gb: 你要作以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。
refs.text_big5: 你要作以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。
refs.text_en: And you shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue strands.

refs.text_gb: 袍上要为头留一领口，用编织的手工在领口周围织出领边，仿佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。
refs.text_big5: 袍上要為頭留一領口，用編織的手工在領口周圍織出領邊，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。
refs.text_en: And there shall be an opening for the head in its center; around its opening there shall be a binding edge of woven work, like the opening of a coat of mail, so that it will not be torn.

refs.text_gb: 袍子周围底边上，要用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线作石榴。在袍子周围的石榴中间，要有金铃，
refs.text_big5: 袍子周圍底邊上，要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線作石榴。在袍子周圍的石榴中間，要有金鈴，
refs.text_en: And you shall make on its hem pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet strands, all around its hem, and bells of gold between them all around:

refs.text_gb: 一个金铃一个石榴，一个金铃一个石榴，在袍子周围的底边上。
refs.text_big5: 一個金鈴一個石榴，一個金鈴一個石榴，在袍子周圍的底邊上。
refs.text_en: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, on the hem of the robe all around.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦供职的时候，要穿这袍子。他进圣所到耶和华面前，以及出来的时候，袍上的铃声必被听见，使他不至于死亡。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫供職的時候，要穿這袍子。他進聖所到耶和華面前，以及出來的時候，袍上的鈴聲必被聽見，使他不至於死亡。
refs.text_en: And it shall be upon Aaron when he ministers, and its sound shall be heard when he goes into the sanctuary before Jehovah and when he comes out, so that he may not die.

refs.text_gb: 你要用纯金作一面牌，在上面按刻图章之法，刻着归耶和华为圣。
refs.text_big5: 你要用純金作一面牌，在上面按刻圖章之法，刻著歸耶和華為聖。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a plate of pure gold and engrave upon it, like the engravings of a signet: HOLINESS TO JEHOVAH.

refs.text_gb: 要用蓝细带子，将牌系在顶冠前面。
refs.text_big5: 要用藍細帶子，將牌繫在頂冠前面。
refs.text_en: And you shall put it on a cord of blue strands, and it shall be on the turban; it shall be at the front of the turban.

refs.text_gb: 这牌必在亚伦的额上，亚伦要担当干犯圣物的罪孽；这些圣物是以色列人所分别为圣，作他们一切圣礼物的；这牌要常在亚伦的额上，使他们可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
refs.text_big5: 這牌必在亞倫的額上，亞倫要擔當干犯聖物的罪孽；這些聖物是以色列人所分別為聖，作他們一切聖禮物的；這牌要常在亞倫的額上，使他們可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。
refs.text_en: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel sanctify for all their holy gifts; and it shall always be on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 要用细麻线编织内袍，用细麻布作顶冠，又用绣花的手工作腰带。
refs.text_big5: 要用細麻線編織內袍，用細麻布作頂冠，又用繡花的手工作腰帶。
refs.text_en: And you shall weave the tunic of fine linen, and you shall make a turban of fine linen, and you shall make a girding sash, the work of an embroiderer.

refs.text_gb: 你要为亚伦的儿子们作内袍、腰带、头巾，为荣耀为华美。
refs.text_big5: 你要為亞倫的兒子們作內袍、腰帶、頭巾，為榮耀為華美。
refs.text_en: And for Aaron's sons you shall make tunics, and you shall make for them girding sashes, and you shall make for them high hats, for glory and for beauty.

refs.text_gb: 要把这些给你的哥哥亚伦和他儿子们穿戴；又要膏他们，使他们承接圣职，将他们分别为圣，他们好作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 要把這些給你的哥哥亞倫和他兒子們穿戴；又要膏他們，使他們承接聖職，將他們分別為聖，他們好作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall put them upon Aaron your brother and upon his sons with him, and you shall anoint them and consecrate them and sanctify them, that they may serve Me as priests.

refs.text_gb: 要给他们作细麻布裤子，遮掩下体；裤子当从腰达到大腿。
refs.text_big5: 要給他們作細麻布褲子，遮掩下體；褲子當從腰達到大腿。
refs.text_en: And you shall make them linen trousers to cover their naked flesh; they shall reach from the loins even to the thighs;

refs.text_gb: 亚伦和他儿子们进入会幕，或就近坛，在圣所供职的时候必穿上，免得担当罪孽而死。这要为亚伦和他的后裔作永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫和他兒子們進入會幕，或就近壇，在聖所供職的時候必穿上，免得擔當罪孽而死。這要為亞倫和他的後裔作永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: And they shall be upon Aaron and upon his sons when they go into the Tent of Meeting or when they come near to the altar to minister in the sanctuary, that they may not bear iniquity and die. It shall be a perpetual statute for him and for his seed after him.

refs.text_gb: 比撒列用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，以精工制作衣服，用以在圣所供职，又为亚伦作圣衣；是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_big5: 比撒列用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，以精工製作衣服，用以在聖所供職，又為亞倫作聖衣；是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_en: And from the blue and the purple and the scarlet strands, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the sanctuary, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

refs.text_gb: 他用金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻作以弗得；
refs.text_big5: 他用金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻作以弗得；
refs.text_en: And Bezalel made the ephod of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen.

refs.text_gb: 他们把金子锤成薄片，剪出线来，用巧匠的手工，编织在蓝色、紫色、朱红色线和细麻中。
refs.text_big5: 他們把金子錘成薄片，剪出線來，用巧匠的手工，編織在藍色、紫色、朱紅色線和細麻中。
refs.text_en: And they beat the gold into thin sheets and cut them into threads, to work into the blue and into the purple and into the scarlet strands and into the fine linen, the work of a skillful workman.

refs.text_gb: 又为以弗得作两条肩带，与以弗得相连，接在以弗得两端。
refs.text_big5: 又為以弗得作兩條肩帶，與以弗得相連，接在以弗得兩端。
refs.text_en: They made shoulder pieces for it, joined to it; at the two edges it was joined.

refs.text_gb: 以弗得上巧工织的带子，和以弗得一样的作法，与以弗得接连一块，用以系住，是用金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻作的；是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_big5: 以弗得上巧工織的帶子，和以弗得一樣的作法，與以弗得接連一塊，用以繫住，是用金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻作的；是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_en: And the skillfully woven band, which was on it for its fastening, was of one piece with it and like it in workmanship, of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

refs.text_gb: 又琢出两块红玛瑙，镶嵌在金框内，仿佛刻图章，按着以色列儿子们的名字雕刻。
refs.text_big5: 又琢出兩塊紅瑪瑙，鑲嵌在金框內，彷彿刻圖章，按著以色列兒子們的名字雕刻。
refs.text_en: And they made the onyx stones enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet according to the names of the sons of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 他将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人作记念石，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_big5: 他將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人作記念石，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_en: And he put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

refs.text_gb: 他用巧匠的手工作胸牌，和以弗得一样的作法，用金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻作成。
refs.text_big5: 他用巧匠的手工作胸牌，和以弗得一樣的作法，用金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻作成。
refs.text_en: And he made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod, of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet strands and of fine twined linen.

refs.text_gb: 胸牌是四方的，叠为两层；这两层长一虎口，宽一虎口。
refs.text_big5: 胸牌是四方的，疊為兩層；這兩層長一虎口，寬一虎口。
refs.text_en: It was square; they made the breastplate doubled; a span its length and a span its width when doubled.

refs.text_gb: 他们在上面镶嵌四行宝石：第一行是红宝石、黄玉、绿宝石，
refs.text_big5: 他們在上面鑲嵌四行寶石：第一行是紅寶石、黃玉、綠寶石，
refs.text_en: And they filled it with four rows of stones. The first row was a row of a sardius, a topaz, and an emerald;

refs.text_gb: 第二行是红玉、蓝宝石、金钢石，
refs.text_big5: 第二行是紅玉、藍寶石、金鋼石，
refs.text_en: And the second row, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a diamond;

refs.text_gb: 第三行是紫玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶，
refs.text_big5: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶，
refs.text_en: And the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

refs.text_gb: 第四行是黄碧玺、红玛瑙、碧玉；这些都镶嵌在金框内。
refs.text_big5: 第四行是黃碧璽、紅瑪瑙、碧玉；這些都鑲嵌在金框內。
refs.text_en: And the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in settings of gold in their enclosures.

refs.text_gb: 这些宝石，按着以色列儿子们的名字，有十二块；每块刻一个名字，仿佛刻图章，代表十二个支派。
refs.text_big5: 這些寶石，按著以色列兒子們的名字，有十二塊；每塊刻一個名字，彷彿刻圖章，代表十二個支派。
refs.text_en: And the stones were according to the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, each according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

refs.text_gb: 在胸牌上，用纯金以拧绳子的手工作链子。
refs.text_big5: 在胸牌上，用純金以擰繩子的手工作鍊子。
refs.text_en: And they made on the breastplate twisted chains, a corded work of pure gold.

refs.text_gb: 又作两个金框和两个金环，安在胸牌的两端。
refs.text_big5: 又作兩個金框和兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩端。
refs.text_en: And they made two settings of gold and two rings of gold, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

refs.text_gb: 把那两条拧成的金链子，穿在胸牌两端的环子里。
refs.text_big5: 把那兩條擰成的金鍊子，穿在胸牌兩端的環子裏。
refs.text_en: And they put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

refs.text_gb: 又把链子的另外两端，接在两框上，安在以弗得前面的肩带上。
refs.text_big5: 又把鍊子的另外兩端，接在兩框上，安在以弗得前面的肩帶上。
refs.text_en: And the two other ends of the two cords they put on the two settings and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front of it.

refs.text_gb: 作两个金环，安在胸牌两端里面的边上，贴近以弗得。
refs.text_big5: 作兩個金環，安在胸牌兩端裏面的邊上，貼近以弗得。
refs.text_en: And they made two rings of gold and put them on the two ends of the breastplate on its edge, which was toward the ephod on the inside.

refs.text_gb: 又作两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，靠近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。
refs.text_big5: 又作兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，靠近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。
refs.text_en: And they made two rings of gold and put them on the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod on the front of it, close to the place where it is joined, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

refs.text_gb: 用蓝细带子，把胸牌的环子与以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不至从以弗得松开；是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_big5: 用藍細帶子，把胸牌的環子與以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不至從以弗得鬆開；是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_en: And they bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue strands, that it might be upon the skillfully woven band of the ephod and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

refs.text_gb: 他用编织的手工，作以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。
refs.text_big5: 他用編織的手工，作以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。
refs.text_en: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue strands,

refs.text_gb: 袍上留一领口，在领口周围织出领边，仿佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。
refs.text_big5: 袍上留一領口，在領口周圍織出領邊，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。
refs.text_en: And the opening of the robe in its center like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding edge around its opening so that it would not be torn.

refs.text_gb: 在袍子底边上，用捻的蓝色、紫色、朱红色线作石榴。
refs.text_big5: 在袍子底邊上，用撚的藍色、紫色、朱紅色線作石榴。
refs.text_en: And they made on the hem of the robe pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet strands, twined.

refs.text_gb: 又用纯金作铃，把金铃钉在袍子周围底边上的石榴中间；
refs.text_big5: 又用純金作鈴，把金鈴釘在袍子周圍底邊上的石榴中間；
refs.text_en: And they made bells of pure gold and put the bells between the pomegranates on the hem of the robe all around, between the pomegranates;

refs.text_gb: 一个金铃一个石榴，一个金铃一个石榴，在袍子周围底边上，用以供职；是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_big5: 一個金鈴一個石榴，一個金鈴一個石榴，在袍子周圍底邊上，用以供職；是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_en: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, on the hem of the robe all around, to minister in; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

refs.text_gb: 他们用织成的细麻布，为亚伦和他的儿子们作内袍；
refs.text_big5: 他們用織成的細麻布，為亞倫和他的兒子們作內袍；
refs.text_en: And they made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

refs.text_gb: 并用细麻布作顶冠和华美的头巾，用捻的细麻作细麻布裤子；
refs.text_big5: 並用細麻布作頂冠和華美的頭巾，用撚的細麻作細麻布褲子；
refs.text_en: And the turban of fine linen, and the headdresses of high hats of fine linen, and the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

refs.text_gb: 又用捻的细麻，并蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，以绣花的手工作腰带；是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_big5: 又用撚的細麻，並藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，以繡花的手工作腰帶；是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_en: And the girding sash of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet strands, the work of an embroiderer, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

refs.text_gb: 他们用纯金作圣冠的牌，在上面按刻图章之法，刻着归耶和华为圣的字样。
refs.text_big5: 他們用純金作聖冠的牌，在上面按刻圖章之法，刻著歸耶和華為聖的字樣。
refs.text_en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold and wrote an inscription upon it, like the engravings of a signet: HOLINESS TO JEHOVAH.

refs.text_gb: 又用蓝细带子，将牌系在顶冠上；是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_big5: 又用藍細帶子，將牌繫在頂冠上；是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_en: And they tied to it a cord of blue strands to fasten it on the turban above, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

refs.text_gb: 给亚伦穿上内袍，束上腰带，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用其上巧工织的带子束上，把以弗得系在他身上；
refs.text_big5: 給亞倫穿上內袍，束上腰帶，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用其上巧工織的帶子束上，把以弗得繫在他身上；

refs.text_big5: 又給他戴上胸牌，把烏陵和土明放在胸牌內，

refs.text_gb: 摩西叫亚伦的儿子们近前来，给他们穿上内袍，束上腰带，裹上头巾，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

refs.text_en: And Moses brought Aaron's sons near, and clothed them with tunics and girded them with girding sashes and bound high hats on them, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

verses.text_en: And the anointing oil, and the incense of fragrant spices for the sanctuary. According to all that I have commanded you, they shall do.
verses.text_gb_plain: 膏油和供圣所用馨香香料的香。他们都要照我所吩咐你的一切去作。
verses.text_big5_plain: 膏油和供聖所用馨香香料的香。他們都要照我所吩咐你的一切去作。

refs.text_gb: 你要取上好的香料，就是流质的没药五百舍客勒，香肉桂一半，就是二百五十舍客勒，香菖蒲二百五十舍客勒，

refs.text_en: You also take the finest spices: of flowing myrrh five hundred shekels, and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, two hundred fifty shekels, and of fragrant calamus two hundred fifty shekels,

refs.text_gb: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按着圣所的舍客勒，又取橄榄油一欣；
refs.text_big5: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按著聖所的舍客勒，又取橄欖油一欣；
refs.text_en: And of cassia five hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, and a hin of olive oil.

refs.text_gb: 你要把这些香料，按调制香品者之法复合成香品，作成圣膏油。
refs.text_big5: 你要把這些香料，按調製香品者之法複合成香品，作成聖膏油。
refs.text_en: And you shall make it a holy anointing oil, a fragrant ointment compounded according to the work of a compounder; it shall be a holy anointing oil.

refs.text_gb: 要用这膏油抹会幕和见证的柜、
refs.text_big5: 要用這膏油抹會幕和見證的櫃、
refs.text_en: And with it you shall anoint the Tent of Meeting and the Ark of the Testimony,

refs.text_gb: 桌子和桌子的一切器具、灯台和灯台的器具、并香坛、
refs.text_big5: 桌子和桌子的一切器具、燈臺和燈臺的器具、並香壇、
refs.text_en: And the table and all its utensils, and the lampstand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,

refs.text_gb: 燔祭坛和坛的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座。
refs.text_big5: 燔祭壇和壇的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座。
refs.text_en: And the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the laver and its base.

refs.text_gb: 你要这样使这些分别为圣，好成为至圣；凡触着这些的都成为圣。
refs.text_big5: 你要這樣使這些分別為聖，好成為至聖；凡觸著這些的都成為聖。
refs.text_en: Thus you shall sanctify them that they may be most holy; whatever touches them shall be holy.

refs.text_gb: 要膏亚伦和他的儿子们，使他们分别为圣，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 要膏亞倫和他的兒子們，使他們分別為聖，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons and sanctify them that they may serve Me as priests.

refs.text_gb: 你要对以色列人说，这油要世世代代归我为圣膏油。
refs.text_big5: 你要對以色列人說，這油要世世代代歸我為聖膏油。
refs.text_en: And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, This shall be a holy anointing oil to Me throughout your generations.

refs.text_gb: 不可倒在一般人的身上，也不可按这些成分，调制与这相似的；这膏油是圣的，你们也要以为圣。
refs.text_big5: 不可倒在一般人的身上，也不可按這些成分，調製與這相似的；這膏油是聖的，你們也要以為聖。
refs.text_en: Upon the flesh of man it shall not be poured, nor shall you make any like it, according to its composition; it is holy, and it shall be holy to you.

refs.text_gb: 凡调制与这相似的，或将这膏油膏在凡俗的人身上的，这人要从民中剪除。
refs.text_big5: 凡調製與這相似的，或將這膏油膏在凡俗的人身上的，這人要從民中剪除。
refs.text_en: Whoever compounds any like it or whoever puts any of it upon a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.

refs.text_gb: 又按调制香品者之法，作圣膏油和纯净馨香的香。
refs.text_big5: 又按調製香品者之法，作聖膏油和純淨馨香的香。
refs.text_en: And he made the holy anointing oil and the pure fragrant incense, the work of a compounder.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦要在坛上烧馨香的香；每早晨他收拾灯的时候，要烧这香。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫要在壇上燒馨香的香；每早晨他收拾燈的時候，要燒這香。
refs.text_en: And Aaron shall burn on it fragrant incense; every morning when he dresses the lamps he shall burn it.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你要取馨香的香料，就是苏合香、香螺、白松香；这些馨香的香料和纯乳香，各样的分量要相等。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你要取馨香的香料，就是蘇合香、香螺、白松香；這些馨香的香料和純乳香，各樣的分量要相等。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take fragrant spices-stacte and onycha and galbanum-fragrant spices with pure frankincense; there shall be an equal part of each;

refs.text_gb: 你要用这些加上盐，按调制香品者之法作成香品，作成纯净圣别的香。
refs.text_big5: 你要用這些加上鹽，按調製香品者之法作成香品，作成純淨聖別的香。
refs.text_en: And you shall make of it incense, a fragrant compound according to the work of a compounder, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

refs.text_gb: 这香要取些捣得极细，放些在会幕内见证的柜前，我要在那里与你相会；你们要以这香为至圣。
refs.text_big5: 這香要取些搗得極細，放些在會幕內見證的櫃前，我要在那裏與你相會；你們要以這香為至聖。
refs.text_en: And you shall beat some of it very fine, and put some of it before the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you; it shall be to you most holy.

refs.text_gb: 你们为自己调制的香，不可按这些成分调制；要以这香为圣，归耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 你們為自己調製的香，不可按這些成分調製；要以這香為聖，歸耶和華。
refs.text_en: And the incense which you shall make, you shall not make for yourselves according to its composition; it shall be holy to you for Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 凡作香和这香一样，为要闻香味的，这人要从民中剪除。
refs.text_big5: 凡作香和這香一樣，為要聞香味的，這人要從民中剪除。
refs.text_en: Whoever shall make any like it, to smell it, shall be cut off from his people.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华告诉摩西说，
verses.text_big5: 耶和華告訴摩西說，
verses.text_en: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华告诉摩西说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華告訴摩西說，

verses.text_gb: [Cra]你要吩咐以色列人说，你们务要守我的[Fn1]安息日；因为这是我与你们之间世世代代的[Fn2][Crb]记号，使你们[Crc]知道我是把你们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]你要吩咐以色列人說，你們務要守我的[Fn1]安息日；因為這是我與你們之間世世代代的[Fn2][Crb]記號，使你們[Crc]知道我是把你們分別為聖的耶和華。
verses.text_en: Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, You shall surely keep My Sabbaths; for it is a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am Jehovah who sanctifies you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你要吩咐以色列人说，你们务要守我的安息日；因为这是我与你们之间世世代代的记号，使你们知道我是把你们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你要吩咐以色列人說，你們務要守我的安息日；因為這是我與你們之間世世代代的記號，使你們知道我是把你們分別為聖的耶和華。

footnotes.zh: 这里再次提到安息日(参二十8～11)，与神居所建造的工作有关，表征当神的子民同祂并为祂作工时，他们必须学习借着享受祂并被祂充满，而与祂同得安息。守安息日是一个记号(17)，表明神的子民为神作工，不是凭着他们自己的力量，乃是借着享受祂并与祂是一。守安息日也是一个永远的约(16)，向神保证我们与祂是一，是借着先享受祂，然后才与祂同工、为祂作工并且与祂是一而作工。神是先作工，后安息；人是先安息，后作工(创二2与注)。这里提到安息日，也指明凡与帐幕及其器物有关的事，都把我们引到神的安息日，及其安息与舒畅，以享受神所定意并作成的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏再次題到安息日，（參二十8～11，）與神居所建造的工作有關，表徵當神的子民同祂並為祂作工時，他們必須學習藉著享受祂並被祂充滿，而與祂同得安息。守安息日是一個記號，（17，）表明神的子民為神作工，不是憑著他們自己的力量，乃是藉著享受祂並與祂是一。守安息日也是一個永遠的約，（16，）向神保證我們與祂是一，是藉著先享受祂，然後纔與祂同工、為祂作工、並且與祂是一而作工。神是先作工，後安息；人是先安息，後作工。（創二2與註。）這裏題到安息日，也指明凡與帳幕及其器物有關的事，都把我們引到神的安息日，及其安息與舒暢，以享受神所定意並作成的。
footnotes.en: 31:13 1 Sabbaths The Sabbath is mentioned again here (cf. Exo. 20:8-11), in relation to the work of building God's dwelling place, signifying that as God's people work with Him and for Him, they must learn to rest with Him by enjoying Him and being filled with Him. Keeping the Sabbath is a sign (v. 17) that God's people work for God not by their own strength but by enjoying Him and being one with Him. It is also an eternal covenant (v. 16) assuring God that we will be one with Him by first enjoying Him and then working with Him, for Him, and in oneness with Him. God first worked and then rested; man first rests and then works (Gen. 2:2 and note Gen. 2:2 1 ). The mentioning of the Sabbath here indicates also that everything related to the tabernacle and its furniture leads us to God's Sabbath, with its rest and refreshment in the enjoyment of what God has purposed and done.

footnotes.zh: 见二十10注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見二十10註1。
footnotes.en: 31:13 2 sign See note Exo. 20:10 1 .

refs.text_gb: 当记念安息日，将这日分别为圣。
refs.text_big5: 當記念安息日，將這日分別為聖。
refs.text_en: Remember the Sabbath day so as to sanctify it.

refs.text_gb: 六日要劳碌作你一切的工，
refs.text_big5: 六日要勞碌作你一切的工，
refs.text_en: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

refs.text_gb: 但第七日是向耶和华你神当守的安息日；这一日你和你的儿子、女儿、仆人、婢女、牲畜、并你城里的寄居者，无论何工都不可作；
refs.text_big5: 但第七日是向耶和華你神當守的安息日；這一日你和你的兒子、女兒、僕人、婢女、牲畜、並你城裏的寄居者，無論何工都不可作；
refs.text_en: But the seventh day is a Sabbath to Jehovah your God; you shall not do any work, you nor your son nor your daughter, your male servant nor your female servant, nor your cattle nor the sojourner with you, who is within your gates.

refs.text_gb: 因为六日之内，耶和华造天、地、海、和其中的万物，第七日便安息了；所以耶和华赐福与安息日，将这日分别为圣。
refs.text_big5: 因為六日之內，耶和華造天、地、海、和其中的萬物，第七日便安息了；所以耶和華賜福與安息日，將這日分別為聖。
refs.text_en: For in six days Jehovah made heaven and earth, the sea and all that is in them, and rested on the seventh day; therefore Jehovah blessed the Sabbath day and sanctified it.

refs.text_gb: 当照耶和华你神所吩咐的，守安息日，将这日分别为圣。
refs.text_big5: 當照耶和華你神所吩咐的，守安息日，將這日分別為聖。
refs.text_en: Keep the Sabbath day so as to sanctify it, as Jehovah your God has commanded you.

refs.text_gb: 六日要劳碌作你一切的工，
refs.text_big5: 六日要勞碌作你一切的工，
refs.text_en: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

refs.text_gb: 但第七日是向耶和华你神当守的安息日；这一日你和你的儿子、女儿、仆人、婢女、牛、驴、牲畜、并你城里的寄居者，无论何工都不可作，使你的仆人、婢女可以和你一样安息。
refs.text_big5: 但第七日是向耶和華你神當守的安息日；這一日你和你的兒子、女兒、僕人、婢女、牛、驢、牲畜、並你城裏的寄居者，無論何工都不可作，使你的僕人、婢女可以和你一樣安息。
refs.text_en: But the seventh day is a Sabbath to Jehovah your God; you shall not do any work, you nor your son nor your daughter nor your male servant nor your female servant nor your ox nor your donkey nor any of your cattle nor the sojourner with you who is within your gates, so that your male servant and your female servant may rest as you do.

refs.text_gb: 你要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆，耶和华你神用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，将你从那里领出来；因此，耶和华你的神吩咐你守安息日。
refs.text_big5: 你要記念你在埃及地作過奴僕，耶和華你神用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，將你從那裏領出來；因此，耶和華你的神吩咐你守安息日。
refs.text_en: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt and that Jehovah your God brought you out from there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm; hence, Jehovah your God commanded you to hold the Sabbath day.

refs.text_gb: 六日要作工，第七日是完全安息的安息日，当有圣会。你们什么工都不可作；这是在你们一切的住处向耶和华守的安息日。
refs.text_big5: 六日要作工，第七日是完全安息的安息日，當有聖會。你們甚麼工都不可作；這是在你們一切的住處向耶和華守的安息日。
refs.text_en: Six days work shall be done, but on the seventh day there is a Sabbath of complete rest, a holy convocation. You shall do no work; it is a Sabbath to Jehovah in all your dwelling places.

refs.text_gb: 也不要在安息日从家中担什么担子出去；无论何工都不可作，只要分别安息日为圣，正如我所吩咐你们列祖的。
refs.text_big5: 也不要在安息日從家中擔甚麼擔子出去；無論何工都不可作，只要分別安息日為聖，正如我所吩咐你們列祖的。
refs.text_en: And do not bring out any burden from your houses on the Sabbath day, nor do any work; but sanctify the Sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

refs.text_gb: 这是我与以色列人之间永远的记号；因为六日之内耶和华造天地，第七日便安息舒畅。
refs.text_big5: 這是我與以色列人之間永遠的記號；因為六日之內耶和華造天地，第七日便安息舒暢。
refs.text_en: It is a sign between Me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days Jehovah made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.

refs.text_gb: 又将我的安息日赐给他们，好在我与他们中间作记号，叫他们知道我是那使他们分别为圣的耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 又將我的安息日賜給他們，好在我與他們中間作記號，叫他們知道我是那使他們分別為聖的耶和華。
refs.text_en: And also I gave them My Sabbaths to be a sign between Me and them, that they might know that I am Jehovah who sanctifies them.

refs.text_gb: 且将我的安息日分别为圣，这日在我与你们中间作记号，叫你们知道我是耶和华你们的神。
refs.text_big5: 且將我的安息日分別為聖，這日在我與你們中間作記號，叫你們知道我是耶和華你們的神。
refs.text_en: And sanctify My Sabbaths, and they will be a sign between Me and you, that you might know that I am Jehovah your God.

refs.text_gb: 我要取你们归我作我的百姓，我也要作你们的神。你们要知道我是耶和华你们的神，是把你们从埃及人所加的重担下领出来的。
refs.text_big5: 我要取你們歸我作我的百姓，我也要作你們的神。你們要知道我是耶和華你們的神，是把你們從埃及人所加的重擔下領出來的。
refs.text_en: And I will take you to Myself as My people, and I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Jehovah your God, the One who brought you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

verses.text_gb: 所以你们要守安息日，因为这是你们的圣日。[Cra]凡渎犯这日的，必要被处[Fn1]死；凡在这日作工的，那[Fn2]人要从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5: 所以你們要守安息日，因為這是你們的聖日。[Cra]凡瀆犯這日的，必要被處[Fn1]死；凡在這日作工的，那[Fn2]人要從民中剪除。
verses.text_en: Therefore you shall keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work on it, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以你们要守安息日，因为这是你们的圣日。凡渎犯这日的，必要被处死；凡在这日作工的，那人要从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以你們要守安息日，因為這是你們的聖日。凡瀆犯這日的，必要被處死；凡在這日作工的，那人要從民中剪除。

footnotes.zh: 我们为神作工，却不享受祂，不与祂是一，结果乃是属灵的死亡，并且失去在基督身体里的交通。
footnotes.en: 31:14 1 death When we work for God without enjoying Him and being one with Him, the result is spiritual death and the loss of the fellowship in the Body.

footnotes.zh: 直译，魂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，魂。

refs.text_gb: 以色列人在旷野的时候，有人遇见一个人在安息日捡柴。
refs.text_big5: 以色列人在曠野的時候，有人遇見一個人在安息日撿柴。
refs.text_en: Now while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

refs.text_gb: 遇见他捡柴的人，就把他带到摩西、亚伦、并全会众那里。
refs.text_big5: 遇見他撿柴的人，就把他帶到摩西、亞倫、並全會眾那裏。
refs.text_en: And those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron and to the whole assembly.

refs.text_gb: 他们将他拘禁起来，因为当怎样办他，还没有指明。
refs.text_big5: 他們將他拘禁起來，因為當怎樣辦他，還沒有指明。
refs.text_en: And they put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，那人必要被处死；全会众要在营外用石头把他打死。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，那人必要被處死；全會眾要在營外用石頭把他打死。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, The man shall surely be put to death; the whole assembly shall stone him with stones outside the camp.

refs.text_gb: 于是全会众将他带到营外，用石头打死他，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_big5: 於是全會眾將他帶到營外，用石頭打死他，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
refs.text_en: So the whole assembly brought him outside the camp and stoned him to death with stones, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

verses.text_gb: 六日要作工，但第七日是完全安息的安息日，是归耶和华为圣的；凡在安息日作工的，必要被处死。
verses.text_big5: 六日要作工，但第七日是完全安息的安息日，是歸耶和華為聖的；凡在安息日作工的，必要被處死。
verses.text_en: Six days work shall be done, but on the seventh day there is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to Jehovah; whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.
verses.text_gb_plain: 六日要作工，但第七日是完全安息的安息日，是归耶和华为圣的；凡在安息日作工的，必要被处死。
verses.text_big5_plain: 六日要作工，但第七日是完全安息的安息日，是歸耶和華為聖的；凡在安息日作工的，必要被處死。

verses.text_gb: 故此，以色列人要谨守安息日，要世世代代守这安息日为永远的约。
verses.text_big5: 故此，以色列人要謹守安息日，要世世代代守這安息日為永遠的約。
verses.text_en: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations as a perpetual covenant.
verses.text_gb_plain: 故此，以色列人要谨守安息日，要世世代代守这安息日为永远的约。
verses.text_big5_plain: 故此，以色列人要謹守安息日，要世世代代守這安息日為永遠的約。

verses.text_gb: 这是我与以色列人之间永远的[Cra]记号；因为六日之内耶和华造天地，[Crb]第七日便安息舒畅。
verses.text_big5: 這是我與以色列人之間永遠的[Cra]記號；因為六日之內耶和華造天地，[Crb]第七日便安息舒暢。
verses.text_en: It is a sign between Me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days Jehovah made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这是我与以色列人之间永远的记号；因为六日之内耶和华造天地，第七日便安息舒畅。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這是我與以色列人之間永遠的記號；因為六日之內耶和華造天地，第七日便安息舒暢。

refs.text_gb: 我把虹放在云彩中，这就作我与地立约的记号。
refs.text_big5: 我把虹放在雲彩中，這就作我與地立約的記號。
refs.text_en: I set My bow in the clouds, and it shall be for a sign of a covenant between Me and the earth.

refs.text_gb: 神对挪亚说，这就是我与地上一切有血肉之物立约的记号。
refs.text_big5: 神對挪亞說，這就是我與地上一切有血肉之物立約的記號。
refs.text_en: And God said to Noah, This is the sign of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is upon the earth.

refs.text_gb: 你们都要受割礼，这是我与你们立约的记号。
refs.text_big5: 你們都要受割禮，這是我與你們立約的記號。
refs.text_en: And you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin, and it shall be a sign of a covenant between Me and you.

refs.text_gb: 到第七日，神造作的工已经完毕，就在第七日歇了祂一切造作的工，安息了。
refs.text_big5: 到第七日，神造作的工已經完畢，就在第七日歇了祂一切造作的工，安息了。
refs.text_en: And on the seventh day God finished His work which He had done, and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.

refs.text_gb: 因为论到第七日，祂在某处这样说，“到第七日，神就歇了祂一切的工，”
refs.text_big5: 因為論到第七日，祂在某處這樣說，“到第七日，神就歇了祂一切的工，”
refs.text_en: For He has spoken somewhere concerning the seventh day thus, "And God rested on the seventh day from all His works."

verses.text_gb: 耶和华在西乃山和摩西说完了话，就把两块见证的[Fn1]版交给他，是神用指头写的[Cra]石版。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華在西乃山和摩西說完了話，就把兩塊見證的[Fn1]版交給他，是神用指頭寫的[Cra]石版。
verses.text_en: And when He had finished speaking with him upon Mount Sinai, He gave to Moses the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华在西乃山和摩西说完了话，就把两块见证的版交给他，是神用指头写的石版。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華在西乃山和摩西說完了話，就把兩塊見證的版交給他，是神用指頭寫的石版。

footnotes.zh: 在二十1～二三19，神颁布律法及其典章。然后在二四12，神呼召摩西到山顶，好将律法的石版，就是见证的版交给他(见二十1注1)。但神把石版交给摩西以前，先把帐幕的图样给他，并且将祭司体系的事指示他(二五1～三一17)。这指明神虽然颁赐律法给人，但祂晓得人无法遵守律法；因此，祂预备了帐幕、供物和祭司体系的各方面—其实际和应验乃是基督—作为恩典的路，让祂那些堕落、有罪的子民接触祂并享受祂(参来九1～十22)。虽然神颁赐律法，祂却一点也不信靠律法。神所信靠的，从已往直到如今，完全在于基督作神子民恩典的路。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在二十1～二三19，神頒佈律法及其典章。然後在二四12，神呼召摩西到山頂，好將律法的石版，就是見證的版交給他。（見二十1註1。）但神把石版交給摩西以前，先把帳幕的圖樣給他，並且將祭司體系的事指示他。（二五1～三一17。）這指明神雖然頒賜律法給人，但祂曉得人無法遵守律法；因此，祂豫備了帳幕、供物、和祭司體系的各方面—其實際和應驗乃是基督—作為恩典的路，讓祂那些墮落、有罪的子民接觸祂並享受祂。（參來九1～十22。）雖然神頒賜律法，祂卻一點也不信靠律法。神所信靠的，從已往直到如今，完全在於基督作神子民恩典的路。
footnotes.en: 31:18 1 tablets The law and its ordinances were decreed by God in 20:1—23:19. Then, in Exo. 24:12 God called Moses up to the top of the mountain to give him the tablets of the law, the testimony (see note Exo. 20:1 1 ). However, before giving Moses the tablets, God first gave him the design of the tabernacle and instructions concerning the priesthood (25:1—31:17). This indicates that although God was giving the law, He knew that man could not keep it; therefore, He prepared the tabernacle, the offerings, and all the aspects of the priesthood — the reality and fulfillment of which is Christ — as the way of grace for His fallen and sinful people to contact Him and enjoy Him (cf. Heb. 9:1-28; 10:1-22). Although God was giving the law, He did not have any trust in the law. His trust was, and still is, absolutely in Christ as the way of grace for His people. See note Exo. 25:1 1 .

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你上山顶到我这里来，留在这里；我要将石版，版上有我所写的律法和诫命，赐给你，使你可以教导百姓。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你上山頂到我這裏來，留在這裏；我要將石版，版上有我所寫的律法和誡命，賜給你，使你可以教導百姓。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, Come up to Me at the top of the mountain, and be there; and I will give you the tablets of stone with the law and the commandment, which I have inscribed for their instruction.

verses.text_gb: 百姓见摩西迟延不下山，就大家聚集到亚伦那里，对他说，起来，为我们造[Fn1][Cra]神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们从埃及地上来的那人摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了什么事。
verses.text_big5: 百姓見摩西遲延不下山，就大家聚集到亞倫那裏，對他說，起來，為我們造[Fn1][Cra]神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們從埃及地上來的那人摩西，我們不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。
verses.text_en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered against Aaron and said to him, Come, make a god for us who will go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 百姓见摩西迟延不下山，就大家聚集到亚伦那里，对他说，起来，为我们造神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们从埃及地上来的那人摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了什么事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 百姓見摩西遲延不下山，就大家聚集到亞倫那裏，對他說，起來，為我們造神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們從埃及地上來的那人摩西，我們不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。

footnotes.zh: 甚至在律法完全颁布以前，百姓就陷入拜偶像的罪中，至少干犯了律法的头三条诫命(二十2～7)。人以偶像顶替神，就使人无法遵守神的诫命(参罗一18～32与注，约壹五21与注3一段)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 甚至在律法完全頒佈以前，百姓就陷入拜偶像的罪中，至少干犯了律法的頭三條誡命。（二十2～7。）人以偶像頂替神，就使人無法遵守神的誡命。（參羅一18～32與註，約壹五21與註3一段。）
footnotes.en: 32:1 1 god Even before the decree of the law was completed, the people broke at least the first three commandments of the law (Exo. 20:2-7) by falling into the sin of idolatry. Man's replacing of God with idols causes man to be unable to keep God's commandments (cf. Rom. 1:18-32 and notes; 1 John 5:21 and note 1 John 5:21 3 , par. 1).

refs.text_gb: 对亚伦说，“你且为我们造些神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了什么事。”
refs.text_big5: 對亞倫說，“你且為我們造些神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。”
refs.text_en: Saying to Aaron, "Make gods for us who will go before us; for this Moses, who has led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him."

refs.text_gb: 他们对我说，你为我们造神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们从埃及地上来的那人摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了什么事。
refs.text_big5: 他們對我說，你為我們造神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們從埃及地上來的那人摩西，我們不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。
refs.text_en: For they said to me, Make a god for us who will go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.

verses.text_gb: 亚伦对他们说，把你们妻子、儿子、女儿耳上的金[Fn1]环摘下，拿来给我。
verses.text_big5: 亞倫對他們說，把你們妻子、兒子、女兒耳上的金[Fn1]環摘下，拿來給我。
verses.text_en: And Aaron said to them, Tear off the gold rings, which are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚伦对他们说，把你们妻子、儿子、女儿耳上的金环摘下，拿来给我。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞倫對他們說，把你們妻子、兒子、女兒耳上的金環摘下，拿來給我。

footnotes.zh: 百姓戴金耳环是为着妆饰自己。这指明自我妆饰导致拜偶像(参创三五4与注)。不仅如此，耳环的金子是神在以色列人出埃及以前赐给他们(十二35～36)，要用来建造帐幕的(二五3，三五5)。但这金子在用来为着神的定旨以前，就被撒但篡夺，被神的子民用来作成偶像。因此，拜偶像乃是撒但篡夺以及人滥用神为着祂的定旨所赐给的，以致将其糟蹋。
footnotes.zh_big5: 百姓戴金耳環是為著妝飾自己。這指明自我妝飾導致拜偶像。（參創三五4與註。）不僅如此，耳環的金子是神在以色列人出埃及以前賜給他們，（十二35～36，）要用來建造帳幕的。（二五3，三五5。）但這金子在用來為著神的定旨以前，就被撒但篡奪，被神的子民用來作成偶像。因此，拜偶像乃是撒但篡奪以及人濫用神為著祂的定旨所賜給的，以致將其蹧蹋。
footnotes.en: 32:2 1 rings The gold earrings were worn by the people for self-beautification. This indicates that self-beautification leads to idolatry (cf. Gen. 35:4 and note Gen. 35:4 1 ). Furthermore, the gold in the earrings was given to the children of Israel by God before their exodus from Egypt (Exo. 12:35-36) and was to be used for the building of the tabernacle (Exo. 25:3; 35:5). However, before the gold could be used for God's purpose, it was usurped by Satan and used by God's people to make an idol. Hence, idolatry is Satan's usurping and man's abusing of what God has given for His purpose, in order to make it a waste.

verses.text_gb: 众百姓就把他们耳上的金环摘下，拿来给亚伦。
verses.text_big5: 眾百姓就把他們耳上的金環摘下，拿來給亞倫。
verses.text_en: And all the people tore off the golden rings which were in their ears and brought them to Aaron.
verses.text_gb_plain: 众百姓就把他们耳上的金环摘下，拿来给亚伦。
verses.text_big5_plain: 眾百姓就把他們耳上的金環摘下，拿來給亞倫。

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]亚伦从他们手里接过来，铸了一只[Fn2][Cra]牛犊，是用雕刻的工具作成的。他们就说，以色列啊，这是领你从埃及地上来的神。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]亞倫從他們手裏接過來，鑄了一隻[Fn2][Cra]牛犢，是用雕刻的工具作成的。他們就說，以色列阿，這是領你從埃及地上來的神。
verses.text_en: And he took the gold from their hand and fashioned it with an engraving tool and made it into a molten calf; and they said, This is your god, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚伦从他们手里接过来，铸了一只牛犊，是用雕刻的工具作成的。他们就说，以色列啊，这是领你从埃及地上来的神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞倫從他們手裏接過來，鑄了一隻牛犢，是用雕刻的工具作成的。他們就說，以色列阿，這是領你從埃及地上來的神。

footnotes.zh: 金牛犊不是异教偶像，因为是神所设立真正的大祭司亚伦制造的。不仅如此，亚伦造了牛犊，以耶和华为其名，并且以向神献上祭物并敬拜神的方式，带头敬拜偶像(4～6，8)。这样，神所救赎的百姓敬拜以耶和华他们神为名的偶像，并且以神所命定的方式敬拜(参诗一○六19～20，罗一23)。这是在敬拜神之事上的装假和狡诈的掺杂。 按新约里的原则，拜偶像是分裂与淫乱的主要根源。金牛犊偶像在以色列人中间造成分裂(参林前一10～13，十一18～19)。分裂其实就是属灵的淫乱(参启十七1～5)。拜偶像与淫乱总是并行的(民二五1～2，启二20)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 金牛犢不是異教偶像，因為是神所設立真正的大祭司亞倫製造的。不僅如此，亞倫造了牛犢，以耶和華為其名，並且以向神獻上祭物並敬拜神的方式，帶頭敬拜偶像。（4～6，8。）這樣，神所救贖的百姓敬拜以耶和華他們神為名的偶像，並且以神所命定的方式敬拜。（參詩一○六19～20，羅一23。）這是在敬拜神之事上的裝假和狡詐的攙雜。ˍ按新約裏的原則，拜偶像是分裂與淫亂的主要根源。金牛犢偶像在以色列人中間造成分裂。（參林前一10～13，十一18～19。）分裂其實就是屬靈的淫亂。（參啟十七1～5。）拜偶像與淫亂總是並行的。（民二五1～2，啟二20。）
footnotes.en: 32:4 1 he The golden calf was not a pagan idol, for it was made by Aaron, a genuine high priest appointed by God. Furthermore, Aaron made the calf in the name of Jehovah and took the lead to worship the idol in the way of presenting offerings to God and worshipping God (vv. 4-6, 8). Thus, God's redeemed people worshipped an idol in the name of Jehovah their God and in the way ordained by God (cf. Psa. 106:19-20; Rom. 1:23). This was a pretense and a subtle mixture in the worship of God. According to the principles in the New Testament, idolatry is the main source of division and fornication. The golden calf idol caused a division among the children of Israel (cf. 1 Cor. 1:10-13; 11:18-19). Actually, division is spiritual fornication (cf. Rev. 17:1-5). Idolatry and fornication always go together (Num. 25:1-2; Rev. 2:20).

footnotes.zh: 牛犊不是为着劳动，乃是为着给人吃，所以牛犊表征享受(创十八7～8，路十五23)。金牛犊作好以后，百姓在它面前坐下吃喝，起来玩耍(6，18～19上)。这幅图画指明，以色列人敬拜他们所享受的。他们拜金牛犊乃是一种消遣和娱乐，这指明消遣和娱乐就是他们的偶像。
footnotes.zh_big5: 牛犢不是為著勞動，乃是為著給人喫，所以牛犢表徵享受。（創十八7～8，路十五23。）金牛犢作好以後，百姓在它面前坐下喫喝，起來玩耍。（6，18～19上。）這幅圖畫指明，以色列人敬拜他們所享受的。他們拜金牛犢乃是一種消遣和娛樂，這指明消遣和娛樂就是他們的偶像。
footnotes.en: 32:4 2 calf A calf is not for labor but for eating and therefore signifies enjoyment (Gen. 18:7-8; Luke 15:23). After the golden calf was made, the people ate, drank, and rose up to play in front of it (vv. 6, 18-19a). This picture indicates that the children of Israel worshipped what they enjoyed. Their worshipping of the gold calf was an amusement and an entertainment, indicating that amusement and entertainment were their idol.

refs.text_gb: 我看见你们真的得罪了耶和华你们的神，为自己铸了一只牛犊，很快的偏离了耶和华所吩咐你们行的道路，
refs.text_big5: 我看見你們真的得罪了耶和華你們的神，為自己鑄了一隻牛犢，很快的偏離了耶和華所吩咐你們行的道路，
refs.text_en: And I saw that you had indeed sinned against Jehovah your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf; you had turned aside quickly from the way that Jehovah had commanded you.

refs.text_gb: 甚至当他们为自己铸一只牛犊，说，这是你的神，就是那领你从埃及上来的，因而大大亵慢了你；
refs.text_big5: 甚至當他們為自己鑄一隻牛犢，說，這是你的神，就是那領你從埃及上來的，因而大大褻慢了你；
refs.text_en: Indeed when they made for themselves / A molten calf, / And said, This is your God, / Who brought you up out of Egypt, / And showed great contempt;

refs.text_gb: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊，叩拜铸成的像。
refs.text_big5: 他們在何烈山造了牛犢，叩拜鑄成的像。
refs.text_en: They made a calf in Horeb, / And worshipped a molten image.

refs.text_gb: 如此将他们的荣耀，换为吃草之牛的像。
refs.text_big5: 如此將他們的榮耀，換為喫草之牛的像。
refs.text_en: Thus they exchanged their glory / For the image of an ox that eats grass.

refs.text_gb: 他们竟忘了神他们的救主；祂曾在埃及行大事，
refs.text_big5: 他們竟忘了神他們的救主；祂曾在埃及行大事，
refs.text_en: They forgot God their Savior, / Who had done great things in Egypt,

refs.text_gb: 当那些日子，他们造了一个牛犊，又拿祭物献给那偶像，并因自己手中的工作而欢乐。
refs.text_big5: 當那些日子，他們造了一個牛犢，又拿祭物獻給那偶像，並因自己手中的工作而歡樂。
refs.text_en: And they made a calf in those days and brought up a sacrifice to the idol and were glad with the works of their hands.

verses.text_gb: 亚伦看见，就在牛犊面前筑坛，并且宣告说，明日要向耶和华守节。
verses.text_big5: 亞倫看見，就在牛犢面前築壇，並且宣告說，明日要向耶和華守節。
verses.text_en: And when Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; then Aaron made a proclamation and said, Tomorrow shall be a feast to Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚伦看见，就在牛犊面前筑坛，并且宣告说，明日要向耶和华守节。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞倫看見，就在牛犢面前築壇，並且宣告說，明日要向耶和華守節。

verses.text_gb: 次日，百姓清早起来，献上燔祭，并带来平安祭，然后[Cra]坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。
verses.text_big5: 次日，百姓清早起來，獻上燔祭，並帶來平安祭，然後[Cra]坐下喫喝，起來玩耍。
verses.text_en: And they rose up early on the next day and offered burnt offerings and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and drink and rose up to play.
verses.text_gb_plain: 次日，百姓清早起来，献上燔祭，并带来平安祭，然后坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。
verses.text_big5_plain: 次日，百姓清早起來，獻上燔祭，並帶來平安祭，然後坐下喫喝，起來玩耍。

refs.text_gb: 也不要作拜偶像的人，像他们有些人那样；如经上所记：“百姓坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。”
refs.text_big5: 也不要作拜偶像的人，像他們有些人那樣；如經上所記：“百姓坐下喫喝，起來玩耍。”
refs.text_en: Neither become idolaters, as some of them did; as it is written, "The people sat down to eat and drink, and stood up to play."

verses.text_gb: [Cra]耶和华对摩西说，下去吧，因为你的百姓，就是你从埃及地领上来的，已经[Fn1]败坏了。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]耶和華對摩西說，下去罷，因為你的百姓，就是你從埃及地領上來的，已經[Fn1]敗壞了。
verses.text_en: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，下去吧，因为你的百姓，就是你从埃及地领上来的，已经败坏了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，下去罷，因為你的百姓，就是你從埃及地領上來的，已經敗壞了。

footnotes.zh: 我们爱什么过于爱神，那就是偶像，会败坏我们，带进许多罪恶的事物(参罗一18～32)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 我們愛甚麼過於愛神，那就是偶像，會敗壞我們，帶進許多罪惡的事物。（參羅一18～32。）
footnotes.en: 32:7 1 corrupted Whatever we love more than God is an idol that corrupts us, bringing in many sinful things (cf. Rom. 1:18-32).

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对我说，你起来，从这里赶快下去，因为你的百姓，就是你从埃及领出来的，已经败坏了；他们很快就偏离了我所吩咐他们行的道路，为自己造了铸像。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對我說，你起來，從這裏趕快下去，因為你的百姓，就是你從埃及領出來的，已經敗壞了；他們很快就偏離了我所吩咐他們行的道路，為自己造了鑄像。
refs.text_en: Then Jehovah said to me, Arise, go down quickly from here, for your people, whom you have brought out of Egypt, have spoiled themselves; they have turned aside quickly from the way that I commanded them; they have made for themselves a molten image.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华又对我说，我看这百姓真是硬着颈项的百姓。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華又對我說，我看這百姓真是硬著頸項的百姓。
refs.text_en: Then Jehovah spoke to me, saying, I have seen this people, and indeed they are a stiff-necked people.

refs.text_gb: 你且由着我，我要灭绝他们，将他们的名从天下涂抹；我要使你成为比他们更强、人数更多的国。
refs.text_big5: 你且由著我，我要滅絕他們，將他們的名從天下塗抹；我要使你成為比他們更強、人數更多的國。
refs.text_en: Let Me alone that I may destroy them and blot their name out from under heaven, and I will make of you a nation mightier and more numerous than they.

verses.text_gb: 他们很快就偏离了我所吩咐他们行的道路，为自己铸了一只牛犊，向它[Cra]下拜献祭，说，以色列啊，这就是领你从埃及地上来的神。
verses.text_big5: 他們很快就偏離了我所吩咐他們行的道路，為自己鑄了一隻牛犢，向它[Cra]下拜獻祭，說，以色列阿，這就是領你從埃及地上來的神。
verses.text_en: They have quickly turned aside from the way which I commanded them. They have made for themselves a molten calf, and they have worshipped it and have sacrificed to it and said, Theis is your god, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们很快就偏离了我所吩咐他们行的道路，为自己铸了一只牛犊，向它下拜献祭，说，以色列啊，这就是领你从埃及地上来的神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們很快就偏離了我所吩咐他們行的道路，為自己鑄了一隻牛犢，向它下拜獻祭，說，以色列阿，這就是領你從埃及地上來的神。

refs.text_gb: 也不要作拜偶像的人，像他们有些人那样；如经上所记：“百姓坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。”
refs.text_big5: 也不要作拜偶像的人，像他們有些人那樣；如經上所記：“百姓坐下喫喝，起來玩耍。”
refs.text_en: Neither become idolaters, as some of them did; as it is written, "The people sat down to eat and drink, and stood up to play."

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，我看这百姓真是[Cra]硬着颈项的百姓。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，我看這百姓真是[Cra]硬著頸項的百姓。
verses.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, I have seen this people, and indeed they are, a stiff-necked people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，我看这百姓真是硬着颈项的百姓。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，我看這百姓真是硬著頸項的百姓。
