refs.text_gb: 你们要上去，到那流奶与蜜之地；我不在你们中间同你们上去，恐怕我在路上把你们灭绝，因为你们是硬着颈项的百姓。
refs.text_big5: 你們要上去，到那流奶與蜜之地；我不在你們中間同你們上去，恐怕我在路上把你們滅絕，因為你們是硬著頸項的百姓。
refs.text_en: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up in your midst, lest I consume you in the way, for you are a stiff-necked people.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你告诉以色列人，耶和华说，你们是硬着颈项的百姓，我只要片时在你们中间同你们上去，必会灭绝你们。现在你们要把身上的妆饰脱下来，我好知道怎样待你们。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你告訴以色列人，耶和華說，你們是硬著頸項的百姓，我只要片時在你們中間同你們上去，必會滅絕你們。現在你們要把身上的妝飾脫下來，我好知道怎樣待你們。
refs.text_en: Now Jehovah had said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, You are a stiff-necked people; if I were to go up in your midst for one moment, I would consume you. Now therefore put off your ornaments from you, and I will decide what to do to you.

refs.text_gb: 说，主啊，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求主在我们中间和我们同去；虽然他们是硬着颈项的百姓，但求你赦免我们的罪孽和罪恶，以我们为你的产业。
refs.text_big5: 說，主阿，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求主在我們中間和我們同去；雖然他們是硬著頸項的百姓，但求你赦免我們的罪孽和罪惡，以我們為你的產業。
refs.text_en: And he said, If now I have found favor in Your sight, O Lord, let the Lord please go in our midst; although they are a stiff-necked people, pardon our iniquity and our sin and take us for Your inheritance.

refs.text_gb: 所以你当知道，耶和华你神将这美地赐你为业，并不是因你的义；你本是硬着颈项的百姓。
refs.text_big5: 所以你當知道，耶和華你神將這美地賜你為業，並不是因你的義；你本是硬著頸項的百姓。
refs.text_en: Know therefore that it is not because of your righteousness that Jehovah your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.

refs.text_gb: 因为我知道你们是悖逆的，是硬着颈项的。看哪，我今日还活着与你们同在，你们尚且悖逆耶和华，何况在我死后！
refs.text_big5: 因為我知道你們是悖逆的，是硬著頸項的。看哪，我今日還活著與你們同在，你們尚且悖逆耶和華，何況在我死後！
refs.text_en: For I know your rebelliousness and your stiff neck: See, while I am yet here alive with you today, you have been rebelling against Jehovah; so how much more after my death!

refs.text_gb: 现在不要像你们的列祖硬着颈项，只要归顺耶和华，进入祂所永远分别为圣的圣所；又要事奉耶和华你们的神，好使祂的烈怒转离你们。
refs.text_big5: 現在不要像你們的列祖硬著頸項，只要歸順耶和華，進入祂所永遠分別為聖的聖所；又要事奉耶和華你們的神，好使祂的烈怒轉離你們。
refs.text_en: Do not now be stiff-necked, as your fathers were; yield to Jehovah, and come to His sanctuary, which He has sanctified forever, and serve Jehovah your God, that His burning anger may turn away from you.

refs.text_gb: 你们这硬着颈项，心与耳未受割礼的人，时常抗拒圣灵，你们的祖宗怎样，你们也怎样。
refs.text_big5: 你們這硬著頸項，心與耳未受割禮的人，時常抗拒聖靈，你們的祖宗怎樣，你們也怎樣。
refs.text_en: You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in hearts and ears, you always oppose the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, you also do.

refs.text_gb: 因为我素来知道你是顽梗的，你的颈项是铁筋，你的额是铜的；
refs.text_big5: 因為我素來知道你是頑梗的，你的頸項是鐵筋，你的額是銅的；
refs.text_en: Because I knew that you are obstinate, / And your neck is an iron sinew, / And your forehead bronze;

verses.text_gb: 你且由着我，我要向他们发烈怒，将他们灭绝；我要使你成为[Cra]大国。
verses.text_big5: 你且由著我，我要向他們發烈怒，將他們滅絕；我要使你成為[Cra]大國。
verses.text_en: Now therefore let Me be, that My anger may burn against them, and I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你且由着我，我要向他们发烈怒，将他们灭绝；我要使你成为大国。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你且由著我，我要向他們發烈怒，將他們滅絕；我要使你成為大國。

refs.text_gb: 我要用瘟疫击杀他们，使他们不得承受那地；我要使你成为大国，比他们强盛。
refs.text_big5: 我要用瘟疫擊殺他們，使他們不得承受那地；我要使你成為大國，比他們強盛。
refs.text_en: I will strike them with pestilence and dispossess them, and I will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.

verses.text_gb: 摩西[Fn1][Cra]恳求耶和华他的神，说，耶和华啊，你为什么向你的百姓发烈怒？这百姓是你用大力并大能的手，从埃及地领出来的。
verses.text_big5: 摩西[Fn1][Cra]懇求耶和華他的神，說，耶和華阿，你為甚麼向你的百姓發烈怒？這百姓是你用大力並大能的手，從埃及地領出來的。
verses.text_en: And Moses entreated Jehovah his God and said, Jehovah, why does Your anger burn against Your people, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西恳求耶和华他的神，说，耶和华啊，你为什么向你的百姓发烈怒？这百姓是你用大力并大能的手，从埃及地领出来的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西懇求耶和華他的神，說，耶和華阿，你為甚麼向你的百姓發烈怒？這百姓是你用大力並大能的手，從埃及地領出來的。

footnotes.zh: 直译，使耶和华的脸甜美或愉悦。摩西为以色列人所作的恳求，顾到神的名，并站在神守约的信实上(11～13)，使神脸上的表情，从忿怒变为愉悦。于是神后悔，不将祂的百姓灭绝(14)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，使耶和華的臉甜美或愉悅。摩西為以色列人所作的懇求，顧到神的名，並站在神守約的信實上，（11～13，）使神臉上的表情，從忿怒變為愉悅。於是神後悔，不將祂的百姓滅絕。（14。）
footnotes.en: 32:11 1 entreated Lit., made Jehovah's face sweet, or pleasant. Moses' entreaty on behalf of the children of Israel, which took care of God's name and stood on God's faithfulness to keep His covenant (vv. 11-13), changed the expression on God's face from one of anger to one of pleasantness. Thus, God repented and did not consume His people (v. 14).

refs.text_gb: 所以祂说要灭绝他们；若非有祂所拣选的摩西站在祂面前，堵住破口，使祂的忿怒转消，不灭绝他们，他们早已灭亡了。
refs.text_big5: 所以祂說要滅絕他們；若非有祂所揀選的摩西站在祂面前，堵住破口，使祂的忿怒轉消，不滅絕他們，他們早已滅亡了。
refs.text_en: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, / And would have, had not Moses His chosen one / Stood in the breach before Him / To turn away His wrath from destroying them.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]为什么使埃及人议论说，祂领他们出去，是要降祸与他们，把他们杀在山中，将他们从地面上除灭？求你转意，不发你的烈怒，后悔，不降祸与你的百姓。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]為甚麼使埃及人議論說，祂領他們出去，是要降禍與他們，把他們殺在山中，將他們從地面上除滅？求你轉意，不發你的烈怒，後悔，不降禍與你的百姓。
verses.text_en: Why should the Egyptians speak, saying, With evil intent He brought them out, to slay them in the mountains and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from Your burning anger, and repent of this evil against Your people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 为什么使埃及人议论说，祂领他们出去，是要降祸与他们，把他们杀在山中，将他们从地面上除灭？求你转意，不发你的烈怒，后悔，不降祸与你的百姓。
verses.text_big5_plain: 為甚麼使埃及人議論說，祂領他們出去，是要降禍與他們，把他們殺在山中，將他們從地面上除滅？求你轉意，不發你的烈怒，後悔，不降禍與你的百姓。

refs.text_gb: 摩西对耶和华说，这样，埃及人必听见这事；因为你曾用大能，将这百姓从他们中间领上来。
refs.text_big5: 摩西對耶和華說，這樣，埃及人必聽見這事；因為你曾用大能，將這百姓從他們中間領上來。
refs.text_en: But Moses said to Jehovah, Then the Egyptians will hear of it, for by Your might You brought this people up from their midst,

refs.text_gb: 埃及人必将这事告诉这地的居民；他们已经听见，你耶和华是在这百姓中间；因为耶和华啊，你面对面被人看见，你的云彩停在他们以上；你日间在云柱中，夜间在火柱中，在他们前面行。
refs.text_big5: 埃及人必將這事告訴這地的居民；他們已經聽見，你耶和華是在這百姓中間；因為耶和華阿，你面對面被人看見，你的雲彩停在他們以上；你日間在雲柱中，夜間在火柱中，在他們前面行。
refs.text_en: And they will tell the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that You, Jehovah, are in the midst of this people; for You, O Jehovah, are seen in plain sight, and Your cloud stands over them, and You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.

refs.text_gb: 如今你若把这百姓杀了，如杀一人，那些听见你名声的列国必议论说，
refs.text_big5: 如今你若把這百姓殺了，如殺一人，那些聽見你名聲的列國必議論說，
refs.text_en: Now if You put this people to death as one man, then the nations that have heard the report about You will speak, saying,

refs.text_gb: 耶和华因为不能把这百姓领进祂起誓要赐给他们之地，所以在旷野把他们杀了。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華因為不能把這百姓領進祂起誓要賜給他們之地，所以在曠野把他們殺了。
refs.text_en: Because Jehovah was not able to bring this people into the land which He swore to give them, He has therefore slaughtered them in the wilderness.

refs.text_gb: 免得你领我们出来的那地之人说，耶和华因为不能把这百姓领进祂所应许之地，又因恨他们，所以领他们出去，要在旷野杀他们。
refs.text_big5: 免得你領我們出來的那地之人說，耶和華因為不能把這百姓領進祂所應許之地，又因恨他們，所以領他們出去，要在曠野殺他們。
refs.text_en: Lest the inhabitants of the land from which You have brought us out say, Because Jehovah was not able to bring them into the land which He promised them and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.

refs.text_gb: 其实他们是你的百姓，你的产业，是你用大能和伸出来的膀臂领出来的。
refs.text_big5: 其實他們是你的百姓，你的產業，是你用大能和伸出來的膀臂領出來的。
refs.text_en: But they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You have brought out with Your great strength and with Your outstretched arm.

verses.text_gb: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列，你曾指着自己向他们起誓说，我要使你们的后裔繁增，如同天上的星那样多，并且我要把所应许的这全地，赐给你们的[Cra]后裔，他们要永远承受为业。
verses.text_big5: 求你記念你的僕人亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列，你曾指著自己向他們起誓說，我要使你們的後裔繁增，如同天上的星那樣多，並且我要把所應許的這全地，賜給你們的[Cra]後裔，他們要永遠承受為業。
verses.text_en: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Your servants, to whom You swore by Yourself and said to them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your seed, and they shall inherit it forever.
verses.text_gb_plain: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列，你曾指着自己向他们起誓说，我要使你们的后裔繁增，如同天上的星那样多，并且我要把所应许的这全地，赐给你们的后裔，他们要永远承受为业。
verses.text_big5_plain: 求你記念你的僕人亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列，你曾指著自己向他們起誓說，我要使你們的後裔繁增，如同天上的星那樣多，並且我要把所應許的這全地，賜給你們的後裔，他們要永遠承受為業。

refs.text_gb: 耶和华向亚伯兰显现，说，我要把这地赐给你的后裔。亚伯兰就在那里为向他显现的耶和华筑了一座坛。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華向亞伯蘭顯現，說，我要把這地賜給你的後裔。亞伯蘭就在那裏為向他顯現的耶和華築了一座壇。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah appeared to Abram and said, To your seed I will give this land. And there he built an altar to Jehovah who had appeared to him.

verses.text_gb: 于是耶和华后悔，不把所说的祸降与祂的百姓。
verses.text_big5: 於是耶和華後悔，不把所說的禍降與祂的百姓。
verses.text_en: Thus Jehovah repented of the ill which He said He would do to His people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是耶和华后悔，不把所说的祸降与祂的百姓。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是耶和華後悔，不把所說的禍降與祂的百姓。

verses.text_gb: [Cra]摩西转身下山，手里拿着两块见证的版；版是两面写的，这面那面都有字。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]摩西轉身下山，手裏拿著兩塊見證的版；版是兩面寫的，這面那面都有字。
verses.text_en: Then Moses turned and went down from the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hand, tablets that were written on both of their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西转身下山，手里拿着两块见证的版；版是两面写的，这面那面都有字。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西轉身下山，手裏拿著兩塊見證的版；版是兩面寫的，這面那面都有字。

refs.text_gb: 于是我转身下山，山被火烧着，两块约版在我两手之中。
refs.text_big5: 於是我轉身下山，山被火燒著，兩塊約版在我兩手之中。
refs.text_en: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire, and the two Tablets of the Covenant were in my two hands.

refs.text_gb: 我看见你们真的得罪了耶和华你们的神，为自己铸了一只牛犊，很快的偏离了耶和华所吩咐你们行的道路，
refs.text_big5: 我看見你們真的得罪了耶和華你們的神，為自己鑄了一隻牛犢，很快的偏離了耶和華所吩咐你們行的道路，
refs.text_en: And I saw that you had indeed sinned against Jehovah your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf; you had turned aside quickly from the way that Jehovah had commanded you.

refs.text_gb: 我就握着那两块版，从我两手中扔出去，在你们眼前摔碎了。
refs.text_big5: 我就握著那兩塊版，從我兩手中扔出去，在你們眼前摔碎了。
refs.text_en: And I took hold of the two tablets and cast them out of my two hands and shattered them before your eyes.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]版是神作的；字是神写的，刻在版上。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]版是神作的；字是神寫的，刻在版上。
verses.text_en: And the tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved upon the tablets.
verses.text_gb_plain: 版是神作的；字是神写的，刻在版上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 版是神作的；字是神寫的，刻在版上。

refs.text_gb: 耶和华在西乃山和摩西说完了话，就把两块见证的版交给他，是神用指头写的石版。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華在西乃山和摩西說完了話，就把兩塊見證的版交給他，是神用指頭寫的石版。
refs.text_en: And when He had finished speaking with him upon Mount Sinai, He gave to Moses the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.

verses.text_gb: 约书亚听见百姓呼喊的声音，就对摩西说，在营里有争战的声音。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞聽見百姓呼喊的聲音，就對摩西說，在營裏有爭戰的聲音。
verses.text_en: And when Joshua heard the sound of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, There is a sound of war in the camp.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚听见百姓呼喊的声音，就对摩西说，在营里有争战的声音。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞聽見百姓呼喊的聲音，就對摩西說，在營裏有爭戰的聲音。

verses.text_gb: 但摩西说，这不是打胜仗呼喊的声音；也不是打败仗呼喊的声音；我所听见的，乃是歌唱的声音。
verses.text_big5: 但摩西說，這不是打勝仗呼喊的聲音；也不是打敗仗呼喊的聲音；我所聽見的，乃是歌唱的聲音。
verses.text_en: But Moses said, It is not the sound of the cry of triumph, / Neither is it the sound of the cry of defeat; / But it is the sound of singing that I hear.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但摩西说，这不是打胜仗呼喊的声音；也不是打败仗呼喊的声音；我所听见的，乃是歌唱的声音。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但摩西說，這不是打勝仗呼喊的聲音；也不是打敗仗呼喊的聲音；我所聽見的，乃是歌唱的聲音。

verses.text_gb: 摩西走近营前，就看见那[Cra]牛犊，又看见人跳舞，便发烈怒，把两块版从手中扔出，在山下[Fn1]摔碎了。
verses.text_big5: 摩西走近營前，就看見那[Cra]牛犢，又看見人跳舞，便發烈怒，把兩塊版從手中扔出，在山下[Fn1]摔碎了。
verses.text_en: And as soon as he drew near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing; and Moses' anger burned, and he threw the tablets out of his hands and shattered them at the foot of the mountain.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西走近营前，就看见那牛犊，又看见人跳舞，便发烈怒，把两块版从手中扔出，在山下摔碎了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西走近營前，就看見那牛犢，又看見人跳舞，便發烈怒，把兩塊版從手中扔出，在山下摔碎了。

footnotes.zh: 见证的版(15)被摔碎，指明以色列人在领受律法以前，已经干犯了律法和律法的约。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見證的版（15）被摔碎，指明以色列人在領受律法以前，已經干犯了律法和律法的約。
footnotes.en: 32:19 1 shattered The shattering of the tablets of the testimony (v. 15) indicates that before the children of Israel had received the law, they had already broken the law and the covenant of the law.

refs.text_gb: 也不要作拜偶像的人，像他们有些人那样；如经上所记：“百姓坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。”
refs.text_big5: 也不要作拜偶像的人，像他們有些人那樣；如經上所記：“百姓坐下喫喝，起來玩耍。”
refs.text_en: Neither become idolaters, as some of them did; as it is written, "The people sat down to eat and drink, and stood up to play."

verses.text_gb: [Cra]又将他们所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人[Fn1]喝。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]又將他們所鑄的牛犢用火焚燒，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人[Fn1]喝。
verses.text_en: And he took the calf which they had made, and he burned it with fire and ground it to powder and scattered it upon the water and made the children of Israel drink it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又将他们所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。
verses.text_big5_plain: 又將他們所鑄的牛犢用火焚燒，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。

footnotes.zh: 拜偶像的人，至终必须‘喝’他们所拜的偶像(参罗一23～25，加六7～8上)。这是从神来的惩罚。
footnotes.zh_big5: 拜偶像的人，至終必須“喝”他們所拜的偶像。（參羅一23～25，加六7～8上。）這是從神來的懲罰。
footnotes.en: 32:20 1 drink Those who worship an idol must eventually “drink” the very idol they worship (cf. Rom. 1:23-25; Gal. 6:7-8a). This is a punishment from God.

refs.text_gb: 我把你们犯罪所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，又捣碎磨得极细，以致细如灰尘；我就把这灰尘撒在从山上流下来的溪水中。
refs.text_big5: 我把你們犯罪所鑄的牛犢用火焚燒，又搗碎磨得極細，以致細如灰塵；我就把這灰塵撒在從山上流下來的溪水中。
refs.text_en: Then I took your sin that you had made, the calf, and I burned it with fire and crushed it, grinding it thoroughly until it was as fine as dust; and I cast the dust of it into the brook that came down from the mountain.

verses.text_gb: 摩西对亚伦说，这百姓向你作了什么，你竟使他们陷在这样大的罪里？
verses.text_big5: 摩西對亞倫說，這百姓向你作了甚麼，你竟使他們陷在這樣大的罪裏？
verses.text_en: And Moses said to Aaron, What did this people do to you that you brought so great a sin upon them?
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西对亚伦说，这百姓向你作了什么，你竟使他们陷在这样大的罪里？
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西對亞倫說，這百姓向你作了甚麼，你竟使他們陷在這樣大的罪裏？

verses.text_gb: 亚伦说，求我主不要发烈怒。这百姓专于作恶，是你知道的。
verses.text_big5: 亞倫說，求我主不要發烈怒。這百姓專於作惡，是你知道的。
verses.text_en: And Aaron said, Do not let the anger of my lord burn. You know the people, that they are set on evil;
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚伦说，求我主不要发烈怒。这百姓专于作恶，是你知道的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞倫說，求我主不要發烈怒。這百姓專於作惡，是你知道的。

verses.text_gb: 他们对我说，[Cra]你为我们造神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们从埃及地上来的那人摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了什么事。
verses.text_big5: 他們對我說，[Cra]你為我們造神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們從埃及地上來的那人摩西，我們不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。
verses.text_en: For they said to me, Make a god for us who will go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们对我说，你为我们造神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们从埃及地上来的那人摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了什么事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們對我說，你為我們造神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們從埃及地上來的那人摩西，我們不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。

refs.text_gb: 百姓见摩西迟延不下山，就大家聚集到亚伦那里，对他说，起来，为我们造神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们从埃及地上来的那人摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了什么事。
refs.text_big5: 百姓見摩西遲延不下山，就大家聚集到亞倫那裏，對他說，起來，為我們造神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們從埃及地上來的那人摩西，我們不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。
refs.text_en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered against Aaron and said to him, Come, make a god for us who will go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.

refs.text_gb: 对亚伦说，“你且为我们造些神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了什么事。”
refs.text_big5: 對亞倫說，“你且為我們造些神像，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。”
refs.text_en: Saying to Aaron, "Make gods for us who will go before us; for this Moses, who has led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him."

verses.text_gb: [Cra]所以我对他们说，凡有金环的，可以摘下来，他们就给了我。我把金环扔在火中，这牛犊便出来了。

verses.text_en: So I said to them, Whoever has any gold, let them tear it off; so they gave it to me, and I threw it into the fire, and this calf came out.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以我对他们说，凡有金环的，可以摘下来，他们就给了我。我把金环扔在火中，这牛犊便出来了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以我對他們說，凡有金環的，可以摘下來，他們就給了我。我把金環扔在火中，這牛犢便出來了。

refs.text_gb: 亚伦对他们说，把你们妻子、儿子、女儿耳上的金环摘下，拿来给我。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫對他們說，把你們妻子、兒子、女兒耳上的金環摘下，拿來給我。
refs.text_en: And Aaron said to them, Tear off the gold rings, which are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me.

refs.text_gb: 众百姓就把他们耳上的金环摘下，拿来给亚伦。
refs.text_big5: 眾百姓就把他們耳上的金環摘下，拿來給亞倫。
refs.text_en: And all the people tore off the golden rings which were in their ears and brought them to Aaron.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦从他们手里接过来，铸了一只牛犊，是用雕刻的工具作成的。他们就说，以色列啊，这是领你从埃及地上来的神。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫從他們手裏接過來，鑄了一隻牛犢，是用雕刻的工具作成的。他們就說，以色列阿，這是領你從埃及地上來的神。
refs.text_en: And he took the gold from their hand and fashioned it with an engraving tool and made it into a molten calf; and they said, This is your god, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!

verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西见百姓放肆，（因为亚伦纵容他们，使他们在仇敌中间被讥刺，）
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西見百姓放肆，（因為亞倫縱容他們，使他們在仇敵中間被譏刺，）

verses.text_big5_plain: 就站在營門中，說，凡屬耶和華的，都到我這裏來！於是利未的子孫，都到他那裏聚集。

refs.text_en: And concerning Levi he said, May Your Thummim and Urim be with Your faithful man, / Whom You tested at Massah, / With whom You contended at the waters of Meribah -

refs.text_big5: 他論自己的父母說，我沒有看見；他不承認自己的弟兄，也不認識自己的兒女；這是因利未人謹守你的話，護衛你的約。
refs.text_en: He who said of his father and mother, / I do not regard him; / And his brothers he did not acknowledge, / And his children he did not recognize; / For they have kept Your speaking / And have guarded Your covenant.

refs.text_gb: 他们要将你的典章指教雅各，将你的律法指教以色列；他们要把香焚在你面前，把全牲的燔祭献在你的坛上。
refs.text_big5: 他們要將你的典章指教雅各，將你的律法指教以色列；他們要把香焚在你面前，把全牲的燔祭獻在你的壇上。
refs.text_en: They shall show Jacob Your ordinances, / And Israel Your law; / They shall put incense before Your nostrils / And whole burnt offerings upon Your altar.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华啊，求你赐福给他的能力，悦纳他手中的工作；那些起来攻击他和恨恶他的人，愿你刺透他们的腰，使他们不得再起来。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華阿，求你賜福給他的能力，悅納他手中的工作；那些起來攻擊他和恨惡他的人，願你刺透他們的腰，使他們不得再起來。
refs.text_en: Bless, O Jehovah, his might, / And the work of his hands accept; / Wound thoroughly the loins of those who rise up against him / And of those who hate him, that they may not rise up again.

verses.text_gb: 他对他们说，耶和华以色列的神这样说，你们各人把刀佩在[Fn1]腰间，在营中往来，从这门到那门，各人杀自己的[Fn2]弟兄、同伴和邻舍。
verses.text_big5: 他對他們說，耶和華以色列的神這樣說，你們各人把刀佩在[Fn1]腰間，在營中往來，從這門到那門，各人殺自己的[Fn2]弟兄、同伴和鄰舍。
verses.text_en: And he said to them, Thus says Jehovah the God of Israel, Let each man put his sword upon his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and each man kill his brother, and each man his companion, and each man his neighbor.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他对他们说，耶和华以色列的神这样说，你们各人把刀佩在腰间，在营中往来，从这门到那门，各人杀自己的弟兄、同伴和邻舍。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他對他們說，耶和華以色列的神這樣說，你們各人把刀佩在腰間，在營中往來，從這門到那門，各人殺自己的弟兄、同伴和鄰舍。

footnotes.en: 32:27 1 brother The Levites denied even their closest relationships with those who had worshipped the golden calf. The killing of the idol worshippers separated the sons of Levi from their brothers and qualified them to have the priesthood with the Urim and the Thummim (Deut. 33:8-10). God intended that the entire nation of Israel would be a kingdom of priests (Exo. 19:6), but because of the worship of the golden calf, the majority of the children of Israel lost the priesthood. The priesthood was given to a single tribe, the tribe of Levi. God's intention is that every believer in Christ, every child of God, would be a priest (Rev. 1:6; 5:10). However, through the centuries impure worship has caused the majority of the believers to lose their priesthood. The relatives of the Levites signify ourselves, that part of our being which participates in the worship of idols. If we “kill” these impure worshippers, we will be the overcomers who keep the priesthood; otherwise, we will be counted among those who have lost the priesthood.

footnotes.zh: 利未人甚至否认了与那些拜金牛犊之人最亲密的关系。杀死拜偶像的人，就把利未人从他们的弟兄们分别出来，使他们有资格得着祭司职分连同乌陵和土明(申三三8～10)。神的心意是要以色列全国成为祭司的国度(十九6)，但因着拜金牛犊，大部分以色列人失去了祭司职分。祭司职分就赐给一个支派，就是利未支派。 神的心意是要在基督里的每一个信徒，神的每一个儿女，都作祭司(启一6，五10)。然而，历世纪以来，不纯洁的敬拜使大部分信徒失去了祭司职分。利未人的亲戚表征我们自己，也就是我们这人有分于拜偶像的那一部分。我们若‘杀死’这些不纯洁的敬拜者，就会成为守住祭司职分的得胜者；否则我们就要被算在那些失去祭司职分的人中间。

footnotes.zh: 要解决以色列人拜金牛犊造成的严重问题，神在祂和百姓中间需要一位中保。摩西是个与双方都有亲密关系的人，是惟一有资格作这样中保的人。摩西是神的同伴(三三11与注1)，与神有亲密的关系，知道神心中所存的是什么。他尤其知道神不会放弃祂对以色列人的定旨。因此，他能亲密的对神说到祂的百姓，并为他们使神得以平息。
footnotes.zh_big5: 要解決以色列人拜金牛犢造成的嚴重問題，神在祂和百姓中間需要一位中保。摩西是個與雙方都有親密關係的人，是惟一有資格作這樣中保的人。摩西是神的同伴，（三三11與註1，）與神有親密的關係，知道神心中所存的是甚麼。他尤其知道神不會放棄祂對以色列人的定旨。因此，他能親密的對神說到祂的百姓，並為他們使神得以平息。
footnotes.en: 32:30 1 expiation In order to solve the serious problem caused by the worshipping of the golden calf by the children of Israel, God needed a mediator between Him and the people. Moses, a man who was intimately involved with both parties, was uniquely qualified to be such a mediator. As a companion of God (Exo. 33:11 and note Exo. 33:11 1 ), Moses had an intimate relationship with God and knew what was in God's heart. In particular, he knew that God would not give up His purpose with the children of Israel. Thus, he could speak to God intimately concerning His people and appease God on their behalf.

refs.text_en: Then I threw myself down before Jehovah as at the beginning, forty days and forty nights; I did not eat food nor drink water, because of all your sin which you had sinned by doing that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah so as to anger Him.

refs.text_en: And the Angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them and stood behind them.

refs.text_gb: 现在你去领这百姓，往我所告诉你的地方去，我的使者必在你前面引路；只是到我追讨的日子，我必追讨他们的罪。
refs.text_big5: 現在你去領這百姓，往我所告訴你的地方去，我的使者必在你前面引路；只是到我追討的日子，我必追討他們的罪。
refs.text_en: And now go, lead the people to the place about which I have spoken to you. Now My Angel will go before you; nevertheless in the day when I visit, I will visit their sin upon them.

refs.text_gb: 这摩西，就是他们曾弃绝说，谁立你作首领和审判官的，神却借着那在荆棘中向他显现之使者的手，差派他作首领，作救赎者。
refs.text_big5: 這摩西，就是他們曾棄絕說，誰立你作首領和審判官的，神卻藉著那在荊棘中向他顯現之使者的手，差派他作首領，作救贖者。
refs.text_en: This Moses, whom they refused, saying, Who appointed you a ruler and a judge? this one God has sent as both a ruler and a redeemer, along with the hand of the Angel who appeared to him in the thornbush.

verses.text_gb: 你们要上去，到那流[Cra]奶与蜜之地；我不在你们中间同你们上去，恐怕我在路上把你们灭绝，因为你们是[Crb]硬着颈项的百姓。
verses.text_big5: 你們要上去，到那流[Cra]奶與蜜之地；我不在你們中間同你們上去，恐怕我在路上把你們滅絕，因為你們是[Crb]硬著頸項的百姓。
verses.text_en: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up in your midst, lest I consume you in the way, for you are a stiff-necked people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要上去，到那流奶与蜜之地；我不在你们中间同你们上去，恐怕我在路上把你们灭绝，因为你们是硬着颈项的百姓。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要上去，到那流奶與蜜之地；我不在你們中間同你們上去，恐怕我在路上把你們滅絕，因為你們是硬著頸項的百姓。

refs.text_gb: 我下来要救他们脱离埃及人的手，领他们从那地出来，上到美好、宽阔、流奶与蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地方。
refs.text_big5: 我下來要救他們脫離埃及人的手，領他們從那地出來，上到美好、寬闊、流奶與蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地方。
refs.text_en: And I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，我看这百姓真是硬着颈项的百姓。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，我看這百姓真是硬著頸項的百姓。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, I have seen this people, and indeed they are, a stiff-necked people.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你告诉以色列人，耶和华说，你们是硬着颈项的百姓，我只要片时在你们中间同你们上去，必会灭绝你们。现在你们要把身上的妆饰脱下来，我好知道怎样待你们。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你告訴以色列人，耶和華說，你們是硬著頸項的百姓，我只要片時在你們中間同你們上去，必會滅絕你們。現在你們要把身上的妝飾脫下來，我好知道怎樣待你們。
refs.text_en: Now Jehovah had said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, You are a stiff-necked people; if I were to go up in your midst for one moment, I would consume you. Now therefore put off your ornaments from you, and I will decide what to do to you.

refs.text_gb: 你们这硬着颈项，心与耳未受割礼的人，时常抗拒圣灵，你们的祖宗怎样，你们也怎样。
refs.text_big5: 你們這硬著頸項，心與耳未受割禮的人，時常抗拒聖靈，你們的祖宗怎樣，你們也怎樣。
refs.text_en: You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in hearts and ears, you always oppose the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, you also do.

verses.text_gb: 百姓听见这凶信，就悲哀，也没有人佩戴妆饰。
verses.text_big5: 百姓聽見這兇信，就悲哀，也沒有人佩戴妝飾。
verses.text_en: And when the people heard this evil word, they mourned, and no one put on his ornaments.
verses.text_gb_plain: 百姓听见这凶信，就悲哀，也没有人佩戴妆饰。
verses.text_big5_plain: 百姓聽見這兇信，就悲哀，也沒有人佩戴妝飾。

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你告诉以色列人，耶和华说，你们是硬着颈项的百姓，我只要片时在你们中间同你们上去，必会灭绝你们。现在你们要把身上的妆饰脱下来，我好知道怎样待你们。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你告訴以色列人，耶和華說，你們是硬著頸項的百姓，我只要片時在你們中間同你們上去，必會滅絕你們。現在你們要把身上的妝飾脫下來，我好知道怎樣待你們。
verses.text_en: Now Jehovah had said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, You are a stiff-necked people; if I were to go up in your midst for one moment, I would consume you. Now therefore put off your ornaments from you, and I will decide what to do to you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，你告诉以色列人，耶和华说，你们是硬着颈项的百姓，我只要片时在你们中间同你们上去，必会灭绝你们。现在你们要把身上的妆饰脱下来，我好知道怎样待你们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，你告訴以色列人，耶和華說，你們是硬著頸項的百姓，我只要片時在你們中間同你們上去，必會滅絕你們。現在你們要把身上的妝飾脫下來，我好知道怎樣待你們。

verses.text_gb: 因此，以色列人从住何烈山以后，就把身上的[Fn1]妆饰摘除干净。
verses.text_big5: 因此，以色列人從住何烈山以後，就把身上的[Fn1]妝飾摘除乾淨。
verses.text_en: Thus the children of Israel were stripped of their ornaments from Mount Horeb onward.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因此，以色列人从住何烈山以后，就把身上的妆饰摘除干净。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因此，以色列人從住何烈山以後，就把身上的妝飾摘除乾淨。

footnotes.zh: 摩西在神和以色列人之间作中保的结果，乃是使神的怒气平息，百姓也悔改，并且放弃自我妆饰(见三二2注1，参创三五1～4)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 摩西在神和以色列人之間作中保的結果，乃是使神的怒氣平息，百姓也悔改，並且放棄自我妝飾。（見三二2註1，參創三五1～4。）
footnotes.en: 33:6 1 ornaments As a result of Moses' work as a mediator between God and the children of Israel, God's anger was appeased, and the people repented and gave up their self-beautification (see note Exo. 32:2 1 ; cf. Gen. 35:1-4).

verses.text_gb: 摩西将帐棚支搭在[Fn1][Cra]营外，离营一段距离，他称这帐棚为[Crb]会幕。凡求问耶和华的，就出到营外的会幕那里去。
verses.text_big5: 摩西將帳棚支搭在[Fn1][Cra]營外，離營一段距離，他稱這帳棚為[Crb]會幕。凡求問耶和華的，就出到營外的會幕那裏去。
verses.text_en: Now Moses would take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, some distance from the camp; and he called it the tent of meeting. And everyone who sought Jehovah went out to the tent of meeting, which was outside the camp.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西将帐棚支搭在营外，离营一段距离，他称这帐棚为会幕。凡求问耶和华的，就出到营外的会幕那里去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西將帳棚支搭在營外，離營一段距離，他稱這帳棚為會幕。凡求問耶和華的，就出到營外的會幕那裏去。

footnotes.zh: 摩西懂得神的心，知道他或神都不能留在百姓中间，因为营已经成为拜偶像的了。因此，他将帐棚迁到营外。这帐棚成了会幕，在此神能与寻求祂的百姓相会，对他们说话。这是个预表，应验于来十三12～13(见该处注)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 摩西懂得神的心，知道他或神都不能留在百姓中間，因為營已經成為拜偶像的了。因此，他將帳棚遷到營外。這帳棚成了會幕，在此神能與尋求祂的百姓相會，對他們說話。這是個豫表，應驗於來十三12～13。（見來十三12～13註。）
footnotes.en: 33:7 1 outside Knowing the heart of God, Moses realized that neither he nor God could remain among the people, for the camp had become idolatrous. Hence, he moved his tent outside the camp. This tent became the tent of meeting, where God could meet with His seeking people and speak to them. This was a type fulfilled in Heb. 13:12-13 (see notes there).

refs.text_gb: 这样，我们也当出到营外就了祂去，忍受祂所受的凌辱。
refs.text_big5: 這樣，我們也當出到營外就了祂去，忍受祂所受的凌辱。
refs.text_en: Let us therefore go forth unto Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach.

refs.text_gb: 就是会幕、见证的柜和其上的遮罪盖、会幕的一切器具，
refs.text_big5: 就是會幕、見證的櫃和其上的遮罪蓋、會幕的一切器具，
refs.text_en: The Tent of Meeting, and the Ark of the Testimony and the expiation cover that is on it, and all the utensils of the tent,

refs.text_gb: 他们中间，凡心里有智慧作工的，用十幅幕幔作帐幕；这些幕幔是比撒列用捻的细麻，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线制造的，并用巧匠的手工，绣上基路伯。
refs.text_big5: 他們中間，凡心裏有智慧作工的，用十幅幕幔作帳幕；這些幕幔是比撒列用撚的細麻，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線製造的，並用巧匠的手工，繡上基路伯。
refs.text_en: And all the wise in heart among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains, of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet strands, with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman. Bezalel made them.

refs.text_gb: 每幅幕幔长二十八肘，宽四肘，幕幔都是一样的尺寸。
refs.text_big5: 每幅幕幔長二十八肘，寬四肘，幕幔都是一樣的尺寸。
refs.text_en: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain, four cubits; all the curtains had the same measurement.

refs.text_gb: 他使五幅幕幔幅幅相连，又使另五幅幕幔幅幅相连。
refs.text_big5: 他使五幅幕幔幅幅相連，又使另五幅幕幔幅幅相連。
refs.text_en: And he joined five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he joined to one another.

refs.text_gb: 在这相连幕幔的末幅边缘，作蓝色的钮眼；在那相连幕幔的末幅边缘内，也照样作。
refs.text_big5: 在這相連幕幔的末幅邊緣，作藍色的鈕眼；在那相連幕幔的末幅邊緣內，也照樣作。
refs.text_en: And he made loops of blue strands upon the edge of the one curtain at the end in the set; likewise he made them in the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.

refs.text_gb: 在这相连的幕幔上，作五十个钮眼；在那相连幕幔的边缘，也作五十个钮眼，都是两两相对。
refs.text_big5: 在這相連的幕幔上，作五十個鈕眼；在那相連幕幔的邊緣，也作五十個鈕眼，都是兩兩相對。
refs.text_en: He made fifty loops on the one curtain, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was in the second set; the loops were opposite one another.

refs.text_gb: 又作五十个金扣钩，用扣钩使幕幔彼此相连，成为一整个帐幕。
refs.text_big5: 又作五十個金扣鉤，用扣鉤使幕幔彼此相連，成為一整個帳幕。
refs.text_en: And he made fifty clasps of gold and joined the curtains to one another with the clasps; so the tabernacle became one.

refs.text_gb: 他用山羊毛织十一幅幕幔，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。
refs.text_big5: 他用山羊毛織十一幅幕幔，作為帳幕以上的罩棚。
refs.text_en: And he made curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains he made in all.

refs.text_gb: 每幅幕幔长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幕幔都是一样的尺寸。
refs.text_big5: 每幅幕幔長三十肘，寬四肘；十一幅幕幔都是一樣的尺寸。
refs.text_en: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain, four cubits; the eleven curtains had the same measurement.

refs.text_gb: 他把五幅幕幔连成一幅，又把六幅幕幔连成一幅。
refs.text_big5: 他把五幅幕幔連成一幅，又把六幅幕幔連成一幅。
refs.text_en: And he joined five of the curtains by themselves, and six of the curtains by themselves.

refs.text_gb: 在这相连幕幔的末幅边缘，作五十个钮眼；在那相连幕幔的末幅边缘，也作五十个钮眼。
refs.text_big5: 在這相連幕幔的末幅邊緣，作五十個鈕眼；在那相連幕幔的末幅邊緣，也作五十個鈕眼。
refs.text_en: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the set, and fifty loops he made upon the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second set.

refs.text_gb: 又作五十个铜扣钩，使罩棚连成一整个。
refs.text_big5: 又作五十個銅扣鉤，使罩棚連成一整個。
refs.text_en: And he made fifty clasps of bronze to join the tent together, that it might become one.

refs.text_gb: 并用染红的公羊皮作罩棚的盖；再用海狗皮作罩棚上的顶盖。
refs.text_big5: 並用染紅的公羊皮作罩棚的蓋；再用海狗皮作罩棚上的頂蓋。
refs.text_en: And he made a covering for the tent, of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of porpoise skins above it.

refs.text_gb: 他用皂荚木作帐幕的竖板。
refs.text_big5: 他用皂莢木作帳幕的豎板。
refs.text_en: And he made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

refs.text_gb: 每块长十肘，宽一肘半。
refs.text_big5: 每塊長十肘，寬一肘半。
refs.text_en: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and one and a half cubits, the width of each board.

refs.text_gb: 每块有两榫相接；帐幕一切的板都是这样作。
refs.text_big5: 每塊有兩榫相接；帳幕一切的板都是這樣作。
refs.text_en: Each board had two tenons joined to one another; thus he did for all the boards of the tabernacle.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕的南面，作二十块板。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕的南面，作二十塊板。
refs.text_en: And he made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

refs.text_gb: 在这二十块板下，又作四十个银卯座；这块板下有两个卯座接板上的两榫，那块板下也有两个卯座接板上的两榫。
refs.text_big5: 在這二十塊板下，又作四十個銀卯座；這塊板下有兩個卯座接板上的兩榫，那塊板下也有兩個卯座接板上的兩榫。
refs.text_en: And he made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards, two sockets under one board for its two tenons and two sockets under the next board for its two tenons.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕第二面，就是北面，也作二十块板，
refs.text_big5: 帳幕第二面，就是北面，也作二十塊板，
refs.text_en: And for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

refs.text_gb: 和四十个银卯座；这块板下有两个卯座，那块板下也有两个卯座。
refs.text_big5: 和四十個銀卯座；這塊板下有兩個卯座，那塊板下也有兩個卯座。
refs.text_en: And their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under one board and two sockets under the next board.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，作六块板。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕的後面，就是西面，作六塊板。
refs.text_en: And for the rear of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕后面的拐角，作两块板。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕後面的拐角，作兩塊板。
refs.text_en: And two boards he made for the corners of the tabernacle in the rear.

refs.text_gb: 板下方是双的，板顶端完全连于一个环子；两个拐角的板，都是这样作。
refs.text_big5: 板下方是雙的，板頂端完全連於一個環子；兩個拐角的板，都是這樣作。
refs.text_en: And they were double below, and at its top they were completely joined to a single ring; thus he did to both of them for the two corners.

refs.text_gb: 有八块板和十六个银卯座，每块板下有两个卯座。
refs.text_big5: 有八塊板和十六個銀卯座，每塊板下有兩個卯座。
refs.text_en: And there were eight boards with their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets, two sockets under every board.

refs.text_gb: 他用皂荚木作闩，为帐幕这面的板作五条闩，
refs.text_big5: 他用皂莢木作閂，為帳幕這面的板作五條閂，
refs.text_en: And he made bars of acacia wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle

refs.text_gb: 为帐幕那面的板作五条闩，又为帐幕后面朝西的板作五条闩。
refs.text_big5: 為帳幕那面的板作五條閂，又為帳幕後面朝西的板作五條閂。
refs.text_en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle at the rear westward.

refs.text_gb: 他使板腰间的中闩，从这一头通到那一头。
refs.text_big5: 他使板腰間的中閂，從這一頭通到那一頭。
refs.text_en: And he made the middle bar to pass through in the center of the boards from end to end.

refs.text_gb: 用金将板包裹，又作板上的金环，用以套闩；闩也用金包裹。
refs.text_big5: 用金將板包裹，又作板上的金環，用以套閂；閂也用金包裹。
refs.text_en: And he overlaid the boards with gold and made their rings of gold as holders for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

refs.text_gb: 他用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
refs.text_big5: 他用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
refs.text_en: And he made the veil of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen; he made it with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

refs.text_gb: 为幔子作四根皂荚木柱子，用金包裹；柱子上有金钩；又为柱子铸了四个银卯座。
refs.text_big5: 為幔子作四根皂莢木柱子，用金包裹；柱子上有金鉤；又為柱子鑄了四個銀卯座。
refs.text_en: And he made for it four pillars of acacia and overlaid them with gold; their hooks were of gold. And he cast for them four sockets of silver.

refs.text_gb: 他拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘。
refs.text_big5: 他拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織帳幕的門簾。
refs.text_en: And he made a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer,

refs.text_gb: 又为帘子作五根柱子和柱子上的钩子，用金包裹柱顶和柱子上的横杆。柱子的五个卯座，是用铜作的。
refs.text_big5: 又為簾子作五根柱子和柱子上的鉤子，用金包裹柱頂和柱子上的橫杆。柱子的五個卯座，是用銅作的。
refs.text_en: And its five pillars with their hooks. And he overlaid their capitals and their connecting rods with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

verses.text_gb: 当摩西出营到会幕去的时候，百姓就都起来，各人站在自己帐棚的门口，望着摩西，直等到他进了会幕。
verses.text_big5: 當摩西出營到會幕去的時候，百姓就都起來，各人站在自己帳棚的門口，望著摩西，直等到他進了會幕。
verses.text_en: And whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would rise up and stand, every man at the entrance of his tent, and gaze after Moses, until he entered the tent.
verses.text_gb_plain: 当摩西出营到会幕去的时候，百姓就都起来，各人站在自己帐棚的门口，望着摩西，直等到他进了会幕。
verses.text_big5_plain: 當摩西出營到會幕去的時候，百姓就都起來，各人站在自己帳棚的門口，望著摩西，直等到他進了會幕。

verses.text_gb: 摩西进会幕的时候，[Cra]云柱就降下来，停在会幕的门口，耶和华便与摩西说话。
verses.text_big5: 摩西進會幕的時候，[Cra]雲柱就降下來，停在會幕的門口，耶和華便與摩西說話。
verses.text_en: And whenever Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would descend and stay at the entrance of the tent, and Jehovah would speak with Moses.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西进会幕的时候，云柱就降下来，停在会幕的门口，耶和华便与摩西说话。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西進會幕的時候，雲柱就降下來，停在會幕的門口，耶和華便與摩西說話。

refs.text_gb: 耶和华在他们前面行，日间在云柱中领他们的路；夜间在火柱中光照他们，使他们日夜都可以行走。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華在他們前面行，日間在雲柱中領他們的路；夜間在火柱中光照他們，使他們日夜都可以行走。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah went before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead them on the way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, that they might go by day and by night.

refs.text_gb: 日间云柱，夜间火柱，总不离开百姓的面前。
refs.text_big5: 日間雲柱，夜間火柱，總不離開百姓的面前。
refs.text_en: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night departed from before the people.

refs.text_gb: 祂在云柱中对他们说话；他们遵守祂的法度，和祂所赐给他们的律例。
refs.text_big5: 祂在雲柱中對他們說話；他們遵守祂的法度，和祂所賜給他們的律例。
refs.text_en: In the pillar of cloud He spoke to them; / They kept His testimonies and the statute that He gave them.

verses.text_gb: 众百姓看见云柱立在会幕门口，就都起来，各人在自己帐棚的门口下拜。
verses.text_big5: 眾百姓看見雲柱立在會幕門口，就都起來，各人在自己帳棚的門口下拜。
verses.text_en: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, all the people would rise up and worship, every man at the entrance of his tent.
verses.text_gb_plain: 众百姓看见云柱立在会幕门口，就都起来，各人在自己帐棚的门口下拜。
verses.text_big5_plain: 眾百姓看見雲柱立在會幕門口，就都起來，各人在自己帳棚的門口下拜。

verses.text_gb: 耶和华与摩西[Cra]面对面说话，好像人与[Fn1]同伴说话一般。摩西回到营里去，但他的帮手，一个少年人，就是嫩的儿子[Crb]约书亚，不离开会幕。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華與摩西[Cra]面對面說話，好像人與[Fn1]同伴說話一般。摩西回到營裏去，但他的幫手，一個少年人，就是嫩的兒子[Crb]約書亞，不離開會幕。
verses.text_en: And Jehovah would speak to Moses face to face, just as a man speaks to his companion. And Moses would return to the camp, but his attendant Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, would not depart out of the tent.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华与摩西面对面说话，好像人与同伴说话一般。摩西回到营里去，但他的帮手，一个少年人，就是嫩的儿子约书亚，不离开会幕。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華與摩西面對面說話，好像人與同伴說話一般。摩西回到營裏去，但他的幫手，一個少年人，就是嫩的兒子約書亞，不離開會幕。

footnotes.zh: 同伴不仅是朋友，更是伙伴，同伙，有共同的权益，共同的事业。虽然亚伯拉罕是神的朋友(代下二十7，赛四一8，雅二23)，摩西却是神的同伴，神伟大事业中的同伙。惟有像摩西这样一个懂得神的心，凡事照着神的心而行的人，才能作神的同伴，与神有共同的权益，并且被神使用，执行祂在地上的事业。
footnotes.zh_big5: 同伴不僅是朋友，更是夥伴，同夥，有共同的權益，共同的事業。雖然亞伯拉罕是神的朋友，（代下二十7，賽四一8，雅二23，）摩西卻是神的同伴，神偉大事業中的同夥。惟有像摩西這樣一個懂得神的心，凡事照著神的心而行的人，纔能作神的同伴，與神有共同的權益，並且被神使用，執行祂在地上的事業。
footnotes.en: 33:11 1 companion A companion, being more than a friend, is an associate, a partner, one who shares a common interest and a common enterprise. Although Abraham was God's friend (2 Chron. 20:7; Isa. 41:8; James 2:23), Moses was God's companion, a partner in God's great enterprise. Only a person like Moses, a person who knows God's heart and does everything according to God's heart, can be a companion of God, sharing a common interest with God and being used by God to carry out His enterprise on earth.

refs.text_gb: 雅各便给那地方起名叫毗努伊勒，因为他说，我面对面看见了神，我的性命仍得保全。
refs.text_big5: 雅各便給那地方起名叫毘努伊勒，因為他說，我面對面看見了神，我的性命仍得保全。
refs.text_en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel, for, he said, I have seen God face to face, and yet my life has been preserved.

refs.text_gb: 我与他面对面说话，乃是明说，不用谜语，他也看见我耶和华的形像。你们毁谤我的仆人摩西，为何不惧怕呢？
refs.text_big5: 我與他面對面說話，乃是明說，不用謎語，他也看見我耶和華的形像。你們毀謗我的僕人摩西，為何不懼怕呢？
refs.text_en: With him I speak face to face, even openly, and not in riddles; / And he beholds the form of Jehovah. Why then were you not afraid to speak against My servant, against Moses?

refs.text_gb: 以后以色列中再没有兴起申言者像摩西的；他是耶和华面对面所认识的，
refs.text_big5: 以後以色列中再沒有興起申言者像摩西的；他是耶和華面對面所認識的，
refs.text_en: And there has not arisen a prophet since then in Israel like Moses, whom Jehovah knew face to face,

refs.text_gb: 我们如今对着镜子观看，模糊不清，到那时就要面对面了。我如今所知道的是局部的，到那时就全知道，如同我全被知道一样。
refs.text_big5: 我們如今對著鏡子觀看，糢糊不清，到那時就要面對面了。我如今所知道的是局部的，到那時就全知道，如同我全被知道一樣。
refs.text_en: For now we see in a mirror obscurely, but at that time face to face; now I know in part, but at that time I will fully know even as also I was fully known.

refs.text_gb: 摩西对约书亚说，你为我们选出人来，出去和亚玛力人争战。明天我手里要拿着神的杖，站在山顶上。
refs.text_big5: 摩西對約書亞說，你為我們選出人來，出去和亞瑪力人爭戰。明天我手裏要拿著神的杖，站在山頂上。
refs.text_en: And Moses said to Joshua, Choose men for us, and go out; fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the staff of God in my hand.

refs.text_gb: 于是约书亚照着摩西对他所说的话行，和亚玛力人争战。摩西、亚伦与户珥，都上了山顶。
refs.text_big5: 於是約書亞照著摩西對他所說的話行，和亞瑪力人爭戰。摩西、亞倫與戶珥，都上了山頂。
refs.text_en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

verses.text_gb: 摩西对耶和华说，看哪，你对我说，[Cra]将这百姓领上去，却没有让我知道你要差遣谁与我同去，只是你曾说，我按你的名认识你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。

verses.text_en: And Moses said to Jehovah, See, You say to me, Bring up this people; but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, I know you by name, and you have also found favor in My sight.

verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西對耶和華說，看哪，你對我說，將這百姓領上去，卻沒有讓我知道你要差遣誰與我同去，只是你曾說，我按你的名認識你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。

refs.text_en: And now go, lead the people to the place about which I have spoken to you. Now My Angel will go before you; nevertheless in the day when I visit, I will visit their sin upon them.

verses.text_en: Now therefore if I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know now Your ways, that I may know You, so that I may continue to find favor in Your sight. Consider also that this nation is Your people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我如今若在你眼前蒙恩，求你叫我知道你的法则，使我可以认识你，好在你眼前继续蒙恩。求你也想到这民是你的百姓。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我如今若在你眼前蒙恩，求你叫我知道你的法則，使我可以認識你，好在你眼前繼續蒙恩。求你也想到這民是你的百姓。

refs.text_en: But they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You have brought out with Your great strength and with Your outstretched arm.

refs.text_gb: 事奉耶和华的祭司，要在廊子和祭坛中间哭泣，说，耶和华啊，求你顾惜你的百姓，不要使你的产业受羞辱，受列邦管辖；为何在万民中有人说，他们的神在哪里呢？
refs.text_big5: 事奉耶和華的祭司，要在廊子和祭壇中間哭泣，說，耶和華阿，求你顧惜你的百姓，不要使你的產業受羞辱，受列邦管轄；為何在萬民中有人說，他們的神在那裏呢？
refs.text_en: Let the priests, the ministers of Jehovah, / Weep between the porch and the altar, / And let them say, / Look with pity, O Jehovah, upon Your people; / And do not give Your inheritance over to reproach, / That the nations should rule over them. / Why should they say among the peoples, / Where is their God?

verses.text_gb: 耶和华说，我的[Fn1][Cra]同在必和你同去，我必使你得安息。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華說，我的[Fn1][Cra]同在必和你同去，我必使你得安息。
verses.text_en: And He said, My presence shall go with you, and I will give you rest.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华说，我的同在必和你同去，我必使你得安息。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華說，我的同在必和你同去，我必使你得安息。

footnotes.zh: 直译，脸面。下节者同。在12～17节，摩西与神讨价还价，要求神的同在与他和百姓同去。神的同在就是祂的道路，是‘地图’，将祂的百姓当行的路指示他们(参约十四6与注1，来十一8与注)。以色列人有神的同在，但非常有限，因为他们远离神的心(参赛二九13)。然而摩西是个非常接近神的心，并照着神的心的人。因此，他有神的同在，到了完满的地步。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，臉面。下節者同。在12～17節，摩西與神討價還價，要求神的同在與他和百姓同去。神的同在就是祂的道路，是“地圖，”將祂的百姓當行的路指示他們。（參約十四6與註1，來十一8與註。）以色列人有神的同在，但非常有限，因為他們遠離神的心。（參賽二九13。）然而摩西是個非常接近神的心，並照著神的心的人。因此，他有神的同在，到了完滿的地步。
footnotes.en: 33:14 1 presence Lit., face. In vv. 12-17 Moses bargained with God for His presence to go with him and the people. God's presence is His way, the “map” that shows His people the way they should take (cf. John 14:6 and note John 14:6 1 ; Heb. 11:8 and note Heb. 11:8 1 ). The children of Israel had God's presence in a very limited way, for they were far from God's heart (cf. Isa. 29:13). Moses, however, was a person very near to God's heart and according to God's heart. Hence, he had God's presence to a full extent.

refs.text_gb: 因为耶和华你们的神与你们同去，要为你们与仇敌争战，拯救你们。
refs.text_big5: 因為耶和華你們的神與你們同去，要為你們與仇敵爭戰，拯救你們。
refs.text_en: For it is Jehovah your God who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

refs.text_gb: 你们当刚强壮胆，不要惧怕，也不要因他们惊恐，因为耶和华你的神必亲自和你同去；祂必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。
refs.text_big5: 你們當剛強壯膽，不要懼怕，也不要因他們驚恐，因為耶和華你的神必親自和你同去；祂必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。
refs.text_en: Be strong and take courage; do not fear, neither be terrified of them, for it is Jehovah your God who goes with you; He will not fail you nor forsake you.

verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西对祂说，你的同在若不和我们同去，就不要把我们从这里领上去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西對祂說，你的同在若不和我們同去，就不要把我們從這裏領上去。

verses.text_big5: 人如何得以知道，我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩？豈不是因你與我們同去，使我和你的百姓與地上的萬民[Cra]有分別麼？
verses.text_en: For how then shall it be known that I have found favor in Your sight, I and Your people? Is it not by Your going with us, so that we, I and Your people, are distinct from all the other people who are on the face of the earth?
verses.text_gb_plain: 人如何得以知道，我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩？岂不是因你与我们同去，使我和你的百姓与地上的万民有分别么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 人如何得以知道，我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩？豈不是因你與我們同去，使我和你的百姓與地上的萬民有分別麼？

refs.text_gb: 主耶和华啊，因你已将他们从地上的万民中分别出来，作你的产业，正如你领我们列祖出埃及的时候，借你仆人摩西所说的。
refs.text_big5: 主耶和華阿，因你已將他們從地上的萬民中分別出來，作你的產業，正如你領我們列祖出埃及的時候，藉你僕人摩西所說的。
refs.text_en: For You have separated them from all the peoples of the earth to be Your inheritance, as You spoke through Moses Your servant, when You brought our fathers out from Egypt, O Lord Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你所说的这事我也要行；因为你在我眼前蒙了恩，并且我按你的名认识你。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你所說的這事我也要行；因為你在我眼前蒙了恩，並且我按你的名認識你。
verses.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，你所说的这事我也要行；因为你在我眼前蒙了恩，并且我按你的名认识你。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，你所說的這事我也要行；因為你在我眼前蒙了恩，並且我按你的名認識你。

verses.text_gb: 摩西说，求你将你的[Fn1][Cra]荣耀显给我看。
verses.text_big5: 摩西說，求你將你的[Fn1][Cra]榮耀顯給我看。
verses.text_en: And he said, Please show me Your glory.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西说，求你将你的荣耀显给我看。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西說，求你將你的榮耀顯給我看。

footnotes.zh: 神的荣耀乃是祂的彰显—神自己彰显出来。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神的榮耀乃是祂的彰顯—神自己彰顯出來。
footnotes.en: 33:18 1 glory God's glory is His expression — God Himself expressed.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦正对以色列全会众说话的时候，他们向旷野观看，不料，耶和华的荣光在云中显现。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫正對以色列全會眾說話的時候，他們向曠野觀看，不料，耶和華的榮光在雲中顯現。
refs.text_en: And as Aaron spoke to the whole assembly of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and there the glory of Jehovah appeared in the cloud.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华说，我要使我一切的美善，在你面前经过，并要在你面前宣告[Cra]耶和华的名。我要向谁施恩惠，就向谁施恩惠；[Crb]要对谁动怜恤，就对谁动怜恤；
verses.text_big5: 耶和華說，我要使我一切的美善，在你面前經過，並要在你面前宣告[Cra]耶和華的名。我要向誰施恩惠，就向誰施恩惠；[Crb]要對誰動憐恤，就對誰動憐恤；
verses.text_en: And He said, I will make all My goodness pass before you, and I will proclaim the name of Jehovah before you; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华说，我要使我一切的美善，在你面前经过，并要在你面前宣告耶和华的名。我要向谁施恩惠，就向谁施恩惠；要对谁动怜恤，就对谁动怜恤；
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華說，我要使我一切的美善，在你面前經過，並要在你面前宣告耶和華的名。我要向誰施恩惠，就向誰施恩惠；要對誰動憐恤，就對誰動憐恤；

refs.text_gb: 耶和华在云中降临，和摩西一同站在那里，宣告耶和华的名。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華在雲中降臨，和摩西一同站在那裏，宣告耶和華的名。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah descended in the cloud and took His place there with him and proclaimed the name of Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华在他面前经过，宣告说，耶和华，耶和华，是有怜恤、有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和信实；
refs.text_big5: 耶和華在他面前經過，宣告說，耶和華，耶和華，是有憐恤、有恩典的神，不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和信實；
refs.text_en: Then Jehovah passed by before him and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah, God compassionate and gracious, long-suffering, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth,

refs.text_gb: 为千万代存留慈爱，赦免罪孽、过犯和罪；但祂绝不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨他的罪孽，自父及子及孙，直到三四代。
refs.text_big5: 為千萬代存留慈愛，赦免罪孽、過犯和罪；但祂絕不以有罪的為無罪，必追討他的罪孽，自父及子及孫，直到三四代。
refs.text_en: Keeping lovingkindness with thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin; but He will by no means clear the guilty, but visits the iniquity of the fathers upon the children and upon the grandchildren, to the third and fourth generations.

refs.text_gb: 因为祂对摩西说，“我要向谁施怜悯，就向谁施怜悯；要对谁动怜恤，就对谁动怜恤。”
refs.text_big5: 因為祂對摩西說，“我要向誰施憐憫，就向誰施憐憫；要對誰動憐恤，就對誰動憐恤。”
refs.text_en: For to Moses He says, "I will have mercy on whomever I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whomever I will have compassion."

verses.text_gb: 又说，你不能看见我的面，因为[Cra]没有人看见我的面还能存活。
verses.text_big5: 又說，你不能看見我的面，因為[Cra]沒有人看見我的面還能存活。
verses.text_en: But He said, You cannot see My face, for no man shall see Me and live.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又说，你不能看见我的面，因为没有人看见我的面还能存活。
verses.text_big5_plain: 又說，你不能看見我的面，因為沒有人看見我的面還能存活。

refs.text_gb: 雅各便给那地方起名叫毗努伊勒，因为他说，我面对面看见了神，我的性命仍得保全。
refs.text_big5: 雅各便給那地方起名叫毘努伊勒，因為他說，我面對面看見了神，我的性命仍得保全。
refs.text_en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel, for, he said, I have seen God face to face, and yet my life has been preserved.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你和亚伦、拿答和亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都要上到耶和华这里来，远远地敬拜。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你和亞倫、拿答和亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都要上到耶和華這裏來，遠遠的敬拜。
refs.text_en: Then He said to Moses, Come up to Jehovah, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship at a distance.

refs.text_gb: 唯独摩西可以亲近耶和华，他们却不可亲近；百姓也不可和他一同上来。
refs.text_big5: 惟獨摩西可以親近耶和華，他們卻不可親近；百姓也不可和他一同上來。
refs.text_en: And Moses alone shall come near to Jehovah, but they shall not come near, nor shall the people come up with him.

refs.text_gb: 摩西来将耶和华一切的话语、典章，都述说与百姓听；众百姓齐声回答说，凡耶和华所说的话，我们必要行。
refs.text_big5: 摩西來將耶和華一切的話語、典章，都述說與百姓聽；眾百姓齊聲回答說，凡耶和華所說的話，我們必要行。
refs.text_en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of Jehovah and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice and said, All the words which Jehovah has spoken we will do.

refs.text_gb: 摩西将耶和华的话都写下；他清早起来，在山下筑了一座坛，并按以色列十二支派，立了十二根柱子；
refs.text_big5: 摩西將耶和華的話都寫下；他清早起來，在山下築了一座壇，並按以色列十二支派，立了十二根柱子；
refs.text_en: And Moses wrote down all the words of Jehovah. And he rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain and twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 又打发以色列人中的少年人去献燔祭，又向耶和华献牛为平安祭。
refs.text_big5: 又打發以色列人中的少年人去獻燔祭，又向耶和華獻牛為平安祭。
refs.text_en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of bulls to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 摩西将血一半盛在盆中，一半洒在坛上。
refs.text_big5: 摩西將血一半盛在盆中，一半灑在壇上。
refs.text_en: And Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

refs.text_gb: 又将约书念给百姓听；他们说，凡耶和华所说的，我们必要行，也必听从。
refs.text_big5: 又將約書念給百姓聽；他們說，凡耶和華所說的，我們必要行，也必聽從。
refs.text_en: And he took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people; and they said, All that Jehovah has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.

refs.text_gb: 摩西将血洒在百姓身上，说，看哪，这是耶和华按这一切话与你们所立之约的血。
refs.text_big5: 摩西將血灑在百姓身上，說，看哪，這是耶和華按這一切話與你們所立之約的血。
refs.text_en: So Moses took the blood and sprinkled it on the people and said, Here is the blood of the covenant, which Jehovah has made with you in accordance with all these words.

refs.text_gb: 随后摩西和亚伦、拿答和亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都上了山。
refs.text_big5: 隨後摩西和亞倫、拿答和亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都上了山。
refs.text_en: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

refs.text_gb: 他们看见以色列的神，祂脚下仿佛有平铺的蓝宝石，像天本身一样明净。
refs.text_big5: 他們看見以色列的神，祂腳下彷彿有平鋪的藍寶石，像天本身一樣明淨。
refs.text_en: And they saw the God of Israel, and under His feet there was something like a paved work of sapphire, even like heaven itself for clearness.

refs.text_gb: 祂不伸手加害以色列人的尊贵者。他们观看神，并且又吃又喝。
refs.text_big5: 祂不伸手加害以色列人的尊貴者。他們觀看神，並且又喫又喝。
refs.text_en: And He did not stretch out His hand upon the nobles of the children of Israel. And they beheld God and ate and drank.

refs.text_gb: 说，看哪，耶和华我们神将祂的荣光和祂的伟大显给我们看，我们又听见祂的声音从火中出来；今日我们得见神与人说话，人还存活。
refs.text_big5: 說，看哪，耶和華我們神將祂的榮光和祂的偉大顯給我們看，我們又聽見祂的聲音從火中出來；今日我們得見神與人說話，人還存活。
refs.text_en: And said, Jehovah our God has just shown us His glory and His greatness, and His voice we have heard from the midst of the fire; today we have seen that God speaks with man and yet he lives.

refs.text_gb: 基甸见祂是耶和华的使者，就说，哀哉！主耶和华啊，我不好了，因为我面对面看见了耶和华的使者。
refs.text_big5: 基甸見祂是耶和華的使者，就說，哀哉！主耶和華阿，我不好了，因為我面對面看見了耶和華的使者。
refs.text_en: And Gideon saw that He was the Angel of Jehovah. And Gideon said, Alas, O Lord Jehovah! For I have seen the Angel of Jehovah face to face.

refs.text_gb: 那时我说，祸哉，我灭亡了！因为我是嘴唇不洁的人，又住在嘴唇不洁的民中；又因我眼见大君王万军之耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 那時我說，禍哉，我滅亡了！因為我是嘴脣不潔的人，又住在嘴脣不潔的民中；又因我眼見大君王萬軍之耶和華。
refs.text_en: Then I said, Woe is me, for I am finished! / For I am a man of unclean lips, / And in the midst of a people of unclean lips I dwell; / Yet my eyes have seen the King, Jehovah of hosts.

refs.text_gb: 从来没有人看见神，只有在父怀里的独生子，将祂表明出来。
refs.text_big5: 從來沒有人看見神，只有在父懷裏的獨生子，將祂表明出來。
refs.text_en: No one has ever seen God; the only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, He has declared Him.

refs.text_gb: 就是那独一不死，住在不能靠近的光中，是人未曾看见，也不能看见的，要将基督这显现显明出来。愿尊贵和永远的权能都归与祂。阿们。
refs.text_big5: 就是那獨一不死，住在不能靠近的光中，是人未曾看見，也不能看見的，要將基督這顯現顯明出來。願尊貴和永遠的權能都歸與祂。阿們。
refs.text_en: Who alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal might. Amen.

refs.text_gb: 从来没有人见过神；我们若彼此相爱，神就住在我们里面，祂的爱也在我们里面得了成全。
refs.text_big5: 從來沒有人見過神；我們若彼此相愛，神就住在我們裏面，祂的愛也在我們裏面得了成全。
refs.text_en: No one has beheld God at any time; if we love one another, God abides in us, and His love is perfected in us.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华说，看哪，在我这里有个地方，你要站在磐石上；
verses.text_big5: 耶和華說，看哪，在我這裏有個地方，你要站在磐石上；
verses.text_en: Then Jehovah said, Here, there is a place by Me, and you shall stand upon the rock;
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华说，看哪，在我这里有个地方，你要站在磐石上；
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華說，看哪，在我這裏有個地方，你要站在磐石上；

verses.text_gb: 我的荣耀经过的时候，我要将你放在[Fn1]磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，直等我过去；
verses.text_big5: 我的榮耀經過的時候，我要將你放在[Fn1]磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，直等我過去；
verses.text_en: And while My glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and I will cover you with My hand until I have passed by.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我的荣耀经过的时候，我要将你放在磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，直等我过去；
verses.text_big5_plain: 我的榮耀經過的時候，我要將你放在磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，直等我過去；

footnotes.zh: 基督是裂开的磐石，是为我们裂开的永久磐石(见十七6与注)。惟有在钉十字架的基督里面，我们才能看见神(参太五8，启二二4)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 基督是裂開的磐石，是為我們裂開的永久磐石。（見十七6與註。）惟有在釘十字架的基督裏面，我們纔能看見神。（參太五8，啟二二4。）
footnotes.en: 33:22 1 cleft Christ is the cleft rock, the everlasting rock cleft for us (see Exo. 17:6 and notes). Only in the crucified Christ can we see God (cf. Matt. 5:8; Rev. 22:4).

verses.text_gb: 然后我要将我的手挪开，你就得见我的背，却不得见我的面。
verses.text_big5: 然後我要將我的手挪開，你就得見我的背，卻不得見我的面。
verses.text_en: And I will take away My hand, and you will see My back; but My face shall not be seen.
verses.text_gb_plain: 然后我要将我的手挪开，你就得见我的背，却不得见我的面。
verses.text_big5_plain: 然後我要將我的手挪開，你就得見我的背，卻不得見我的面。

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你要凿出两块[Fn1][Cra]石版，和先前的一样；先前你[Crb]摔碎的版，其上的字我要[Crc]写在这两块版上。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你要鑿出兩塊[Fn1][Cra]石版，和先前的一樣；先前你[Crb]摔碎的版，其上的字我要[Crc]寫在這兩塊版上。
verses.text_en: Then Jehovah said to Moses, Cut two tablets of stone like the first ones, and I will write upon the tablets the words which were on the first tablets, which you shattered.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，你要凿出两块石版，和先前的一样；先前你摔碎的版，其上的字我要写在这两块版上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，你要鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣；先前你摔碎的版，其上的字我要寫在這兩塊版上。

footnotes.zh: 本章论到恢复神与祂百姓之间被破坏的约(三二19，三四10上)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本章論到恢復神與祂百姓之間被破壞的約。（三二19，三四10上。）
footnotes.en: 34:1 1 tablets This chapter concerns the recovery of the broken covenant between God and His people (Exo. 32:19; v. 10a).

refs.text_gb: 那时耶和华对我说，你要凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，上山到我这里来，又要作一个木柜。
refs.text_big5: 那時耶和華對我說，你要鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣，上山到我這裏來，又要作一個木櫃。
refs.text_en: At that time Jehovah said to me, Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first ones, and come up to Me on the mountain; and make yourself an ark of wood.

refs.text_gb: 若那用字刻在石头上属死的职事，尚且是带着荣光立的，以致以色列子孙因摩西面上渐渐废去的荣光，不能定睛看他的脸，
refs.text_big5: 若那用字刻在石頭上屬死的職事，尚且是帶著榮光立的，以致以色列子孫因摩西面上漸漸廢去的榮光，不能定睛看他的臉，
refs.text_en: Moreover if the ministry of death, engraved in stone in letters, came about in glory, so that the sons of Israel were not able to gaze at the face of Moses because of the glory of his face, a glory which was being done away with,

refs.text_gb: 有金香坛，和四面包金的约柜，柜里有盛吗哪的金罐、和亚伦发过芽的杖、并两块约版；
refs.text_big5: 有金香壇，和四面包金的約櫃，櫃裏有盛嗎哪的金罐、和亞倫發過芽的杖、並兩塊約版；
refs.text_en: Having a golden altar and the Ark of the Covenant covered about everywhere with gold, in which were the golden pot that had the manna and Aaron's rod that budded and the tablets of the covenant,

refs.text_gb: 摩西走近营前，就看见那牛犊，又看见人跳舞，便发烈怒，把两块版从手中扔出，在山下摔碎了。
refs.text_big5: 摩西走近營前，就看見那牛犢，又看見人跳舞，便發烈怒，把兩塊版從手中扔出，在山下摔碎了。
refs.text_en: And as soon as he drew near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing; and Moses' anger burned, and he threw the tablets out of his hands and shattered them at the foot of the mountain.

refs.text_gb: 摩西在那里与耶和华同在四十昼四十夜，也不吃饭也不喝水。耶和华将这约的话，就是十条诫命，写在两块版上。
refs.text_big5: 摩西在那裏與耶和華同在四十晝四十夜，也不喫飯也不喝水。耶和華將這約的話，就是十條誡命，寫在兩塊版上。
refs.text_en: And he was there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights; he did not eat bread, and he did not drink water. And He wrote upon the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.

refs.text_gb: 你先前摔碎的版，其上的字我要写在这两块版上；你要将这两块版放在柜里。
refs.text_big5: 你先前摔碎的版，其上的字我要寫在這兩塊版上；你要將這兩塊版放在櫃裏。
refs.text_en: And I will write upon the tablets the words which were on the first tablets, which you shattered; and you shall place them in the Ark.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华将祂在大会之日，在山上从火中对你们所说的十条诫命，照先前所写的，写在这两块版上，将版交给了我。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華將祂在大會之日，在山上從火中對你們所說的十條誡命，照先前所寫的，寫在這兩塊版上，將版交給了我。
refs.text_en: And He wrote upon the tablets as He had done the first writing, the Ten Commandments, which Jehovah spoke to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly; and Jehovah gave them to me.

verses.text_gb: 早晨以前你要预备好，到了早晨你要上西乃山，在山顶上站在我面前。
verses.text_big5: 早晨以前你要豫備好，到了早晨你要上西乃山，在山頂上站在我面前。
verses.text_en: And be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to Me, on the top of the mountain.
verses.text_gb_plain: 早晨以前你要预备好，到了早晨你要上西乃山，在山顶上站在我面前。
verses.text_big5_plain: 早晨以前你要豫備好，到了早晨你要上西乃山，在山頂上站在我面前。

verses.text_gb: 谁也不可和你一同上去，遍[Cra]山都不可有人，在山前也不可叫羊群牛群吃草。
verses.text_big5: 誰也不可和你一同上去，遍[Cra]山都不可有人，在山前也不可叫羊群牛群喫草。
verses.text_en: And no one shall come up with you, nor let anyone be seen anywhere on the mountain, nor let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.
verses.text_gb_plain: 谁也不可和你一同上去，遍山都不可有人，在山前也不可叫羊群牛群吃草。
verses.text_big5_plain: 誰也不可和你一同上去，遍山都不可有人，在山前也不可叫羊群牛群喫草。

refs.text_gb: 你要在山的四围给百姓定界限，说，你们当谨慎，不可上山去，也不可触着山的边界；凡触着这山的，必被处死。
refs.text_big5: 你要在山的四圍給百姓定界限，說，你們當謹慎，不可上山去，也不可觸著山的邊界；凡觸著這山的，必被處死。
refs.text_en: And you shall set limits for the people all around, saying, Be careful that you do not go up on the mountain or touch the border of it. Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death.

refs.text_gb: 不可用手触着他，必用石头打死，或用箭射透；无论是走兽是人，都不得活。到角声拖长的时候，他们才可以到山上来。
refs.text_big5: 不可用手觸著他，必用石頭打死，或用箭射透；無論是走獸是人，都不得活。到角聲拖長的時候，他們纔可以到山上來。
refs.text_en: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether beast or man, he shall not live. When the trumpet sounds a long blast, they may come up on the mountain.

verses.text_gb: 摩西就凿出两块石版，和先前的一样；[Fn1]清晨起来，照耶和华所吩咐的上西乃山去，手里拿着两块石版。
verses.text_big5: 摩西就鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣；[Fn1]清晨起來，照耶和華所吩咐的上西乃山去，手裏拿著兩塊石版。
verses.text_en: So Moses cut two tablets of stone like the first ones. Then Moses rose up early in the morning and went up to Mount Sinai, just as Jehovah had commanded him; and he took two tablets of stone in his hand.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西就凿出两块石版，和先前的一样；清晨起来，照耶和华所吩咐的上西乃山去，手里拿着两块石版。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西就鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣；清晨起來，照耶和華所吩咐的上西乃山去，手裏拿著兩塊石版。

verses.text_gb: 耶和华在云中[Cra]降临，和摩西一同站在那里，[Fn1]宣告[Crb]耶和华的名。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華在雲中[Cra]降臨，和摩西一同站在那裏，[Fn1]宣告[Crb]耶和華的名。
verses.text_en: And Jehovah descended in the cloud and took His place there with him and proclaimed the name of Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华在云中降临，和摩西一同站在那里，宣告耶和华的名。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華在雲中降臨，和摩西一同站在那裏，宣告耶和華的名。

footnotes.zh: 神宣告祂的名，意思是借宣告祂的所是，显示祂的地位。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神宣告祂的名，意思是藉宣告祂的所是，顯示祂的地位。
footnotes.en: 34:5 1 proclaimed For God to proclaim His name means that He assumed His position by declaring who He is.

refs.text_gb: 西乃全山冒烟，因为耶和华在火中降在山上。山的烟气上腾，如同烧窑的烟气一般；遍山大大地震动。
refs.text_big5: 西乃全山冒煙，因為耶和華在火中降在山上。山的煙氣上騰，如同燒窯的煙氣一般；遍山大大的震動。
refs.text_en: Now the whole of Mount Sinai smoked because Jehovah descended upon it in fire, and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace; and the whole mountain shook greatly.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华在云中降临，对摩西说话，并且把他身上的灵，也放在那七十个长老身上。灵停歇在他们身上的时候，他们就申言，以后却没有再申言。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華在雲中降臨，對摩西說話，並且把他身上的靈，也放在那七十個長老身上。靈停歇在他們身上的時候，他們就申言，以後卻沒有再申言。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and He took of the Spirit who was upon him, and put Him upon the seventy elders. And when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, but they did not do so again.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华说，我要使我一切的美善，在你面前经过，并要在你面前宣告耶和华的名。我要向谁施恩惠，就向谁施恩惠；要对谁动怜恤，就对谁动怜恤；
refs.text_big5: 耶和華說，我要使我一切的美善，在你面前經過，並要在你面前宣告耶和華的名。我要向誰施恩惠，就向誰施恩惠；要對誰動憐恤，就對誰動憐恤；
refs.text_en: And He said, I will make all My goodness pass before you, and I will proclaim the name of Jehovah before you; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华在他面前经过，宣告说，耶和华，耶和华，是[Cra]有怜恤、有恩典的神，[Fn1][Crb]不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和信实；
verses.text_big5: 耶和華在他面前經過，宣告說，耶和華，耶和華，是[Cra]有憐恤、有恩典的神，[Fn1][Crb]不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和信實；
verses.text_en: Then Jehovah passed by before him and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah, God compassionate and gracious, long-suffering, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth,
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华在他面前经过，宣告说，耶和华，耶和华，是有怜恤、有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和信实；
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華在他面前經過，宣告說，耶和華，耶和華，是有憐恤、有恩典的神，不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和信實；

footnotes.zh: 或，恒久忍耐。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，恆久忍耐。

refs.text_gb: 你们若转向耶和华，你们的弟兄和儿女必在掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤，得以归回这地，因为耶和华你们的神有恩典、有怜恤；你们若转向祂，祂必不转脸不顾你们。
refs.text_big5: 你們若轉向耶和華，你們的弟兄和兒女必在擄掠他們的人面前蒙憐恤，得以歸回這地，因為耶和華你們的神有恩典、有憐恤；你們若轉向祂，祂必不轉臉不顧你們。
refs.text_en: For when you turn to Jehovah, your brothers and your children will find compassion before those who led them captive and will return to this land, for Jehovah your God is gracious and compassionate, and will not turn His face away from you if you return to Him.

refs.text_gb: 不肯听从，也不记念你在他们中间所行的奇事，竟硬着颈项，自立首领，要回埃及去受奴役。但你是乐意饶恕人的神，有恩典，有怜恤，不轻易发怒，有丰盛的慈爱，所以你没有丢弃他们。
refs.text_big5: 不肯聽從，也不記念你在他們中間所行的奇事，竟硬著頸項，自立首領，要回埃及去受奴役。但你是樂意饒恕人的神，有恩典，有憐恤，不輕易發怒，有豐盛的慈愛，所以你沒有丟棄他們。
refs.text_en: And they refused to listen / And would not remember Your wondrous acts, / Which You had done among them. / And they stiffened their neck and appointed a leader / To return to their slavery in Egypt. / But You are a God of forgiveness, / Gracious and compassionate, / Long-suffering and abounding in lovingkindness; / So You did not forsake them.

refs.text_gb: 但主啊，你是有怜恤有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和真实。
refs.text_big5: 但主阿，你是有憐恤有恩典的神，不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和真實。
refs.text_en: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, / Long-suffering and abundant in lovingkindness and truth.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华有怜恤，有恩典，不轻易发怒，且有丰盛的慈爱。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華有憐恤，有恩典，不輕易發怒，且有豐盛的慈愛。
refs.text_en: Jehovah is compassionate and gracious, / Long-suffering and abundant in lovingkindness.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华有恩典，有怜恤，不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華有恩典，有憐恤，不輕易發怒，大有慈愛。
refs.text_en: Jehovah is gracious and compassionate, / Long-suffering and great in lovingkindness.

refs.text_gb: 你们要撕裂心肠，不要撕裂衣服，并要归向耶和华你们的神，因为祂有恩典，有怜恤，不轻易发怒，有丰盛的慈爱，并且后悔，不降所说的灾。
refs.text_big5: 你們要撕裂心腸，不要撕裂衣服，並要歸向耶和華你們的神，因為祂有恩典，有憐恤，不輕易發怒，有豐盛的慈愛，並且後悔，不降所說的災。
refs.text_en: And rend your hearts, / And not your garments, / And turn to Jehovah your God, / For He is gracious and compassionate, / Long-suffering and abundant in lovingkindness / And repentant of evil.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，我们称那忍耐的人是有福的。你们听见过约伯的忍耐，也看见过主给他的结局，明显主是满有慈心，且有怜恤。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，我們稱那忍耐的人是有福的。你們聽見過約伯的忍耐，也看見過主給他的結局，明顯主是滿有慈心，且有憐恤。
refs.text_en: Behold, we call those who endured blessed. You have heard of the endurance of Job, and you have seen his end from the Lord, that the Lord is very tenderhearted and compassionate.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱，赦免罪孽和过犯；但祂绝不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨他的罪孽，自父及子，直到三四代。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛，赦免罪孽和過犯；但祂絕不以有罪的為無罪，必追討他的罪孽，自父及子，直到三四代。
refs.text_en: Jehovah is slow to anger and abundant in lovingkindness, forgiving iniquity and transgression; but He will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and the fourth generations.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华不轻易发怒，大有能力，绝不以有罪的为无罪；耶和华的道路在旋风和暴风中，云彩是祂脚下的尘土。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華不輕易發怒，大有能力，絕不以有罪的為無罪；耶和華的道路在旋風和暴風中，雲彩是祂腳下的塵土。
refs.text_en: Jehovah is long-suffering and great in power / And will by no means clear the guilty. / Jehovah - His way is in the whirlwind and in the storm, / And the clouds are the dust of His feet.

verses.text_gb: 为千万代[Cra]存留慈爱，赦免罪孽、过犯和罪；但祂绝不以有罪的为无罪，[Crb]必追讨他的罪孽，自父及子及孙，直到三四代。
verses.text_big5: 為千萬代[Cra]存留慈愛，赦免罪孽、過犯和罪；但祂絕不以有罪的為無罪，[Crb]必追討他的罪孽，自父及子及孫，直到三四代。
verses.text_en: Keeping lovingkindness with thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin; but He will by no means clear the guilty, but visits the iniquity of the fathers upon the children and upon the grandchildren, to the third and fourth generations.
verses.text_gb_plain: 为千万代存留慈爱，赦免罪孽、过犯和罪；但祂绝不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨他的罪孽，自父及子及孙，直到三四代。

verses.text_gb: 说，主啊，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求主[Cra]在我们中间和我们同去；虽然他们是[Crb]硬着颈项的百姓，但求你赦免我们的罪孽和罪恶，以我们为你的[Crc]产业。

verses.text_en: And he said, If now I have found favor in Your sight, O Lord, let the Lord please go in our midst; although they are a stiff-necked people, pardon our iniquity and our sin and take us for Your inheritance.
verses.text_gb_plain: 说，主啊，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求主在我们中间和我们同去；虽然他们是硬着颈项的百姓，但求你赦免我们的罪孽和罪恶，以我们为你的产业。
verses.text_big5_plain: 說，主阿，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求主在我們中間和我們同去；雖然他們是硬著頸項的百姓，但求你赦免我們的罪孽和罪惡，以我們為你的產業。

refs.text_en: And he said to Him, If Your presence does not go with us, do not bring us up from here.

refs.text_en: For how then shall it be known that I have found favor in Your sight, I and Your people? Is it not by Your going with us, so that we, I and Your people, are distinct from all the other people who are on the face of the earth?

refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, I have seen this people, and indeed they are, a stiff-necked people.

refs.text_big5: 耶和華的分本是祂的百姓；雅各是祂當得的產業。
refs.text_en: For Jehovah's portion is His people; / Jacob is the allotment of His inheritance.

refs.text_gb: 求你拯救你的百姓，赐福给你的产业，牧养他们，怀抱他们，直到永远。
refs.text_big5: 求你拯救你的百姓，賜福給你的產業，牧養他們，懷抱他們，直到永遠。
refs.text_en: Save Your people, / And bless Your inheritance; / And shepherd them and carry them forever.

refs.text_gb: 以耶和华为神的，那国是有福的；祂所拣选为自己产业的，那民是有福的。
refs.text_big5: 以耶和華為神的，那國是有福的；祂所揀選為自己產業的，那民是有福的。
refs.text_en: Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, / The people whom He has chosen as His own possession.

refs.text_gb: 并将祂的百姓交与刀剑，向祂的产业发怒。
refs.text_big5: 並將祂的百姓交與刀劍，向祂的產業發怒。
refs.text_en: He also delivered His people to the sword / And was angry with His inheritance.

refs.text_gb: 因为耶和华必不丢弃祂的百姓，也不离弃祂的产业。
refs.text_big5: 因為耶和華必不丟棄祂的百姓，也不離棄祂的產業。
refs.text_en: For Jehovah will not abandon His people, / Nor will He forsake His inheritance.

refs.text_gb: 雅各的分不像这些；因祂是形成万有的，以色列也是祂产业的支派；万军之耶和华是祂的名。
refs.text_big5: 雅各的分不像這些；因祂是形成萬有的，以色列也是祂產業的支派；萬軍之耶和華是祂的名。
refs.text_en: The Portion of Jacob is not like these; / For He is the One who formed everything, / And Israel is the tribe of His inheritance; / Jehovah of hosts is His name.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华说，看哪，我要立[Cra]约。我要在你的众百姓面前行[Fn1]奇事，是在全地万国中所未曾行的。在你四围的众民，就要看见耶和华的作为，因我要向你行的是可畏惧的事。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華說，看哪，我要立[Cra]約。我要在你的眾百姓面前行[Fn1]奇事，是在全地萬國中所未曾行的。在你四圍的眾民，就要看見耶和華的作為，因我要向你行的是可畏懼的事。
verses.text_en: And He said, Now I hereby make a covenant: Before all your people I will perform wonders such as have not been produced in all the earth, nor among any of the nations; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of Jehovah, for it is an awesome thing that I will do with you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华说，看哪，我要立约。我要在你的众百姓面前行奇事，是在全地万国中所未曾行的。在你四围的众民，就要看见耶和华的作为，因我要向你行的是可畏惧的事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華說，看哪，我要立約。我要在你的眾百姓面前行奇事，是在全地萬國中所未曾行的。在你四圍的眾民，就要看見耶和華的作為，因我要向你行的是可畏懼的事。

footnotes.zh: 神奇妙的作为乃是为着一个目标，就是把祂的百姓带进美地，好建造殿作神的见证和祂在地上的居所。照样，神为我们行奇事，目的是要把我们带进基督，就是美地的实际里(见申八7注1)，好建造召会作神的见证和神的殿(启一2，林前三16)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神奇妙的作為乃是為著一個目標，就是把祂的百姓帶進美地，好建造殿作神的見證和祂在地上的居所。照樣，神為我們行奇事，目的是要把我們帶進基督，就是美地的實際裏，（見申八7註1，）好建造召會作神的見證和神的殿。（啟一2，林前三16。）
footnotes.en: 34:10 1 wonders God's wonderful doings were for the goal of bringing His people into the good land for the building up of the temple as God's testimony and His dwelling place on earth. Likewise, God performs wonders for us with the intention of bringing us into Christ, the reality of the good land (see note Deut. 8:7 1 in ), for the building up of the church as God's testimony and God's temple (Rev. 1:2; 1 Cor. 3:16).

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你要将这些话写上，因为我是按这些话与你和以色列人立约的。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你要將這些話寫上，因為我是按這些話與你和以色列人立約的。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, Write these words, for according to the speaking of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华我们的神在何烈山与我们立约。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華我們的神在何烈山與我們立約。
refs.text_en: Jehovah our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

refs.text_gb: 这些是耶和华在摩押地吩咐摩西与以色列人立约的话，是在祂和他们于何烈山所立的约之外。
refs.text_big5: 這些是耶和華在摩押地吩咐摩西與以色列人立約的話，是在祂和他們於何烈山所立的約之外。
refs.text_en: These are the words of the covenant which Jehovah commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant that He made with them at Horeb.

verses.text_gb: 我今天所吩咐你的，你要谨守。我要从你面前[Cra]撵出亚摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。
verses.text_big5: 我今天所吩咐你的，你要謹守。我要從你面前[Cra]攆出亞摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。
verses.text_en: Observe what I am commanding you today. I will drive out before you the Amorites and the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我今天所吩咐你的，你要谨守。我要从你面前撵出亚摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我今天所吩咐你的，你要謹守。我要從你面前攆出亞摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。

refs.text_gb: 我要差遣使者在你前面；我要撵出迦南人、亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。
refs.text_big5: 我要差遣使者在你前面；我要攆出迦南人、亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。
refs.text_en: And I will send an Angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanites, the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华你神领你进入要得为业之地，从你面前除掉许多国民，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七国的民，都比你多、比你强。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華你神領你進入要得為業之地，從你面前除掉許多國民，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亞摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七國的民，都比你多、比你強。
refs.text_en: When Jehovah your God brings you into the land which you are about to enter to possess, and clears away many nations from before you-the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, the Jebusites, seven nations more numerous and mightier than you -

refs.text_gb: 耶和华你的神将他们从你面前撵出以后，你心里不可说，耶和华将我领进来得这地，是因我的义。其实，耶和华将这些国民从你面前赶出去，是因他们的恶。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華你的神將他們從你面前攆出以後，你心裏不可說，耶和華將我領進來得這地，是因我的義。其實，耶和華將這些國民從你面前趕出去，是因他們的惡。
refs.text_en: Do not say in your heart when Jehovah your God drives them out from before you, Because of my righteousness, Jehovah has brought me in to possess this land. Rather, it is because of the wickedness of these nations that Jehovah is about to dispossess them from before you.

refs.text_gb: 你进去得他们的地，并不是因你的义，也不是因你心里正直，乃是因这些国民的恶，耶和华你的神才将他们从你面前赶出去，又因耶和华要坚定祂向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓的话。
refs.text_big5: 你進去得他們的地，並不是因你的義，也不是因你心裏正直，乃是因這些國民的惡，耶和華你的神纔將他們從你面前趕出去，又因耶和華要堅定祂向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓的話。
refs.text_en: It is not because of your righteousness nor because of the uprightness of your heart that you are entering in to possess their land, but Jehovah your God is about to dispossess them from before you because of the wickedness of these nations and so that Jehovah may establish the word that He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

footnotes.zh: 12～17节是关于拜偶像之网罗的警告，重申十诫中的头三诫(二十2～7)。偶像就是任何顶替神，使我们不能完满享受基督作美地的人、事、物。神宣告说，祂要作一切事，把祂的百姓带进美地(10～11)，但祂也指出拜偶像的危机，那会废除祂为以色列人所行的奇妙作为。照样，神已应许作成必要的一切，把我们带进包罗万有的基督里，使我们享受祂(参西一12～13)，但我们必须留意神关于拜偶像的警告(参约壹五21)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 12～17節是關於拜偶像之網羅的警告，重申十誡中的頭三誡。（二十2～7。）偶像就是任何頂替神，使我們不能完滿享受基督作美地的人、事、物。神宣告說，祂要作一切事，把祂的百姓帶進美地，（10～11，）但祂也指出拜偶像的危機，那會廢除祂為以色列人所行的奇妙作為。照樣，神已應許作成必要的一切，把我們帶進包羅萬有的基督裏，使我們享受祂，（參西一12～13，）但我們必須留意神關於拜偶像的警告。（參約壹五21。）
footnotes.en: 34:14 1 god Verses 12-17 are a warning concerning the snare of idolatry, a repetition of the first three of the Ten Commandments (Exo. 20:2-7). An idol is any person, matter, or thing that replaces God and keeps us from the full enjoyment of Christ as our good land. God declared that He would do everything to bring the people into the good land (vv. 10-11), but He also pointed out the danger of idolatry, which would nullify His wondrous doings on behalf of the children of Israel. Likewise, God has promised to do everything necessary to bring us into the all-inclusive Christ for our enjoyment (cf. Col. 1:12-13), but we must take heed to God's warning concerning idolatry (cf. 1 John 5:21).

verses.text_en: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in the month of Abib you came out from Egypt.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期，吃无酵饼七天，因为你是在亚笔月内出埃及的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你要守除酵節，照我所吩咐你的，在亞筆月內所定的日期，喫無酵餅七天，因為你是在亞筆月內出埃及的。

footnotes.zh: 神的心意不是要祂的百姓用自己的力量努力遵守十诫；反之，神的心意乃是吩咐百姓享受祂—与祂一同守节并与祂一同安息。这与我们天然的愿望相反，我们总是想要为神作什么(参路十五18～32与19注2)。遵守神的诫命必须是次要的，那必须是与主一同守节与主一同安息的结果(见创二17注1一段)。 18和22～23节所提每年三个节期的意义，见二三14～16注与利二三注。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神的心意不是要祂的百姓用自己的力量努力遵守十誡；反之，神的心意乃是吩咐百姓享受祂—與祂一同守節並與祂一同安息。這與我們天然的願望相反，我們總是想要為神作甚麼。（參路十五18～32與19註2。）遵守神的誡命必須是次要的，那必須是與主一同守節、與主一同安息的結果。（見創二17註1一段。）ˍ18和22～23節所題每年三個節期的意義，見二三14～16註與利二三註。
footnotes.en: 34:18 1 keep It was not God's intention that His people would endeavor in their own strength to keep the Ten Commandments. Rather, His intention was to command His people to enjoy Him — to feast with Him and rest with Him. This is contrary to our natural desire to always want to do something for God (cf. Luke 15:18-32 and note Luke 15:19 2 ). The keeping of God's commandments must be secondary; it must be the issue of feasting with the Lord and resting with Him (see note Gen. 2:17 1 , par. 1). For the significance of the three annual feasts mentioned in vv. 18 and vv. 22-23, see note on Exo. 23:14-16 and on Lev. 23.

refs.text_gb: 你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期，吃无酵饼七天，因为你是在这月出埃及的。谁也不可空手朝见我。
refs.text_big5: 你要守除酵節，照我所吩咐你的，在亞筆月內所定的日期，喫無酵餅七天，因為你是在這月出埃及的。誰也不可空手朝見我。
refs.text_en: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread; as I commanded you, seven days you shall eat unleavened bread at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in it you came out from Egypt. And no one shall appear before Me empty.

refs.text_gb: 这月十五日是节期，要吃无酵饼七日。
refs.text_big5: 這月十五日是節期，要喫無酵餅七日。
refs.text_en: And on the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast; seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.

refs.text_gb: 这月十五日是向耶和华守的无酵节；你们要吃无酵饼七日。
refs.text_big5: 這月十五日是向耶和華守的無酵節；你們要喫無酵餅七日。
refs.text_en: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the Feast of Unleavened Bread to Jehovah; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

verses.text_gb: 凡[Fn1][Cra]头胎的都是我的；一切牲畜头生的，无论是牛是羊，公的都是我的。
verses.text_big5: 凡[Fn1][Cra]頭胎的都是我的；一切牲畜頭生的，無論是牛是羊，公的都是我的。
verses.text_en: All that opens the womb is Mine, even the first male produced by all your livestock, of cattle or sheep.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡头胎的都是我的；一切牲畜头生的，无论是牛是羊，公的都是我的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡頭胎的都是我的；一切牲畜頭生的，無論是牛是羊，公的都是我的。

footnotes.zh: 见十三2注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見十三2註2。

refs.text_gb: 要把一切头生的分别为圣归我：以色列中头胎的，无论是人是牲畜，都是我的。
refs.text_big5: 要把一切頭生的分別為聖歸我：以色列中頭胎的，無論是人是牲畜，都是我的。
refs.text_en: Sanctify to Me all the firstborn: Whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast, it is Mine.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]头生的驴，你要用[Cra]羊羔代赎；若不代赎，就要打折它的颈项。凡你儿子中头生的，都要赎出来。谁也不可[Crb]空手朝见我。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]頭生的驢，你要用[Cra]羊羔代贖；若不代贖，就要打折牠的頸項。凡你兒子中頭生的，都要贖出來。誰也不可[Crb]空手朝見我。
verses.text_en: And the first offspring of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; but if you do not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem, and they shall not appear before Me empty.
verses.text_gb_plain: 头生的驴，你要用羊羔代赎；若不代赎，就要打折它的颈项。凡你儿子中头生的，都要赎出来。谁也不可空手朝见我。
verses.text_big5_plain: 頭生的驢，你要用羊羔代贖；若不代贖，就要打折牠的頸項。凡你兒子中頭生的，都要贖出來。誰也不可空手朝見我。

footnotes.zh: 见十三13注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見十三13註1。
footnotes.en: 34:20 1 donkey See note Exo. 13:13 1 .

refs.text_gb: 凡头生的驴，你要用羊羔代赎；若不代赎，就要打折它的颈项。凡你儿子中头生的都要赎出来。
refs.text_big5: 凡頭生的驢，你要用羊羔代贖；若不代贖，就要打折牠的頸項。凡你兒子中頭生的都要贖出來。
refs.text_en: And every first offspring of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you do not redeem it, you shall break its neck. And every firstborn male among your sons you shall redeem.

refs.text_gb: 他们所奉给耶和华的，连人带牲畜，一切血肉所生，凡头胎的，都要归给你；只是人中头生的，总要赎出来；不洁净牲畜头生的，也要赎出来。
refs.text_big5: 他們所奉給耶和華的，連人帶牲畜，一切血肉所生，凡頭胎的，都要歸給你；只是人中頭生的，總要贖出來；不潔淨牲畜頭生的，也要贖出來。
refs.text_en: Everything that opens the womb of all flesh, which they present to Jehovah, whether human or animal, shall be yours; nevertheless the firstborn of human beings you shall surely redeem, and the firstborn of unclean animals you shall redeem.

refs.text_gb: 你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期，吃无酵饼七天，因为你是在这月出埃及的。谁也不可空手朝见我。
refs.text_big5: 你要守除酵節，照我所吩咐你的，在亞筆月內所定的日期，喫無酵餅七天，因為你是在這月出埃及的。誰也不可空手朝見我。
refs.text_en: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread; as I commanded you, seven days you shall eat unleavened bread at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in it you came out from Egypt. And no one shall appear before Me empty.

refs.text_gb: 你一切的男丁，要在除酵节、七七节、住棚节，一年三次，在耶和华你神所选择的地方朝见祂。他们不可空手朝见耶和华；
refs.text_big5: 你一切的男丁，要在除酵節、七七節、住棚節，一年三次，在耶和華你神所選擇的地方朝見祂。他們不可空手朝見耶和華；
refs.text_en: Three times a year all your males shall appear before Jehovah your God in the place which He will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Tabernacles. And they shall not appear before Jehovah empty-handed;

verses.text_gb: 你[Cra]六日要作工，[Fn1]第七日要停工，虽在耕种和收割的时候，也要停工。
verses.text_big5: 你[Cra]六日要作工，[Fn1]第七日要停工，雖在耕種和收割的時候，也要停工。
verses.text_en: Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall cease from labor. Even in plowing time and in harvest time you shall cease from labor.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你六日要作工，第七日要停工，虽在耕种和收割的时候，也要停工。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你六日要作工，第七日要停工，雖在耕種和收割的時候，也要停工。

footnotes.zh: 除了每年的节期以外(18，22～23)，以色列人每周要守安息日，停下劳苦，与神一同安息，记念神是他们的创造主和救赎主。在论到节期的这段话中间插入论安息日的话，指明当我们享受基督，我们同时就与祂一同安息。
footnotes.zh_big5: 除了每年的節期以外，（18，22～23，）以色列人每週要守安息日，停下勞苦，與神一同安息，記念神是他們的創造主和救贖主。在論到節期的這段話中間插入論安息日的話，指明當我們享受基督，我們同時就與祂一同安息。
footnotes.en: 34:21 1 seventh In addition to the annual feasts (vv. 18, 22-23), every week the children of Israel were to keep the Sabbath, ceasing from their labor and resting with God in remembrance of Him as their Creator and Redeemer. The inserting of the word concerning the Sabbath between the word concerning the feasts indicates that while we are enjoying Christ, simultaneously we rest with Him.

refs.text_gb: 六日要劳碌作你一切的工，
refs.text_big5: 六日要勞碌作你一切的工，
refs.text_en: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

verses.text_gb: 在收割初熟麦子的时候，要守[Cra]七七节；又在年底，要守[Crb]收藏节。
verses.text_big5: 在收割初熟麥子的時候，要守[Cra]七七節；又在年底，要守[Crb]收藏節。
verses.text_en: And you shall keep the Feast of Weeks, that is, of the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在收割初熟麦子的时候，要守七七节；又在年底，要守收藏节。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在收割初熟麥子的時候，要守七七節；又在年底，要守收藏節。
