refs.text_gb: 又要守收割节，所收割的是你田间所种、劳碌得来的初熟之物；也要在年底从田里收藏你劳碌得来之物时，守收藏节。
refs.text_big5: 又要守收割節，所收割的是你田間所種、勞碌得來的初熟之物；也要在年底從田裏收藏你勞碌得來之物時，守收藏節。
refs.text_en: And you shall keep the Feast of the Harvest, of the firstfruits of your labors from what you sow in the fruit of the field, and the Feast of Ingathering, at the end of the year when you gather in your labors out of the field.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，
refs.text_en: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

refs.text_gb: 你要对以色列人说，你们进了我赐给你们的地，收割庄稼的时候，要将初熟的庄稼一捆带给祭司；
refs.text_big5: 你要對以色列人說，你們進了我賜給你們的地，收割莊稼的時候，要將初熟的莊稼一捆帶給祭司；
refs.text_en: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When you come into the land which I am giving you, and reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest;

refs.text_gb: 他要把这一捆在耶和华面前摇一摇，使你们蒙悦纳；祭司要在安息日的次日把这捆摇一摇。
refs.text_big5: 他要把這一捆在耶和華面前搖一搖，使你們蒙悅納；祭司要在安息日的次日把這捆搖一搖。
refs.text_en: And he shall wave the sheaf before Jehovah for your acceptance; on the day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

refs.text_gb: 摇这捆的日子，你们要把一只一岁、没有残疾的公绵羊羔献给耶和华为燔祭。
refs.text_big5: 搖這捆的日子，你們要把一隻一歲、沒有殘疾的公綿羊羔獻給耶和華為燔祭。
refs.text_en: And on the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb a year old without blemish as a burnt offering to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 同献的素祭，是调油的细面一伊法的十分之二，作为怡爽香气的火祭，献给耶和华。同献的奠祭，是酒一欣的四分之一。
refs.text_big5: 同獻的素祭，是調油的細麵一伊法的十分之二，作為怡爽香氣的火祭，獻給耶和華。同獻的奠祭，是酒一欣的四分之一。
refs.text_en: And its meal offering shall be two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering by fire to Jehovah for a satisfying fragrance. And its drink offering shall be of wine, a fourth of a hin.

refs.text_gb: 无论是饼，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你们都不可吃，直等到把你们献给神的供物带来的那一天，才可以吃。这在你们一切的住处，要作世世代代永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 無論是餅，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你們都不可喫，直等到把你們獻給神的供物帶來的那一天，纔可以喫。這在你們一切的住處，要作世世代代永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: And you shall eat no bread or parched grain or fresh ears until that same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwelling places.

refs.text_gb: 你们要从安息日的次日，献禾捆为摇祭的那日算起，满了七个安息日。
refs.text_big5: 你們要從安息日的次日，獻禾捆為搖祭的那日算起，滿了七個安息日。
refs.text_en: And you shall count for yourselves from the day after the Sabbath; from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering there shall be seven complete Sabbaths.

refs.text_gb: 到第七个安息日的次日，共计五十天，再要将新素祭献给耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 到第七個安息日的次日，共計五十天，再要將新素祭獻給耶和華。
refs.text_en: You shall count fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath; then you shall present a new meal offering to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 要从你们的住处带来两个摇祭的饼，是用细面一伊法的十分之二加酵烤成的，当作初熟之物献给耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 要從你們的住處帶來兩個搖祭的餅，是用細麵一伊法的十分之二加酵烤成的，當作初熟之物獻給耶和華。
refs.text_en: You shall bring out of your dwelling places two loaves as a wave offering; they shall be of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with leaven, as firstfruits to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 又要将没有残疾、一岁的羊羔七只、公牛犊一只、公绵羊两只，和饼一同奉上；这些与同献的素祭和奠祭要作为燔祭献给耶和华，就是作怡爽香气的火祭献给耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 又要將沒有殘疾、一歲的羊羔七隻、公牛犢一隻、公綿羊兩隻，和餅一同奉上；這些與同獻的素祭和奠祭要作為燔祭獻給耶和華，就是作怡爽香氣的火祭獻給耶和華。
refs.text_en: And you shall present with the bread seven lambs, a year old without blemish, and one bull of the herd and two rams; they shall be a burnt offering to Jehovah with their meal offering and their drink offerings, an offering by fire for a satisfying fragrance to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 你们要献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，两只一岁的公绵羊羔作平安祭。
refs.text_big5: 你們要獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，兩隻一歲的公綿羊羔作平安祭。
refs.text_en: And you shall offer one male goat for a sin offering and two male lambs, a year old, for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要把这些和初熟之物作的饼，连同两只公绵羊羔，一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这些是归耶和华为圣，给与祭司的。
refs.text_big5: 祭司要把這些和初熟之物作的餅，連同兩隻公綿羊羔，一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這些是歸耶和華為聖，給與祭司的。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits as a wave offering before Jehovah with the two lambs; they shall be holy to Jehovah for the priest.

refs.text_gb: 当这日，你们要宣告有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可作。这在你们一切的住处，要作世世代代永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 當這日，你們要宣告有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可作。這在你們一切的住處，要作世世代代永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a proclamation on that same day; you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no work of labor. It shall be a perpetual statute in all your dwelling places throughout your generations.

refs.text_gb: 你们收割地的庄稼时，不可割尽田角，也不可拾取收割时所遗落的，要留给穷人和寄居的；我是耶和华你们的神。
refs.text_big5: 你們收割地的莊稼時，不可割盡田角，也不可拾取收割時所遺落的，要留給窮人和寄居的；我是耶和華你們的神。
refs.text_en: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap the corners of your field, nor shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest; you shall leave them for the poor and for the sojourner; I am Jehovah your God.

refs.text_gb: 在七七节，庄稼初熟，你们献新素祭给耶和华的日子，当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可作。
refs.text_big5: 在七七節，莊稼初熟，你們獻新素祭給耶和華的日子，當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可作。
refs.text_en: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when you present a new meal offering to Jehovah in your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no work of labor;

refs.text_gb: 你要计算七个七日：从你开镰收割禾稼时算起，共计七个七日。
refs.text_big5: 你要計算七個七日：從你開鐮收割禾稼時算起，共計七個七日。
refs.text_en: You shall count off for yourself seven weeks. You shall begin to count the seven weeks from the time that you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.

refs.text_gb: 你要照耶和华你神所赐你的福，手里拿着你所要献上足量的甘心祭，向耶和华你的神守七七节。
refs.text_big5: 你要照耶和華你神所賜你的福，手裏拿著你所要獻上足量的甘心祭，向耶和華你的神守七七節。
refs.text_en: And you shall hold the Feast of Weeks to Jehovah your God according to the sufficiency of the freewill offering of your hand, which you will give, as Jehovah your God blesses you.

refs.text_gb: 又要守收割节，所收割的是你田间所种、劳碌得来的初熟之物；也要在年底从田里收藏你劳碌得来之物时，守收藏节。
refs.text_big5: 又要守收割節，所收割的是你田間所種、勞碌得來的初熟之物；也要在年底從田裏收藏你勞碌得來之物時，守收藏節。
refs.text_en: And you shall keep the Feast of the Harvest, of the firstfruits of your labors from what you sow in the fruit of the field, and the Feast of Ingathering, at the end of the year when you gather in your labors out of the field.

refs.text_gb: 七月十五日，你们当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可作，要向耶和华守节七日。
refs.text_big5: 七月十五日，你們當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可作，要向耶和華守節七日。
refs.text_en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no work of labor, and you shall hold a feast to Jehovah seven days.

refs.text_gb: 你从禾场、酒醡收藏了出产以后，就要守住棚节七日。
refs.text_big5: 你從禾場、酒醡收藏了出產以後，就要守住棚節七日。
refs.text_en: You shall hold the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after your ingathering from your threshing floor and your winepress.

refs.text_gb: 守节的时候，你和你的儿子、女儿、仆人、婢女，并你城里的利未人，以及寄居的与孤儿寡妇，都要欢乐。
refs.text_big5: 守節的時候，你和你的兒子、女兒、僕人、婢女，並你城裏的利未人，以及寄居的與孤兒寡婦，都要歡樂。
refs.text_en: And you and your son and daughter, and your male servant and female servant, and the Levite and the sojourner and the orphan and the widow who are within your gates shall rejoice in your feast.

refs.text_gb: 在耶和华所选择的地方，你当向耶和华你的神守节七日；因为耶和华你神在你一切的出产上，和你手所办的一切事上，要赐福与你，你就十分欢乐。
refs.text_big5: 在耶和華所選擇的地方，你當向耶和華你的神守節七日；因為耶和華你神在你一切的出產上，和你手所辦的一切事上，要賜福與你，你就十分歡樂。
refs.text_en: You shall keep the feast to Jehovah your God for seven days in the place which Jehovah will choose, for Jehovah your God will bless you in all your produce and in all your undertakings; therefore you shall be nothing but joyful.

verses.text_gb: 你所有的男丁，要[Fn1][Cra]一年三次朝见主耶和华以色列的神。
verses.text_big5: 你所有的男丁，要[Fn1][Cra]一年三次朝見主耶和華以色列的神。
verses.text_en: Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你所有的男丁，要一年三次朝见主耶和华以色列的神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你所有的男丁，要一年三次朝見主耶和華以色列的神。

footnotes.zh: 以色列人是年年过节，周周守安息日(21)。然而这应当是描绘我们每天对基督的经历。我们每天都该享受基督作本章所提到的三个节期，并且一天多次停下我们的工作，与基督一同安息而记念祂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 以色列人是年年過節，週週守安息日。（21。）然而這應當是描繪我們每天對基督的經歷。我們每天都該享受基督作本章所題到的三個節期，並且一天多次停下我們的工作，與基督一同安息而記念祂。
footnotes.en: 34:23 1 Three For the children of Israel the feasts were held yearly and the Sabbath (v. 21) was kept weekly. However, this should be a portrait of our daily experience of Christ. Every day we should enjoy Christ as the three feasts mentioned in this chapter, and many times during the day we should cease from our work and rest with Christ in remembrance of Him.

refs.text_gb: 一年三次，你要向我守节。
refs.text_big5: 一年三次，你要向我守節。
refs.text_en: Three times a year you shall hold a feast to Me.

refs.text_gb: 你所有的男丁，要一年三次朝见主耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 你所有的男丁，要一年三次朝見主耶和華。
refs.text_en: Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 你一切的男丁，要在除酵节、七七节、住棚节，一年三次，在耶和华你神所选择的地方朝见祂。他们不可空手朝见耶和华；
refs.text_big5: 你一切的男丁，要在除酵節、七七節、住棚節，一年三次，在耶和華你神所選擇的地方朝見祂。他們不可空手朝見耶和華；
refs.text_en: Three times a year all your males shall appear before Jehovah your God in the place which He will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Tabernacles. And they shall not appear before Jehovah empty-handed;

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]因我要从你面前[Fn2][Cra]赶出外邦人，[Crb]扩张你的境界；你一年三次上去朝见耶和华你神的时候，必没有人贪图你的地土。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]因我要從你面前[Fn2][Cra]趕出外邦人，[Crb]擴張你的境界；你一年三次上去朝見耶和華你神的時候，必沒有人貪圖你的地土。
verses.text_en: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders, and no one shall covet your land when you go up to appear before Jehovah your God three times in the year.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因我要从你面前赶出外邦人，扩张你的境界；你一年三次上去朝见耶和华你神的时候，必没有人贪图你的地土。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因我要從你面前趕出外邦人，擴張你的境界；你一年三次上去朝見耶和華你神的時候，必沒有人貪圖你的地土。

footnotes.zh: 本节说出神的子民需要与祂一同守节，并与祂一同安息的原因。要与仇敌争战，并使仇敌远离我们，最好的路就是享受主。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本節說出神的子民需要與祂一同守節，並與祂一同安息的原因。要與仇敵爭戰，並使仇敵遠離我們，最好的路就是享受主。
footnotes.en: 34:24 1 For This verse gives the reason that God's people need to feast with Him and rest with Him. The best way to fight against the enemy and to keep the enemy away from us is to enjoy the Lord.

footnotes.zh: 赶出外邦人，表征毁坏那些霸占、篡夺我们的事物(见二三23注1)；扩张美地的境界，表征扩充我们享受基督的度量(代上四10与注)；使贪图我们地土的仇敌远离，表征护卫我们对基督的享受。
footnotes.en: 34:24 2 drive The driving out of the nations signifies the demolishing of the things that preoccupy and usurp us (see note 23 1 in ch. 23); the enlarging of the borders of the good land signifies the enlarging of our capacity to enjoy Christ (1 Chron. 4:10 and note); and the keeping away of the coveting enemies signifies the guarding of the enjoyment of Christ.

refs.text_gb: 我要打发大黄蜂在你前面，把希未人、迦南人、赫人从你面前撵出去。
refs.text_big5: 我要打發大黃蜂在你前面，把希未人、迦南人、赫人從你面前攆出去。
refs.text_en: And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites from before you.

refs.text_gb: 我不在一年之内将他们从你面前撵出去，免得地变荒凉，田野的兽多起来害你。
refs.text_big5: 我不在一年之內將他們從你面前攆出去，免得地變荒涼，田野的獸多起來害你。
refs.text_en: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate and the animals of the field multiply against you.

refs.text_gb: 我要渐渐地将他们从你面前撵出去，直等你繁衍加多，承受那地为业。
refs.text_big5: 我要漸漸的將他們從你面前攆出去，直等你繁衍加多，承受那地為業。
refs.text_en: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have become fruitful and inherit the land.

refs.text_gb: 祂在他们面前赶出外邦人，用绳子将外邦的地量给他们，拈阄分给他们为业，叫以色列支派的人在那里住在他们的帐棚里。
refs.text_big5: 祂在他們面前趕出外邦人，用繩子將外邦的地量給他們，拈鬮分給他們為業，叫以色列支派的人在那裏住在他們的帳棚裏。
refs.text_en: And He drove out the nations before them / And allotted them as an inheritance by line, / And He made the tribes of Israel dwell there in their tents.

refs.text_gb: 你从埃及挪出一棵葡萄树，赶出外邦人，把这树栽上。
refs.text_big5: 你從埃及挪出一棵葡萄樹，趕出外邦人，把這樹栽上。
refs.text_en: You brought a vine out of Egypt; / You drove out nations and planted it;

refs.text_gb: 我要定你的境界，从红海直到非利士海，又从旷野直到大河；我要将那地的居民交在你手中，你要将他们从你面前撵出去。
refs.text_big5: 我要定你的境界，從紅海直到非利士海，又從曠野直到大河；我要將那地的居民交在你手中，你要將他們從你面前攆出去。
refs.text_en: And I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out from before you.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华你的神，照祂所应许扩张你境界的时候，你心里想要吃肉，说，我要吃肉，就可以随心所欲地吃肉。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華你的神，照祂所應許擴張你境界的時候，你心裏想要喫肉，說，我要喫肉，就可以隨心所欲的喫肉。
refs.text_en: When Jehovah your God enlarges your territory, as He has promised you, and you say, I will eat meat, because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat according to all that your soul desires.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华你神若照祂向你列祖所起的誓，扩张你的境界，将所应许赐你列祖的地全然给你；
refs.text_big5: 耶和華你神若照祂向你列祖所起的誓，擴張你的境界，將所應許賜你列祖的地全然給你；
refs.text_en: And if Jehovah your God enlarges your territory, as He swore to your fathers, and gives you all the land which He promised to give to your fathers;

refs.text_en: But if a stranger sojourns with you and will observe the Passover to Jehovah, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near to observe it; and he will be like one who is a native of the land. But no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

refs.text_en: These are they who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are they who follow the Lamb wherever He may go. These were purchased from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.

refs.text_gb: 地里首先初熟之物，要带到耶和华你神的殿中。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
refs.text_big5: 地裏首先初熟之物，要帶到耶和華你神的殿中。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
refs.text_en: The first of the firstfruits of your ground you shall bring into the house of Jehovah your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

refs.text_gb: 凡自死的，你们都不可吃，可以给你城里寄居的吃，或卖与外人，因为你是归耶和华你神的圣别子民。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
refs.text_big5: 凡自死的，你們都不可喫，可以給你城裏寄居的喫，或賣與外人，因為你是歸耶和華你神的聖別子民。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
refs.text_en: You shall not eat any carcass; to the sojourner who is within your gates you may give it that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner. For you are a holy people to Jehovah your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你要将这些话写上，因为我是按[Fn1]这些话与你和以色列人立[Cra]约的。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你要將這些話寫上，因為我是按[Fn1]這些話與你和以色列人立[Cra]約的。
verses.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, Write these words, for according to the speaking of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，你要将这些话写上，因为我是按这些话与你和以色列人立约的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，你要將這些話寫上，因為我是按這些話與你和以色列人立約的。

footnotes.zh: 直译，这些话的口。神在这一章的说话乃是重复祂在二十～二三章所说的。这重复说话的中心点不在于遵守十诫和律法的典章，乃在于享受美地的丰富，并一再与神一同守节、一同安息，借此享受神。这符合新约教训的中心点，主要是论到享受基督(林前一9，五8)。神的心意不是仅仅要得着一班人来遵守祂的诫命和典章。神的心意乃是要将祂自己分赐到祂所拣选的人里面，使他们完全被祂注入，好彰显祂(见29注1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，這些話的口。神在這一章的說話乃是重複祂在二十～二三章所說的。這重複說話的中心點不在於遵守十誡和律法的典章，乃在於享受美地的豐富，並一再與神一同守節、一同安息，藉此享受神。這符合新約教訓的中心點，主要是論到享受基督。（林前一9，五8。）神的心意不是僅僅要得著一班人來遵守祂的誡命和典章。神的心意乃是要將祂自己分賜到祂所揀選的人裏面，使他們完全被祂注入，好彰顯祂。（見29註1。）
footnotes.en: 34:27 1 speaking Lit., mouth. God's speaking in this chapter is a repetition of what He spoke in chs. 20—23. The focus of this repeated speaking is not on the keeping of the Ten Commandments and the ordinances of the law but on the enjoyment of God through the enjoyment of the riches of the good land and the repeated feasting and resting with Him. This matches the focus of the New Testament teaching, which is concerned primarily with the enjoyment of Christ (1 Cor. 1:9; 5:8). It was not God's intention merely to have a people to keep His commandments and ordinances. God's intention was to dispense Himself into His chosen people so that they would be fully infused with Him in order to express Him (see note Exo. 34:29 1 ).

refs.text_gb: 耶和华说，看哪，我要立约。我要在你的众百姓面前行奇事，是在全地万国中所未曾行的。在你四围的众民，就要看见耶和华的作为，因我要向你行的是可畏惧的事。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華說，看哪，我要立約。我要在你的眾百姓面前行奇事，是在全地萬國中所未曾行的。在你四圍的眾民，就要看見耶和華的作為，因我要向你行的是可畏懼的事。
refs.text_en: And He said, Now I hereby make a covenant: Before all your people I will perform wonders such as have not been produced in all the earth, nor among any of the nations; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of Jehovah, for it is an awesome thing that I will do with you.

refs.text_gb: 祂将所吩咐你们遵行的约，就是十条诫命，向你们宣示，并将这些话写在两块石版上。
refs.text_big5: 祂將所吩咐你們遵行的約，就是十條誡命，向你們宣示，並將這些話寫在兩塊石版上。
refs.text_en: And He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to do, the Ten Commandments; and He wrote them upon two tablets of stone.

refs.text_gb: 摩西将这律法写下来，交给抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未子孙，和以色列的众长老。

refs.text_en: And Moses wrote this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who bear the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah, and to all the elders of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 摩西进入云中上了山，在山上四十昼四十夜。
refs.text_big5: 摩西進入雲中上了山，在山上四十晝四十夜。
refs.text_en: And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

refs.text_gb: 我上了山，要领受两块石版，就是耶和华与你们立约的版；那时我在山上住了四十昼四十夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。
refs.text_big5: 我上了山，要領受兩塊石版，就是耶和華與你們立約的版；那時我在山上住了四十晝四十夜，沒有喫飯，也沒有喝水。
refs.text_en: When I went up to the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the Tablets of the Covenant which Jehovah made with you, I remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I did not eat food nor drink water.

refs.text_gb: 因你们所犯的一切罪，你们行了耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹祂发怒，我就像从前那样，俯伏在耶和华面前四十昼四十夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。
refs.text_big5: 因你們所犯的一切罪，你們行了耶和華眼中看為惡的事，惹祂發怒，我就像從前那樣，俯伏在耶和華面前四十晝四十夜，沒有喫飯，也沒有喝水。
refs.text_en: Then I threw myself down before Jehovah as at the beginning, forty days and forty nights; I did not eat food nor drink water, because of all your sin which you had sinned by doing that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah so as to anger Him.

refs.text_gb: 祂禁食了四十昼四十夜，后来就饿了。
refs.text_big5: 祂禁食了四十晝四十夜，後來就餓了。
refs.text_en: And when He had fasted forty days and forty nights, afterward He became hungry.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，你要凿出两块石版，和先前的一样；先前你摔碎的版，其上的字我要写在这两块版上。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，你要鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣；先前你摔碎的版，其上的字我要寫在這兩塊版上。
refs.text_en: Then Jehovah said to Moses, Cut two tablets of stone like the first ones, and I will write upon the tablets the words which were on the first tablets, which you shattered.

refs.text_gb: 版是神作的；字是神写的，刻在版上。
refs.text_big5: 版是神作的；字是神寫的，刻在版上。
refs.text_en: And the tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved upon the tablets.

refs.text_gb: 祂将所吩咐你们遵行的约，就是十条诫命，向你们宣示，并将这些话写在两块石版上。
refs.text_big5: 祂將所吩咐你們遵行的約，就是十條誡命，向你們宣示，並將這些話寫在兩塊石版上。
refs.text_en: And He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to do, the Ten Commandments; and He wrote them upon two tablets of stone.

refs.text_gb: 你先前摔碎的版，其上的字我要写在这两块版上；你要将这两块版放在柜里。
refs.text_big5: 你先前摔碎的版，其上的字我要寫在這兩塊版上；你要將這兩塊版放在櫃裏。
refs.text_en: And I will write upon the tablets the words which were on the first tablets, which you shattered; and you shall place them in the Ark.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华将祂在大会之日，在山上从火中对你们所说的十条诫命，照先前所写的，写在这两块版上，将版交给了我。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華將祂在大會之日，在山上從火中對你們所說的十條誡命，照先前所寫的，寫在這兩塊版上，將版交給了我。
refs.text_en: And He wrote upon the tablets as He had done the first writing, the Ten Commandments, which Jehovah spoke to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly; and Jehovah gave them to me.

verses.text_gb: 摩西手里拿着两块[Cra]见证的版，下西乃山的时候，不知道自己的[Crb]面皮因[Fn1]耶和华和他说话就发了光。

verses.text_en: And when Moses came down from Mount Sinai-and the two tablets of the Testimony were in Moses' hand when he came down from the mountain-Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone by reason of His speaking with him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西手里拿着两块见证的版，下西乃山的时候，不知道自己的面皮因耶和华和他说话就发了光。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西手裏拿著兩塊見證的版，下西乃山的時候，不知道自己的面皮因耶和華和他說話就發了光。

footnotes.zh: 或，他和耶和华说话。参民七89。摩西长久与神同在期间，借着神对他说话，他就完全被神注入并浸透。结果，摩西的面皮发光。按照本章，神不是先给摩西法版；祂乃是先花时间对摩西讲到对祂自己的享受，而以祂自己灌注摩西(参林后三3)。神颁赐律法给摩西之前，先将自己给了摩西。这清楚描绘出神的心意。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，他和耶和華說話。參民七89。摩西長久與神同在期間，藉著神對他說話，他就完全被神注入並浸透。結果，摩西的面皮發光。按照本章，神不是先給摩西法版；祂乃是先花時間對摩西講到對祂自己的享受，而以祂自己灌注摩西。（參林後三3。）神頒賜律法給摩西之前，先將自己給了摩西。這清楚描繪出神的心意。
footnotes.en: 34:29 1 His Or, his (Moses') speaking with Him (Jehovah); cf. Num. 7:89. Through God's speaking to Moses during his lengthy stay with God, Moses was thoroughly infused with God and saturated with Him. As a result, Moses' face shone. According to this chapter, God did not first give Moses the tablets of the law; rather, He first spent time to infuse Moses with Himself by speaking to Moses concerning the enjoyment of Himself (cf. 2 Cor. 3:3). Before God gave the law to Moses, God gave Himself to him. This clearly portrays God's intention.

footnotes.zh: 论到守安息日的这话，是在嘱咐制造帐幕及其器物和祭司的衣服之前，指明神的子民在为神作工以前，必须先与祂一同安息。先为神作工，然后享受恩典与安息，那是照着律法的作法。照着恩典，我们乃是先享受恩典，与主一同安息，然后才为祂作工(参林前十五10)。见三一13注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 論到守安息日的這話，是在囑咐製造帳幕及其器物和祭司的衣服之前，指明神的子民在為神作工以前，必須先與祂一同安息。先為神作工，然後享受恩典與安息，那是照著律法的作法。照著恩典，我們乃是先享受恩典，與主一同安息，然後纔為祂作工。（參林前十五10。）見三一13註1。
footnotes.en: 35:2 1 Sabbath This word concerning the keeping of the Sabbath, coming before the commandments concerning the making of the tabernacle with its furniture and the garments for the priests, indicates that before God's people work for Him, they must rest with Him. The way of first working for God and then enjoying grace and rest is according to the law. According to grace, we first enjoy grace and rest with the Lord; then we work for Him (cf. 1 Cor. 15:10). See note Exo. 31:13 1 .

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]你们中间要拿[Fn2]举祭给耶和华，凡[Cra]心中乐意的，可以拿耶和华的举祭来，就是金、银、铜，

verses.text_en: Take from among yourselves a heave offering to Jehovah; whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, the heave offering of Jehovah: gold and silver and bronze,

footnotes.en: 35:5 1 Take For vv. 5-9, see notes in Exo. 25:2-7.

footnotes.zh: 这些为着建造帐幕献给神的材料，虽然是以色列人在埃及得着的(十二35～36)，却称为举祭、摇祭、甘心祭(5，21～22，24，29，三六3)。这一切供物乃是预表基督不同的方面，为神的子民在实际的日常生活中所经历、享受并得着，然后献上给神。见二五2注1一段。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這些為著建造帳幕獻給神的材料，雖然是以色列人在埃及得著的，（十二35～36，）卻稱為舉祭、搖祭、甘心祭。（5，21～22，24，29，三六3。）這一切供物乃是豫表基督不同的方面，為神的子民在實際的日常生活中所經歷、享受並得著，然後獻上給神。見二五2註1一段。
footnotes.en: 35:5 2 heave Although they were gained by the children of Israel while they were in Egypt (Exo. 12:35-36), the materials offered to God for the building of the tabernacle were called heave offerings, wave offerings, and freewill offerings (vv. 5, 21-22, 24, 29; 36:3). All these offerings are types of Christ in different aspects experienced, enjoyed, and gained by God's people in their practical daily lives, and then offered by them to God. See note Exo. 25:2 1 , par. 1.

refs.text_gb: 你吩咐以色列人，当为我拿举祭来；凡甘心乐意的，你们就可以从他收下归我。

refs.text_en: Tell the children of Israel to take for Me a heave offering. From every man whose heart makes him willing you shall take My heave offering.

verses.text_en: And let every man who is wise in heart among you come and make all that Jehovah has commanded:

refs.text_gb: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦作衣服，使他分别为圣，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的靈所充滿的，給亞倫作衣服，使他分別為聖，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall speak to all who are wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron's garments to sanctify him, that he may serve Me as a priest.

refs.text_gb: 我已经亲自分派但支派中，亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯与他同工；凡心中有智慧的，我已赐他们心中有智慧，能作我所吩咐你的一切，
refs.text_big5: 我已經親自分派但支派中，亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯與他同工；凡心中有智慧的，我已賜他們心中有智慧，能作我所吩咐你的一切，
refs.text_en: And now, I Myself have appointed with him Oholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise in heart I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

verses.text_gb: 就是[Cra]帐幕和帐幕的[Crb]罩棚，并帐幕的盖、扣钩、板、闩、柱子和卯座，

verses.text_en: The tabernacle, its tent, and its covering; its clasps and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.text_gb_plain: 就是帐幕和帐幕的罩棚，并帐幕的盖、扣钩、板、闩、柱子和卯座，
verses.text_big5_plain: 就是帳幕和帳幕的罩棚，並帳幕的蓋、扣鉤、板、閂、柱子和卯座，

refs.text_gb: 就是会幕、见证的柜和其上的遮罪盖、会幕的一切器具，
refs.text_big5: 就是會幕、見證的櫃和其上的遮罪蓋、會幕的一切器具，
refs.text_en: The Tent of Meeting, and the Ark of the Testimony and the expiation cover that is on it, and all the utensils of the tent,

refs.text_gb: 桌子和桌子的器具、纯金的灯台和灯台的一切器具、香坛，
refs.text_big5: 桌子和桌子的器具、純金的燈臺和燈臺的一切器具、香壇，
refs.text_en: And the table and its utensils, and the pure lampstand with all its utensils, and the altar of incense,

refs.text_gb: 燔祭坛和坛的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座，
refs.text_big5: 燔祭壇和壇的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座，
refs.text_en: And the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the laver and its base,

refs.text_gb: 精工作的衣服，就是祭司亚伦的圣衣，和他儿子们用以作祭司事奉的衣服，
refs.text_big5: 精工作的衣服，就是祭司亞倫的聖衣，和他兒子們用以作祭司事奉的衣服，
refs.text_en: And the finely worked garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for them to serve as priests,

refs.text_gb: 膏油和供圣所用馨香香料的香。他们都要照我所吩咐你的一切去作。
refs.text_big5: 膏油和供聖所用馨香香料的香。他們都要照我所吩咐你的一切去作。
refs.text_en: And the anointing oil, and the incense of fragrant spices for the sanctuary. According to all that I have commanded you, they shall do.

refs.text_gb: 他们送到摩西那里的，有帐幕、罩棚、和帐幕的一切物件，就是扣钩、板、闩、柱子和卯座，
refs.text_big5: 他們送到摩西那裏的，有帳幕、罩棚、和帳幕的一切物件，就是扣鉤、板、閂、柱子和卯座，
refs.text_en: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars and its sockets;

refs.text_gb: 染红公羊皮的盖、海狗皮的顶盖、和遮掩柜的幔子，
refs.text_big5: 染紅公羊皮的蓋、海狗皮的頂蓋、和遮掩櫃的幔子，
refs.text_en: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red and the covering of porpoise skins, and the veil of the screen;

refs.text_gb: 见证的柜、柜的杠、和遮罪盖，
refs.text_big5: 見證的櫃、櫃的槓、和遮罪蓋，
refs.text_en: The Ark of the Testimony and its poles and the expiation cover;

refs.text_gb: 桌子、桌子的一切器具、和陈设饼，
refs.text_big5: 桌子、桌子的一切器具、和陳設餅，
refs.text_en: The table, all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;

refs.text_gb: 纯金的灯台、摆列的灯盏、灯台的一切器具、和点灯的油，
refs.text_big5: 純金的燈臺、擺列的燈盞、燈臺的一切器具、和點燈的油，
refs.text_en: The pure lampstand, its lamps, even the lamps set in order, and all its utensils, and the oil for the light;

refs.text_gb: 金坛，膏油和馨香的香，并会幕门口的帘子，
refs.text_big5: 金壇，膏油和馨香的香，並會幕門口的簾子，
refs.text_en: And the golden altar and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense and the screen for the entrance of the tent;

refs.text_gb: 铜坛、坛的铜网、坛的杠和坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
refs.text_big5: 銅壇、壇的銅網、壇的槓和壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
refs.text_en: The bronze altar, and its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils; the laver and its base;

refs.text_gb: 院子的帷子、帷子的柱子和卯座，院子的门帘、绳子、橛子，并会幕之帐幕一切供事奉使用的器具，
refs.text_big5: 院子的帷子、帷子的柱子和卯座，院子的門簾、繩子、橛子，並會幕之帳幕一切供事奉使用的器具，
refs.text_en: The hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets; and the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, and its pegs; and all the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting;

refs.text_gb: 在圣所供职用的精工作的衣服，就是祭司亚伦的圣衣，和他儿子们用以作祭司事奉的衣服。
refs.text_big5: 在聖所供職用的精工作的衣服，就是祭司亞倫的聖衣，和他兒子們用以作祭司事奉的衣服。
refs.text_en: The finely worked garments for ministering in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for them to serve as priests.

refs.text_gb: 这一切工作，耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就照样作。
refs.text_big5: 這一切工作，耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就照樣作。
refs.text_en: According to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

refs.text_gb: 你要用十幅幕幔作帐幕；这些幕幔要用捻的细麻，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线制造，并用巧匠的手工，绣上基路伯。
refs.text_big5: 你要用十幅幕幔作帳幕；這些幕幔要用撚的細麻，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線製造，並用巧匠的手工，繡上基路伯。
refs.text_en: Now the tabernacle you shall make with ten curtains of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet strands; you shall make them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

refs.text_gb: 每幅幕幔要长二十八肘，宽四肘，幕幔都要一样的尺寸。
refs.text_big5: 每幅幕幔要長二十八肘，寬四肘，幕幔都要一樣的尺寸。
refs.text_en: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain, four cubits; all the curtains shall have the same measurement.

refs.text_gb: 五幅幕幔要幅幅相连，另五幅幕幔也要幅幅相连。
refs.text_big5: 五幅幕幔要幅幅相連，另五幅幕幔也要幅幅相連。
refs.text_en: Five curtains shall be joined to one another; and the other five curtains shall be joined to one another.

refs.text_gb: 在这相连幕幔的末幅边缘，要作蓝色的钮眼；在那相连幕幔的末幅边缘内，也要照样作。
refs.text_big5: 在這相連幕幔的末幅邊緣，要作藍色的鈕眼；在那相連幕幔的末幅邊緣內，也要照樣作。
refs.text_en: And you shall make loops of blue strands on the edge of the one curtain at the end in the set; and likewise you shall make them in the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.

refs.text_gb: 在这相连的幕幔上，要作五十个钮眼；在那相连幕幔的边缘，也要作五十个钮眼；都要两两相对。
refs.text_big5: 在這相連的幕幔上，要作五十個鈕眼；在那相連幕幔的邊緣，也要作五十個鈕眼；都要兩兩相對。
refs.text_en: You shall make fifty loops on the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set; the loops shall be opposite one another.

refs.text_gb: 又要作五十个金扣钩，用扣钩使幕幔彼此相连，成为一整个帐幕。
refs.text_big5: 又要作五十個金扣鉤，用扣鉤使幕幔彼此相連，成為一整個帳幕。
refs.text_en: And you shall make fifty clasps of gold, and join the curtains to one another with the clasps, so that the tabernacle may become one.

refs.text_gb: 你要用山羊毛织十一幅幕幔，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。
refs.text_big5: 你要用山羊毛織十一幅幕幔，作為帳幕以上的罩棚。
refs.text_en: And you shall make curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains you shall make in all.

refs.text_gb: 每幅幕幔要长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幕幔都要一样的尺寸。
refs.text_big5: 每幅幕幔要長三十肘，寬四肘；十一幅幕幔都要一樣的尺寸。
refs.text_en: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain, four cubits; the eleven curtains shall have the same measurement.

refs.text_gb: 要把五幅幕幔连成一幅，又把六幅幕幔连成一幅；这第六幅幕幔，要在罩棚的前面对摺上去。
refs.text_big5: 要把五幅幕幔連成一幅，又把六幅幕幔連成一幅；這第六幅幕幔，要在罩棚的前面對摺上去。
refs.text_en: And you shall join five of the curtains by themselves and six of the curtains by themselves, and you shall double the sixth curtain over at the front of the tent.

refs.text_gb: 在这相连幕幔的末幅边缘，要作五十个钮眼；在那相连幕幔的末幅边缘，也要作五十个钮眼。
refs.text_big5: 在這相連幕幔的末幅邊緣，要作五十個鈕眼；在那相連幕幔的末幅邊緣，也要作五十個鈕眼。
refs.text_en: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the set, and fifty loops upon the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second set.

refs.text_gb: 又要作五十个铜扣钩，穿在钮眼中，使罩棚连成一整个。
refs.text_big5: 又要作五十個銅扣鉤，穿在鈕眼中，使罩棚連成一整個。
refs.text_en: And you shall make fifty clasps of bronze and put the clasps into the loops and join the tent together, so that it may become one.

refs.text_gb: 罩棚的幕幔所余那垂下来的部分，就是所余的半幅幕幔，要垂在帐幕的后面。
refs.text_big5: 罩棚的幕幔所餘那垂下來的部分，就是所餘的半幅幕幔，要垂在帳幕的後面。
refs.text_en: And the overlapping part that is left over of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that is left over, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

refs.text_gb: 罩棚的幕幔所余长的，这边一肘，那边一肘，要垂在帐幕的两边，遮盖帐幕。
refs.text_big5: 罩棚的幕幔所餘長的，這邊一肘，那邊一肘，要垂在帳幕的兩邊，遮蓋帳幕。
refs.text_en: And the cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of what is left over in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle, on this side and on that side, to cover it.

refs.text_gb: 又要用染红的公羊皮作罩棚的盖；再用海狗皮作罩棚上的顶盖。
refs.text_big5: 又要用染紅的公羊皮作罩棚的蓋；再用海狗皮作罩棚上的頂蓋。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a covering for the tent, of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of porpoise skins above it.

refs.text_gb: 你要用皂荚木作帐幕的竖板。
refs.text_big5: 你要用皂莢木作帳幕的豎板。
refs.text_en: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

refs.text_gb: 每块要长十肘，宽一肘半。
refs.text_big5: 每塊要長十肘，寬一肘半。
refs.text_en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits, the width of each board.

refs.text_gb: 每块必有两榫相接；帐幕一切的板都要这样作。
refs.text_big5: 每塊必有兩榫相接；帳幕一切的板都要這樣作。
refs.text_en: Each board shall have two tenons, joined to one another; thus you shall do for all the boards of the tabernacle.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕的南面要作二十块板。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕的南面要作二十塊板。
refs.text_en: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

refs.text_gb: 在这二十块板底下，要作四十个银卯座；这块板下有两个卯座接板上的两榫，那块板下也有两个卯座接板上的两榫。
refs.text_big5: 在這二十塊板底下，要作四十個銀卯座；這塊板下有兩個卯座接板上的兩榫，那塊板下也有兩個卯座接板上的兩榫。
refs.text_en: And you shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards, two sockets under one board for its two tenons and two sockets under the next board for its two tenons.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕第二面，就是北面，也要作二十块板，
refs.text_big5: 帳幕第二面，就是北面，也要作二十塊板，
refs.text_en: And for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards;

refs.text_gb: 和四十个银卯座；这块板下有两个卯座，那块板下也有两个卯座。
refs.text_big5: 和四十個銀卯座；這塊板下有兩個卯座，那塊板下也有兩個卯座。
refs.text_en: And their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under one board and two sockets under the next board.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，要作六块板。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕的後面，就是西面，要作六塊板。
refs.text_en: And for the rear of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕后面的拐角，要作两块板。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕後面的拐角，要作兩塊板。
refs.text_en: And two boards you shall make for the corners of the tabernacle in the rear.

refs.text_gb: 板下方要双的，板顶端要完全连于一个环子；两块都要这样，用于两个拐角。
refs.text_big5: 板下方要雙的，板頂端要完全連於一個環子；兩塊都要這樣，用於兩個拐角。
refs.text_en: And they shall be double below, and at its top they shall be completely joined to a single ring; thus it shall be for both of them; they shall be for the two corners.

refs.text_gb: 必有八块板和十六个银卯座；这块板下有两个卯座，那块板下也有两个卯座。
refs.text_big5: 必有八塊板和十六個銀卯座；這塊板下有兩個卯座，那塊板下也有兩個卯座。
refs.text_en: And there shall be eight boards with their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board and two sockets under the next board.

refs.text_gb: 你要用皂荚木作闩，为帐幕这面的板作五条闩，
refs.text_big5: 你要用皂莢木作閂，為帳幕這面的板作五條閂，
refs.text_en: And you shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

refs.text_gb: 为帐幕那面的板作五条闩，又为帐幕后面朝西的板作五条闩。
refs.text_big5: 為帳幕那面的板作五條閂，又為帳幕後面朝西的板作五條閂。
refs.text_en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle at the rear westward.

refs.text_gb: 板腰间的中闩，要从这一头通到那一头。
refs.text_big5: 板腰間的中閂，要從這一頭通到那一頭。
refs.text_en: And the middle bar shall pass through in the center of the boards from end to end.

refs.text_gb: 板要用金包裹，又要作板上的金环，用以套闩；闩也要用金包裹。
refs.text_big5: 板要用金包裹，又要作板上的金環，用以套閂；閂也要用金包裹。
refs.text_en: And you shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold as holders for the bars; and you shall overlay the bars with gold.

refs.text_gb: 要照着在山上指示你的样子，立起帐幕。
refs.text_big5: 要照著在山上指示你的樣子，立起帳幕。
refs.text_en: And you shall set up the tabernacle according to its plan, which you were shown in the mountain.

refs.text_gb: 你要用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
refs.text_big5: 你要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen; it shall be made with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

refs.text_gb: 要把幔子挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上，柱子上当有金钩，柱子安在四个银卯座上。
refs.text_big5: 要把幔子掛在四根包金的皂莢木柱子上，柱子上當有金鉤，柱子安在四個銀卯座上。
refs.text_en: And you shall hang it upon four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, and they shall stand on four sockets of silver.

refs.text_gb: 要使幔子垂在扣钩下，把见证的柜抬进幔子内；这幔子要为你们将圣所和至圣所隔开。
refs.text_big5: 要使幔子垂在扣鉤下，把見證的櫃抬進幔子內；這幔子要為你們將聖所和至聖所隔開。
refs.text_en: And you shall hang up the veil under the clasps and bring in the Ark of the Testimony there within the veil; and the veil shall make a separation for you between the Holy Place and the Holy of Holies.

refs.text_gb: 又要把遮罪盖安在至圣所内见证的柜上，
refs.text_big5: 又要把遮罪蓋安在至聖所內見證的櫃上，
refs.text_en: And you shall put the expiation cover upon the Ark of the Testimony in the Holy of Holies.

refs.text_gb: 把桌子放在幔子外帐幕的北面；把灯台放在帐幕的南面，与桌子相对。
refs.text_big5: 把桌子放在幔子外帳幕的北面；把燈臺放在帳幕的南面，與桌子相對。
refs.text_en: And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and the table you shall put on the north side.

refs.text_gb: 你要拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘。
refs.text_big5: 你要拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織帳幕的門簾。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer.

refs.text_gb: 要用皂荚木为帘子作五根柱子，用金包裹；柱子上当有金钩，又要为柱子铸造五个铜卯座。
refs.text_big5: 要用皂莢木為簾子作五根柱子，用金包裹；柱子上當有金鉤，又要為柱子鑄造五個銅卯座。
refs.text_en: And for the screen you shall make five pillars of acacia and overlay them with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, and you shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]柜、柜的杠、遮罪盖、和遮掩柜的[Crb]幔子，
verses.text_big5: [Cra]櫃、櫃的槓、遮罪蓋、和遮掩櫃的[Crb]幔子，
verses.text_en: The Ark and its poles, the expiation cover, and the veil of the screen;
verses.text_gb_plain: 柜、柜的杠、遮罪盖、和遮掩柜的幔子，
verses.text_big5_plain: 櫃、櫃的槓、遮罪蓋、和遮掩櫃的幔子，

refs.text_gb: 他们要用皂荚木作一个柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。
refs.text_big5: 他們要用皂莢木作一個櫃，長二肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘半。
refs.text_en: And they shall make an ark of acacia wood: two and a half cubits shall be its length; and one and a half cubits, its width; and one and a half cubits, its height.

refs.text_gb: 你要把柜里外包上纯金，四围镶上金牙边。
refs.text_big5: 你要把櫃裏外包上純金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
refs.text_en: And you shall overlay it with pure gold; inside and outside you shall overlay it; and you shall make a rim of gold upon it all around.

refs.text_gb: 也要铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上；这边两环，那边两环。
refs.text_big5: 也要鑄四個金環，安在櫃的四腳上；這邊兩環，那邊兩環。
refs.text_en: And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them on its four feet; and two rings shall be on one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

refs.text_gb: 要用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹。
refs.text_big5: 要用皂莢木作兩根槓，用金包裹。
refs.text_en: And you shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

refs.text_gb: 要把杠穿在柜旁的环内，用以抬柜。
refs.text_big5: 要把槓穿在櫃旁的環內，用以抬櫃。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the Ark to carry the Ark with them.

refs.text_gb: 杠要常在柜的环内，不可抽出来。
refs.text_big5: 槓要常在櫃的環內，不可抽出來。
refs.text_en: The poles shall be in the rings of the Ark; they shall not be taken from it.

refs.text_gb: 必将我所要赐给你的见证版，放在柜里。
refs.text_big5: 必將我所要賜給你的見證版，放在櫃裏。
refs.text_en: And you shall put into the Ark the Testimony which I shall give you.

refs.text_gb: 要用纯金作遮罪盖，长二肘半，宽一肘半。
refs.text_big5: 要用純金作遮罪蓋，長二肘半，寬一肘半。
refs.text_en: And you shall make an expiation cover of pure gold: two and a half cubits shall be its length, and one and a half cubits, its width.

refs.text_gb: 要用金子锤出两个基路伯，安在遮罪盖的两端。
refs.text_big5: 要用金子錘出兩個基路伯，安在遮罪蓋的兩端。
refs.text_en: And you shall make two cherubim of gold; of beaten work you shall make them, at the two ends of the expiation cover.

refs.text_gb: 这端作一个基路伯，那端作一个基路伯，两端的基路伯要与遮罪盖接连一块。
refs.text_big5: 這端作一個基路伯，那端作一個基路伯，兩端的基路伯要與遮罪蓋接連一塊。
refs.text_en: And make one cherub at one end and one cherub at the other end; of one piece with the expiation cover you shall make the cherubim on its two ends.

refs.text_gb: 两个基路伯要在盖上展开翅膀，遮掩遮罪盖；基路伯要脸对脸，朝着遮罪盖。
refs.text_big5: 兩個基路伯要在蓋上展開翅膀，遮掩遮罪蓋；基路伯要臉對臉，朝著遮罪蓋。
refs.text_en: And the cherubim shall spread out their wings above the cover, covering the expiation cover with their wings, with their faces toward one another; the faces of the cherubim shall be toward the expiation cover.

refs.text_gb: 要将遮罪盖安在柜的上边，又将我所要赐给你的见证版放在柜里。
refs.text_big5: 要將遮罪蓋安在櫃的上邊，又將我所要賜給你的見證版放在櫃裏。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the expiation cover upon the Ark above it, and into the Ark you shall put the Testimony that I shall give you.

refs.text_gb: 我要在那里与你相会，又要从见证的柜遮罪盖上两个基路伯中间，和你说我所要吩咐你传给以色列人的一切事。
refs.text_big5: 我要在那裏與你相會，又要從見證的櫃遮罪蓋上兩個基路伯中間，和你說我所要吩咐你傳給以色列人的一切事。
refs.text_en: And there I will meet with you, and I will speak with you from above the expiation cover, from between the two cherubim which are upon the Ark of the Testimony, of everything which I will give you in commandment to the children of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 你要用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
refs.text_big5: 你要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen; it shall be made with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

refs.text_gb: 要把幔子挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上，柱子上当有金钩，柱子安在四个银卯座上。
refs.text_big5: 要把幔子掛在四根包金的皂莢木柱子上，柱子上當有金鉤，柱子安在四個銀卯座上。
refs.text_en: And you shall hang it upon four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, and they shall stand on four sockets of silver.

refs.text_gb: 要使幔子垂在扣钩下，把见证的柜抬进幔子内；这幔子要为你们将圣所和至圣所隔开。
refs.text_big5: 要使幔子垂在扣鉤下，把見證的櫃抬進幔子內；這幔子要為你們將聖所和至聖所隔開。
refs.text_en: And you shall hang up the veil under the clasps and bring in the Ark of the Testimony there within the veil; and the veil shall make a separation for you between the Holy Place and the Holy of Holies.

refs.text_gb: 又要把遮罪盖安在至圣所内见证的柜上，
refs.text_big5: 又要把遮罪蓋安在至聖所內見證的櫃上，
refs.text_en: And you shall put the expiation cover upon the Ark of the Testimony in the Holy of Holies.

refs.text_gb: 把桌子放在幔子外帐幕的北面；把灯台放在帐幕的南面，与桌子相对。
refs.text_big5: 把桌子放在幔子外帳幕的北面；把燈臺放在帳幕的南面，與桌子相對。
refs.text_en: And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and the table you shall put on the north side.

refs.text_gb: 把见证的柜安放在里面，用幔子将柜遮掩。
refs.text_big5: 把見證的櫃安放在裏面，用幔子將櫃遮掩。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the Ark of the Testimony there, and you shall screen the Ark with the veil.

refs.text_gb: 把柜抬进帐幕，挂上遮掩柜的幔子，把见证的柜遮掩了；是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
refs.text_big5: 把櫃抬進帳幕，掛上遮掩櫃的幔子，把見證的櫃遮掩了；是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
refs.text_en: And he brought the Ark into the tabernacle and set up the veil for the screen and screened the Ark of the Testimony, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

refs.text_gb: 起营的时候，亚伦和他儿子要进去摘下遮掩柜的幔子，用以蒙盖见证的柜；
refs.text_big5: 起營的時候，亞倫和他兒子要進去摘下遮掩櫃的幔子，用以蒙蓋見證的櫃；
refs.text_en: When the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons shall go in, and they shall take down the veil of the screen and cover the Ark of the Testimony with it,

verses.text_gb: [Cra]桌子、桌子的杠、桌子的一切器具、和[Crb]陈设饼，
verses.text_big5: [Cra]桌子、桌子的槓、桌子的一切器具、和[Crb]陳設餅，
verses.text_en: The table and its poles and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
verses.text_gb_plain: 桌子、桌子的杠、桌子的一切器具、和陈设饼，
verses.text_big5_plain: 桌子、桌子的槓、桌子的一切器具、和陳設餅，

refs.text_gb: 你要用皂荚木作一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半。
refs.text_big5: 你要用皂莢木作一張桌子，長二肘，寬一肘，高一肘半。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a table of acacia wood: two cubits shall be its length, and a cubit its width, and one and a half cubits its height.

refs.text_gb: 要包上纯金，四围镶上金牙边。
refs.text_big5: 要包上純金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
refs.text_en: And you shall overlay it with pure gold and make a rim of gold around it.

refs.text_gb: 桌子的四围，要作一掌宽的框子，框子的四围镶着金牙边。
refs.text_big5: 桌子的四圍，要作一掌寬的框子，框子的四圍鑲著金牙邊。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a frame of a handbreadth around it; and you shall make a rim of gold for its frame around it.

refs.text_gb: 要作四个金环，安在桌子四个脚的四角上。
refs.text_big5: 要作四個金環，安在桌子四個腳的四角上。
refs.text_en: And you shall make for it four rings of gold and put the rings on the four corners that are on its four feet.

refs.text_gb: 环子要靠近框子，可以穿杠抬桌子。
refs.text_big5: 環子要靠近框子，可以穿槓抬桌子。
refs.text_en: The rings shall be close to the frame as holders for the poles to carry the table.

refs.text_gb: 要用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。
refs.text_big5: 要用皂莢木作兩根槓，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。
refs.text_en: And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be carried with them.

refs.text_gb: 要作桌子上的盘子、调羹、并奠酒的壶和杯；这些都要用纯金制作。
refs.text_big5: 要作桌子上的盤子、調羹、並奠酒的壺和杯；這些都要用純金製作。
refs.text_en: And you shall make its plates and its cups and its pitchers and its bowls with which to pour out drink offerings; of pure gold you shall make them.

refs.text_gb: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常摆陈设饼。
refs.text_big5: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常擺陳設餅。
refs.text_en: And you shall set the bread of the Presence upon the table before Me always.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]灯台、灯台的器具、灯盏、和点灯的[Crb]油，
verses.text_big5: [Cra]燈臺、燈臺的器具、燈盞、和點燈的[Crb]油，
verses.text_en: And the lampstand for the light and its utensils and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
verses.text_gb_plain: 灯台、灯台的器具、灯盏、和点灯的油，
verses.text_big5_plain: 燈臺、燈臺的器具、燈盞、和點燈的油，

refs.text_gb: 你要用纯金作一个灯台。灯台的座和干，与杯、花萼、花苞，都要接连一块锤出来。
refs.text_big5: 你要用純金作一個燈臺。燈臺的座和榦，與杯、花萼、花苞，都要接連一塊錘出來。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand with its base and its shaft shall be made of beaten work; its cups, its calyxes, and its blossom buds shall be of one piece with it.

refs.text_gb: 灯台两边要杈出六个枝子，这边三个，那边三个。
refs.text_big5: 燈臺兩邊要杈出六個枝子，這邊三個，那邊三個。
refs.text_en: And there shall be six branches going out of its sides; three branches of the lampstand out of one of its sides, and three branches of the lampstand out of its other side;

refs.text_gb: 这边每枝上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有花萼，有花苞；那边每枝上也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有花萼，有花苞；从灯台杈出来的六个枝子，都是如此。
refs.text_big5: 這邊每枝上有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有花萼，有花苞；那邊每枝上也有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有花萼，有花苞；從燈臺杈出來的六個枝子，都是如此。
refs.text_en: Three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a calyx and a blossom bud; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a calyx and a blossom bud-so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.

refs.text_gb: 灯台的干上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有花萼，有花苞。
refs.text_big5: 燈臺的榦上有四個杯，形狀像杏花，有花萼，有花苞。
refs.text_en: And there shall be on the lampstand four cups made like almond blossoms, its calyxes and its blossom buds;

refs.text_en: Their calyxes and their branches shall be of one piece with it; all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

refs.text_en: And you shall make its lamps, seven; and set up its lamps to give light to the area in front of it.

refs.text_en: And its tongs and its firepans shall be of pure gold.

verses.text_big5: [Cra]香壇和壇的槓，[Crb]膏油和馨香的[Crc]香，並帳幕門口的[Crd]簾子，
verses.text_en: And the altar of incense and its poles; and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense; and the screen for the entrance, at the entrance of the tabernacle;

verses.text_big5_plain: 香壇和壇的槓，膏油和馨香的香，並帳幕門口的簾子，

refs.text_gb: 你要用皂荚木作一座烧香的坛。
refs.text_big5: 你要用皂莢木作一座燒香的壇。
refs.text_en: And you shall make an altar on which to burn incense; you shall make it of acacia wood.

refs.text_big5: 這壇要四方的，長一肘，寬一肘，高二肘；壇的四角要與壇接連一塊。
refs.text_en: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width, a cubit; it shall be square, and two cubits its height; its horns shall be of one piece with it.

refs.text_gb: 要用纯金，把坛的上面与坛的四围，并坛的四角包裹；又要在坛的四围镶上金牙边。

refs.text_en: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, its top and its sides around it and its horns; and you shall make a rim of gold around it.

refs.text_en: And you shall make for it two rings of gold under its rim; on its two sides, on its opposite sides, you shall make them; and they shall be as holders for poles with which to carry it.

refs.text_gb: 要用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹。
refs.text_big5: 要用皂莢木作兩根槓，用金包裹。
refs.text_en: And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

refs.text_gb: 要把坛放在见证柜前的幔子外，对着见证柜上的遮罪盖，就是我要与你相会的地方。
refs.text_big5: 要把壇放在見證櫃前的幔子外，對著見證櫃上的遮罪蓋，就是我要與你相會的地方。
refs.text_en: And you shall put it before the veil that is over the Ark of the Testimony, before the expiation cover that is over the Testimony, where I will meet with you.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦要在坛上烧馨香的香；每早晨他收拾灯的时候，要烧这香。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫要在壇上燒馨香的香；每早晨他收拾燈的時候，要燒這香。
refs.text_en: And Aaron shall burn on it fragrant incense; every morning when he dresses the lamps he shall burn it.

refs.text_big5: 黃昏他點燈的時候，也要燒這香，作為世世代代在耶和華面前常燒的香。
refs.text_en: And when Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Jehovah throughout your generations.

refs.text_gb: 在这坛上不可献上别的香，不可献燔祭、素祭，也不可浇上奠祭。
refs.text_big5: 在這壇上不可獻上別的香，不可獻燔祭、素祭，也不可澆上奠祭。
refs.text_en: You shall not offer any strange incense on it, or a burnt offering or a meal offering; and you shall not pour a drink offering on it.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦一年一次，要在坛的四角上为坛遮罪；他一年一次，要用遮罪之赎罪祭的血，为坛遮罪，作为世世代代的定例。这坛在耶和华面前乃为至圣。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫一年一次，要在壇的四角上為壇遮罪；他一年一次，要用遮罪之贖罪祭的血，為壇遮罪，作為世世代代的定例。這壇在耶和華面前乃為至聖。
refs.text_en: And Aaron shall make expiation on its horns once a year; with the blood of the sin offering of expiation once a year he shall make expiation for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Jehovah.

refs.text_big5: 你要取上好的香料，就是流質的沒藥五百舍客勒，香肉桂一半，就是二百五十舍客勒，香菖蒲二百五十舍客勒，
refs.text_en: You also take the finest spices: of flowing myrrh five hundred shekels, and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, two hundred fifty shekels, and of fragrant calamus two hundred fifty shekels,

refs.text_big5: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按著聖所的舍客勒，又取橄欖油一欣；
refs.text_en: And of cassia five hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, and a hin of olive oil.

refs.text_en: And you shall make it a holy anointing oil, a fragrant ointment compounded according to the work of a compounder; it shall be a holy anointing oil.

refs.text_en: And with it you shall anoint the Tent of Meeting and the Ark of the Testimony,

refs.text_en: And the table and all its utensils, and the lampstand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,

refs.text_big5: 燔祭壇和壇的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座。
refs.text_en: And the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the laver and its base.

refs.text_gb: 你要这样使这些分别为圣，好成为至圣；凡触着这些的都成为圣。
refs.text_big5: 你要這樣使這些分別為聖，好成為至聖；凡觸著這些的都成為聖。
refs.text_en: Thus you shall sanctify them that they may be most holy; whatever touches them shall be holy.

refs.text_gb: 要膏亚伦和他的儿子们，使他们分别为圣，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 要膏亞倫和他的兒子們，使他們分別為聖，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons and sanctify them that they may serve Me as priests.

refs.text_big5: 你要對以色列人說，這油要世世代代歸我為聖膏油。
refs.text_en: And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, This shall be a holy anointing oil to Me throughout your generations.

refs.text_big5: 不可倒在一般人的身上，也不可按這些成分，調製與這相似的；這膏油是聖的，你們也要以為聖。
refs.text_en: Upon the flesh of man it shall not be poured, nor shall you make any like it, according to its composition; it is holy, and it shall be holy to you.

refs.text_en: Whoever compounds any like it or whoever puts any of it upon a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.

refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take fragrant spices-stacte and onycha and galbanum-fragrant spices with pure frankincense; there shall be an equal part of each;

refs.text_en: And you shall make of it incense, a fragrant compound according to the work of a compounder, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

refs.text_en: And you shall beat some of it very fine, and put some of it before the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you; it shall be to you most holy.

refs.text_en: And you shall put it below, under the ledge of the altar so that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

refs.text_en: You shall make it hollow with boards; as it was shown to you in the mountain, so shall they make it.

refs.text_en: And the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the laver and its base.

refs.text_gb: 燔祭坛和坛的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座，

refs.text_en: And the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the laver and its base,

refs.text_gb: 他们进会幕的时候，要用水洗濯，免得死亡；或是他们就近坛前供职，给耶和华献火祭的时候，
refs.text_big5: 他們進會幕的時候，要用水洗濯，免得死亡；或是他們就近壇前供職，給耶和華獻火祭的時候，
refs.text_en: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they may not die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering by fire to Jehovah,

refs.text_gb: 必要洗手洗脚，免得死亡。这要作亚伦和他后裔，世世代代永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 必要洗手洗腳，免得死亡。這要作亞倫和他後裔，世世代代永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: They shall wash their hands and their feet, that they may not die. And it shall be a perpetual statute to them, for him and for his seed throughout their generations.

refs.text_gb: 他用铜作洗濯盆和盆座，是用会幕门前服事之妇人的铜镜作的。
refs.text_big5: 他用銅作洗濯盆和盆座，是用會幕門前服事之婦人的銅鏡作的。
refs.text_en: And he made the laver of bronze and its base of bronze from the mirrors of the serving women who served at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]院子的帷子、帷子的柱子和卯座、并院子的门帘，
verses.text_big5: [Cra]院子的帷子、帷子的柱子和卯座、並院子的門簾，
verses.text_en: The hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
verses.text_gb_plain: 院子的帷子、帷子的柱子和卯座、并院子的门帘，
verses.text_big5_plain: 院子的帷子、帷子的柱子和卯座、並院子的門簾，

refs.text_gb: 你要作帐幕的院子。院子的南面要用捻的细麻作帷子，长一百肘；
refs.text_big5: 你要作帳幕的院子。院子的南面要用撚的細麻作帷子，長一百肘；
refs.text_en: And you shall make the court of the tabernacle; On the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen, a length of one hundred cubits long one side;

refs.text_gb: 帷子的柱子二十根，卯座二十个，都要用铜作；柱子上的钩子和横杆，都要用银作。
refs.text_big5: 帷子的柱子二十根，卯座二十個，都要用銅作；柱子上的鉤子和橫杆，都要用銀作。
refs.text_en: And its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets shall be of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting rods shall be of silver.

refs.text_gb: 北面也当有帷子，长一百肘；帷子的柱子二十根，卯座二十个，都要用铜作；柱子上的钩子和横杆，都要用银作。
refs.text_big5: 北面也當有帷子，長一百肘；帷子的柱子二十根，卯座二十個，都要用銅作；柱子上的鉤子和橫杆，都要用銀作。
refs.text_en: And likewise on the north side, in length there shall be hangings a length of one hundred cubits, and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting rods shall be of silver.

refs.text_gb: 院子的西面当有帷子，宽五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，卯座十个。
refs.text_big5: 院子的西面當有帷子，寬五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，卯座十個。
refs.text_en: And for the width of the court on the west side there shall be hangings of fifty cubits, with their ten pillars and their ten sockets.

refs.text_gb: 院子的东面要宽五十肘。
refs.text_big5: 院子的東面要寬五十肘。
refs.text_en: And the width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

refs.text_gb: 门这边当有帷子，宽十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，卯座三个。
refs.text_big5: 門這邊當有帷子，寬十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，卯座三個。
refs.text_en: And there shall be fifteen cubits of hangings for the one side of the gate, with their three pillars and their three sockets.

refs.text_gb: 门那边也当有帷子，宽十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，卯座三个。
refs.text_big5: 門那邊也當有帷子，寬十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，卯座三個。
refs.text_en: And there shall be fifteen cubits of hangings for the other side, with their three pillars and their three sockets.

refs.text_gb: 院子的门当有帘子，宽二十肘，要拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织成；有柱子四根，卯座四个。
refs.text_big5: 院子的門當有簾子，寬二十肘，要拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織成；有柱子四根，卯座四個。
refs.text_en: And for the gate of the court there shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer; with their four pillars and their four sockets.

refs.text_gb: 院子四围一切的柱子都要用银杆连络，柱子上的钩子要用银作，卯座要用铜作。
refs.text_big5: 院子四圍一切的柱子都要用銀杆連絡，柱子上的鉤子要用銀作，卯座要用銅作。
refs.text_en: All the pillars around the court shall be connected with silver, with their hooks of silver and their sockets of bronze.

refs.text_gb: 院子要长一百肘，每头宽五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用捻的细麻作，卯座要用铜作。
refs.text_big5: 院子要長一百肘，每頭寬五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用撚的細麻作，卯座要用銅作。
refs.text_en: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits; and the width, fifty at each end; and the height, five cubits; of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

refs.text_gb: 帐幕各样事奉用的一切器具，并帐幕一切的橛子，和院子一切的橛子，都要用铜作。
refs.text_big5: 帳幕各樣事奉用的一切器具，並帳幕一切的橛子，和院子一切的橛子，都要用銅作。
refs.text_en: All the utensils of the tabernacle used in all its service and all its pegs and all the pegs of the court shall be of bronze.

verses.text_gb: 帐幕的橛子，并院子的橛子，和这两处的绳子，
verses.text_big5: 帳幕的橛子，並院子的橛子，和這兩處的繩子，
verses.text_en: The pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the court, and their cords;
verses.text_gb_plain: 帐幕的橛子，并院子的橛子，和这两处的绳子，
verses.text_big5_plain: 帳幕的橛子，並院子的橛子，和這兩處的繩子，

verses.text_gb: 在圣所供职用的精工作的衣服，就是祭司亚伦的圣[Cra]衣，和他儿子们用以作祭司事奉的衣服。
verses.text_big5: 在聖所供職用的精工作的衣服，就是祭司亞倫的聖[Cra]衣，和他兒子們用以作祭司事奉的衣服。
verses.text_en: The finely worked garments for ministering in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for them to serve as priests.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在圣所供职用的精工作的衣服，就是祭司亚伦的圣衣，和他儿子们用以作祭司事奉的衣服。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在聖所供職用的精工作的衣服，就是祭司亞倫的聖衣，和他兒子們用以作祭司事奉的衣服。

refs.text_gb: 你要从以色列人中，使你的哥哥亚伦，和他的儿子拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛，一同就近你，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 你要從以色列人中，使你的哥哥亞倫，和他的兒子拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪，一同就近你，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And bring near to yourself Aaron your brother and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may serve Me as a priest-Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.

refs.text_gb: 你要给你哥哥亚伦作圣衣，为荣耀为华美。
refs.text_big5: 你要給你哥哥亞倫作聖衣，為榮耀為華美。
refs.text_en: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

refs.text_gb: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦作衣服，使他分别为圣，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的靈所充滿的，給亞倫作衣服，使他分別為聖，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall speak to all who are wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron's garments to sanctify him, that he may serve Me as a priest.

refs.text_gb: 他们要作这些衣服：胸牌、以弗得、外袍、编织的内袍、顶冠、腰带；要为你哥哥亚伦和他儿子们作这圣衣，使他们可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 他們要作這些衣服：胸牌、以弗得、外袍、編織的內袍、頂冠、腰帶；要為你哥哥亞倫和他兒子們作這聖衣，使他們可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate and an ephod and a robe and a tunic of checkered work, a turban and a girding sash. So they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and for his sons that he may serve Me as a priest.

refs.text_gb: 因此，他们要把金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并细麻拿来。
refs.text_big5: 因此，他們要把金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並細麻拿來。
refs.text_en: They therefore shall take the gold and the blue and the purple and the scarlet strands and the fine linen,

refs.text_gb: 他们要用金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻，以巧匠的手工作以弗得。
refs.text_big5: 他們要用金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻，以巧匠的手工作以弗得。
refs.text_en: And they shall make the ephod of gold thread, of blue and purple and scarlet strands, and fine twined linen, the work of a skillful workman.

refs.text_gb: 以弗得当有两条肩带，接在以弗得两端，使以弗得相连。
refs.text_big5: 以弗得當有兩條肩帶，接在以弗得兩端，使以弗得相連。
refs.text_en: It shall have two shoulder pieces joined to its two edges, so that it may be joined together.

refs.text_gb: 以弗得上巧工织的带子，要和以弗得一样的作法，用以系住，与以弗得接连一块；要用金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻作成。
refs.text_big5: 以弗得上巧工織的帶子，要和以弗得一樣的作法，用以繫住，與以弗得接連一塊；要用金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻作成。
refs.text_en: And the skillfully woven band, which is on it for its fastening, shall be like it in workmanship, of one piece with it; of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine twined linen.

refs.text_gb: 要取两块红玛瑙，刻上以色列儿子们的名字；
refs.text_big5: 要取兩塊紅瑪瑙，刻上以色列兒子們的名字；
refs.text_en: And you shall take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel,

refs.text_gb: 六个名字在这块宝石上，其余六个名字在那块宝石上，都照他们出生的次序。
refs.text_big5: 六個名字在這塊寶石上，其餘六個名字在那塊寶石上，都照他們出生的次序。
refs.text_en: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the remaining six on the other stone, according to their birth.

refs.text_gb: 要用刻宝石的手工，仿佛刻图章，按着以色列儿子们的名字，刻这两块宝石，镶嵌在金框内。
refs.text_big5: 要用刻寶石的手工，彷彿刻圖章，按著以色列兒子們的名字，刻這兩塊寶石，鑲嵌在金框內。
refs.text_en: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the sons of Israel; you shall make them enclosed in settings of gold.

refs.text_gb: 要将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人作记念石。亚伦要在两肩上担他们的名字，在耶和华面前作为记念。
refs.text_big5: 要將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人作記念石。亞倫要在兩肩上擔他們的名字，在耶和華面前作為記念。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel. And Aaron shall bear their names before Jehovah on his two shoulders for a memorial.

refs.text_gb: 你要用金作两个框，
refs.text_big5: 你要用金作兩個框，
refs.text_en: And you shall make settings of gold,

refs.text_gb: 又要用纯金，以拧绳子的手工，作两条链子，把这拧成的链子接在两框上。
refs.text_big5: 又要用純金，以擰繩子的手工，作兩條鍊子，把這擰成的鍊子接在兩框上。
refs.text_en: And two chains of pure gold; you shall make them twisted, a corded work, and you shall put the chains of cords on the settings.

refs.text_gb: 你要用巧匠的手工，作一个决断的胸牌；要和以弗得一样的作法，用金线，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻作成。
refs.text_big5: 你要用巧匠的手工，作一個決斷的胸牌；要和以弗得一樣的作法，用金線，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻作成。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of a skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet strands, and of fine twined linen you shall make it.

refs.text_gb: 这胸牌要四方的，叠为两层，长一虎口，宽一虎口。
refs.text_big5: 這胸牌要四方的，疊為兩層，長一虎口，寬一虎口。
refs.text_en: It shall be square and doubled; a span its length and a span its width.

refs.text_gb: 要在上面镶嵌四行宝石：第一行是红宝石、黄玉、绿宝石，
refs.text_big5: 要在上面鑲嵌四行寶石：第一行是紅寶石、黃玉、綠寶石，
refs.text_en: And you shall enclose in it enclosures of stones, four rows of stones: the first row shall be a row of a sardius, a topaz, and an emerald;

refs.text_gb: 第二行是红玉、蓝宝石、金钢石，
refs.text_big5: 第二行是紅玉、藍寶石、金鋼石，
refs.text_en: And the second row, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a diamond;

refs.text_gb: 第三行是紫玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶，
refs.text_big5: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶，
refs.text_en: And the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

refs.text_gb: 第四行是黄璧玺、红玛瑙、碧玉；这些都要镶嵌在金框内。
refs.text_big5: 第四行是黃璧璽、紅瑪瑙、碧玉；這些都要鑲嵌在金框內。
refs.text_en: And the fourth row, a chrysolite, and an onyx, and a jasper; they shall be set in gold in their enclosures.

refs.text_gb: 这些宝石，按着以色列儿子们的名字，要有十二块；每块刻一个名字，仿佛刻图章，代表十二个支派。
refs.text_big5: 這些寶石，按著以色列兒子們的名字，要有十二塊；每塊刻一個名字，彷彿刻圖章，代表十二個支派。
refs.text_en: And the stones shall be according to the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names; they shall be like the engravings of a signet, each according to its name, for the twelve tribes.

refs.text_gb: 要在胸牌上，用纯金以拧绳子的手工作链子。
refs.text_big5: 要在胸牌上，用純金以擰繩子的手工作鍊子。
refs.text_en: And you shall make on the breastplate twisted chains, a corded work of pure gold.

refs.text_gb: 在胸牌上也要作两个金环，安在胸牌的两端。
refs.text_big5: 在胸牌上也要作兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩端。
refs.text_en: And you shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

refs.text_gb: 要把那两条拧成的金链子，穿在胸牌两端的环子里。
refs.text_big5: 要把那兩條擰成的金鍊子，穿在胸牌兩端的環子裏。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

refs.text_gb: 又要把链子的另外两端，接在两框上，安在以弗得前面的肩带上。
refs.text_big5: 又要把鍊子的另外兩端，接在兩框上，安在以弗得前面的肩帶上。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the two other ends of the two cords on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front of it.

refs.text_gb: 要作两个金环，安在胸牌两端里面的边上，贴近以弗得。
refs.text_big5: 要作兩個金環，安在胸牌兩端裏面的邊上，貼近以弗得。
refs.text_en: And you shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them upon the two ends of the breastplate upon its edge, which is toward the ephod on the inside.

refs.text_gb: 又要作两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，靠近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。
refs.text_big5: 又要作兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，靠近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。
refs.text_en: And you shall make two rings of gold and shall put them on the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod on the front of it, close to the place where it is joined, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

refs.text_gb: 要用蓝细带子，把胸牌的环子与以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不至从以弗得松开。
refs.text_big5: 要用藍細帶子，把胸牌的環子與以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不至從以弗得鬆開。
refs.text_en: And they shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue strands, that it may be upon the skillfully woven band of the ephod and that the breastplate may not come loose from the ephod.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦进圣所的时候，要将决断胸牌上以色列儿子们的名字，带在胸前，在耶和华面前常作记念。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫進聖所的時候，要將決斷胸牌上以色列兒子們的名字，帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常作記念。
refs.text_en: So Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart when he goes into the sanctuary, for a memorial before Jehovah continually.

refs.text_gb: 你又要将乌陵和土明放在决断的胸牌里；亚伦进到耶和华面前的时候，要带在胸前，在耶和华面前常将以色列人的决断牌带在胸前。
refs.text_big5: 你又要將烏陵和土明放在決斷的胸牌裏；亞倫進到耶和華面前的時候，要帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常將以色列人的決斷牌帶在胸前。
refs.text_en: And you shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron's heart when he goes in before Jehovah, and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Jehovah continually.

refs.text_gb: 你要作以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。
refs.text_big5: 你要作以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。
refs.text_en: And you shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue strands.

refs.text_gb: 袍上要为头留一领口，用编织的手工在领口周围织出领边，仿佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。
refs.text_big5: 袍上要為頭留一領口，用編織的手工在領口周圍織出領邊，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。
refs.text_en: And there shall be an opening for the head in its center; around its opening there shall be a binding edge of woven work, like the opening of a coat of mail, so that it will not be torn.

refs.text_gb: 袍子周围底边上，要用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线作石榴。在袍子周围的石榴中间，要有金铃，
refs.text_big5: 袍子周圍底邊上，要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線作石榴。在袍子周圍的石榴中間，要有金鈴，
refs.text_en: And you shall make on its hem pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet strands, all around its hem, and bells of gold between them all around:

refs.text_gb: 一个金铃一个石榴，一个金铃一个石榴，在袍子周围的底边上。
refs.text_big5: 一個金鈴一個石榴，一個金鈴一個石榴，在袍子周圍的底邊上。
refs.text_en: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, on the hem of the robe all around.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦供职的时候，要穿这袍子。他进圣所到耶和华面前，以及出来的时候，袍上的铃声必被听见，使他不至于死亡。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫供職的時候，要穿這袍子。他進聖所到耶和華面前，以及出來的時候，袍上的鈴聲必被聽見，使他不至於死亡。
refs.text_en: And it shall be upon Aaron when he ministers, and its sound shall be heard when he goes into the sanctuary before Jehovah and when he comes out, so that he may not die.

refs.text_gb: 你要用纯金作一面牌，在上面按刻图章之法，刻着归耶和华为圣。
refs.text_big5: 你要用純金作一面牌，在上面按刻圖章之法，刻著歸耶和華為聖。
refs.text_en: And you shall make a plate of pure gold and engrave upon it, like the engravings of a signet: HOLINESS TO JEHOVAH.

refs.text_gb: 要用蓝细带子，将牌系在顶冠前面。
refs.text_big5: 要用藍細帶子，將牌繫在頂冠前面。
refs.text_en: And you shall put it on a cord of blue strands, and it shall be on the turban; it shall be at the front of the turban.

refs.text_gb: 这牌必在亚伦的额上，亚伦要担当干犯圣物的罪孽；这些圣物是以色列人所分别为圣，作他们一切圣礼物的；这牌要常在亚伦的额上，使他们可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
refs.text_big5: 這牌必在亞倫的額上，亞倫要擔當干犯聖物的罪孽；這些聖物是以色列人所分別為聖，作他們一切聖禮物的；這牌要常在亞倫的額上，使他們可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。
refs.text_en: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel sanctify for all their holy gifts; and it shall always be on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 要用细麻线编织内袍，用细麻布作顶冠，又用绣花的手工作腰带。
refs.text_big5: 要用細麻線編織內袍，用細麻布作頂冠，又用繡花的手工作腰帶。
refs.text_en: And you shall weave the tunic of fine linen, and you shall make a turban of fine linen, and you shall make a girding sash, the work of an embroiderer.

refs.text_gb: 你要为亚伦的儿子们作内袍、腰带、头巾，为荣耀为华美。
refs.text_big5: 你要為亞倫的兒子們作內袍、腰帶、頭巾，為榮耀為華美。
refs.text_en: And for Aaron's sons you shall make tunics, and you shall make for them girding sashes, and you shall make for them high hats, for glory and for beauty.

refs.text_gb: 要把这些给你的哥哥亚伦和他儿子们穿戴；又要膏他们，使他们承接圣职，将他们分别为圣，他们好作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 要把這些給你的哥哥亞倫和他兒子們穿戴；又要膏他們，使他們承接聖職，將他們分別為聖，他們好作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall put them upon Aaron your brother and upon his sons with him, and you shall anoint them and consecrate them and sanctify them, that they may serve Me as priests.

refs.text_gb: 要给他们作细麻布裤子，遮掩下体；裤子当从腰达到大腿。
refs.text_big5: 要給他們作細麻布褲子，遮掩下體；褲子當從腰達到大腿。
refs.text_en: And you shall make them linen trousers to cover their naked flesh; they shall reach from the loins even to the thighs;

refs.text_gb: 亚伦和他儿子们进入会幕，或就近坛，在圣所供职的时候必穿上，免得担当罪孽而死。这要为亚伦和他的后裔作永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫和他兒子們進入會幕，或就近壇，在聖所供職的時候必穿上，免得擔當罪孽而死。這要為亞倫和他的後裔作永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: And they shall be upon Aaron and upon his sons when they go into the Tent of Meeting or when they come near to the altar to minister in the sanctuary, that they may not bear iniquity and die. It shall be a perpetual statute for him and for his seed after him.

refs.text_gb: 精工作的衣服，就是祭司亚伦的圣衣，和他儿子们用以作祭司事奉的衣服，
refs.text_big5: 精工作的衣服，就是祭司亞倫的聖衣，和他兒子們用以作祭司事奉的衣服，
refs.text_en: And the finely worked garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for them to serve as priests,

verses.text_gb: 以色列人全会众从摩西面前退去。
verses.text_big5: 以色列人全會眾從摩西面前退去。
verses.text_en: And all the assembly of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以色列人全会众从摩西面前退去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以色列人全會眾從摩西面前退去。

verses.text_gb: 凡[Fn1]心中受感并灵里[Cra]乐意的，都将耶和华的[Crb]举祭带来，用以造会幕，并供其中一切事奉之用，又用以作圣衣。
verses.text_big5: 凡[Fn1]心中受感並靈裏[Cra]樂意的，都將耶和華的[Crb]舉祭帶來，用以造會幕，並供其中一切事奉之用，又用以作聖衣。
verses.text_en: And they came, everyone whose heart lifted him up and everyone whose spirit made him willing, and brought the heave offering of Jehovah for the work of the Tent of Meeting and for all its service and for the holy garments.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡心中受感并灵里乐意的，都将耶和华的举祭带来，用以造会幕，并供其中一切事奉之用，又用以作圣衣。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡心中受感並靈裏樂意的，都將耶和華的舉祭帶來，用以造會幕，並供其中一切事奉之用，又用以作聖衣。

footnotes.zh: 心中受感，或，心中高昂。26，三六2者同。为着建造神的居所，我们需要一颗受感且高昂的心，以及一个乐意的灵(拉一5～6，林前十五58)。
footnotes.en: 35:21 1 lifted For the building of God's dwelling place, we need an uplifted and uplifting heart and a willing spirit (Ezra 1:5-6; 1 Cor. 15:58).

refs.text_gb: 你吩咐以色列人，当为我拿举祭来；凡甘心乐意的，你们就可以从他收下归我。
refs.text_big5: 你吩咐以色列人，當為我拿舉祭來；凡甘心樂意的，你們就可以從他收下歸我。
refs.text_en: Tell the children of Israel to take for Me a heave offering. From every man whose heart makes him willing you shall take My heave offering.

refs.text_gb: 这些人就从摩西收了以色列人为供圣所事奉使用之工，所带来的各样举祭，好作这工。每早晨百姓仍不断地把甘心祭带给摩西。
refs.text_big5: 這些人就從摩西收了以色列人為供聖所事奉使用之工，所帶來的各樣舉祭，好作這工。每早晨百姓仍不斷的把甘心祭帶給摩西。
refs.text_en: And they received from Moses every heave offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to carry it out. And they still kept bringing to him freewill offerings every morning.

verses.text_gb: 凡[Cra]心中乐意的，连男带女，都将各样金器，就是鼻[Crb]环、耳环、打印的戒指、和手镯带来，各人把金子向耶和华摇一摇，作为摇祭。
verses.text_big5: 凡[Cra]心中樂意的，連男帶女，都將各樣金器，就是鼻[Crb]環、耳環、打印的戒指、和手鐲帶來，各人把金子向耶和華搖一搖，作為搖祭。
verses.text_en: And they came, men together with women, as many as were of a willing heart, and brought nose rings and earrings and signet rings and pendants, all kinds of articles of gold; even every man who waved a wave offering of gold to Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡心中乐意的，连男带女，都将各样金器，就是鼻环、耳环、打印的戒指、和手镯带来，各人把金子向耶和华摇一摇，作为摇祭。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡心中樂意的，連男帶女，都將各樣金器，就是鼻環、耳環、打印的戒指、和手鐲帶來，各人把金子向耶和華搖一搖，作為搖祭。

refs.text_gb: 你吩咐以色列人，当为我拿举祭来；凡甘心乐意的，你们就可以从他收下归我。
refs.text_big5: 你吩咐以色列人，當為我拿舉祭來；凡甘心樂意的，你們就可以從他收下歸我。
refs.text_en: Tell the children of Israel to take for Me a heave offering. From every man whose heart makes him willing you shall take My heave offering.

refs.text_gb: 如今我们将各人所得的金器，就是臂环、手镯、打印的戒指、耳环、项链，都送来为耶和华的供物，好在耶和华面前为我们的性命遮罪。
refs.text_big5: 如今我們將各人所得的金器，就是臂環、手鐲、打印的戒指、耳環、項鍊，都送來為耶和華的供物，好在耶和華面前為我們的性命遮罪。
refs.text_en: And we have presented Jehovah's offering, what every man has obtained, articles of gold, armlets and bracelets, signet rings, earrings and pendants, to make expiation for our souls before Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 凡有[Cra]蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，染红的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都带了来；
verses.text_big5: 凡有[Cra]藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，細麻，山羊毛，染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都帶了來；
verses.text_en: And every man with whom was found blue and purple and scarlet strands and fine linen and goats' hair and rams' skins dyed red and porpoise skins brought them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡有蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，染红的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都带了来；
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡有藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，細麻，山羊毛，染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都帶了來；

refs.text_gb: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，
refs.text_big5: 藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，細麻，山羊毛，
refs.text_en: And blue and purple and scarlet strands, and fine linen, and goats' hair,

refs.text_gb: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，
refs.text_big5: 染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂莢木，
refs.text_en: And rams' skins dyed red, and porpoise skins, and acacia wood,

refs.text_gb: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，
refs.text_big5: 藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，細麻，山羊毛，
refs.text_en: And blue and purple and scarlet strands, and fine linen, and goats' hair,

refs.text_gb: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，
refs.text_big5: 染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂莢木，
refs.text_en: And rams' skins dyed red, and porpoise skins, and acacia wood,

verses.text_gb: 凡献银和铜给耶和华为举祭的，都带了来；凡有皂荚木可作什么事奉用的，也带了来。
verses.text_big5: 凡獻銀和銅給耶和華為舉祭的，都帶了來；凡有皂莢木可作甚麼事奉用的，也帶了來。
verses.text_en: Everyone who offered a heave offering of silver and bronze brought the heave offering of Jehovah, and every man with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service brought it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡献银和铜给耶和华为举祭的，都带了来；凡有皂荚木可作什么事奉用的，也带了来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡獻銀和銅給耶和華為舉祭的，都帶了來；凡有皂莢木可作甚麼事奉用的，也帶了來。

verses.text_gb: 凡[Cra]心中有智慧的妇女亲手纺线，把所纺的蓝色、紫色、朱红色线和细麻，都带了来。
verses.text_big5: 凡[Cra]心中有智慧的婦女親手紡線，把所紡的藍色、紫色、朱紅色線和細麻，都帶了來。
verses.text_en: And all the women who were wise in heart spun with their hands and brought what they had spun, the blue and the purple and the scarlet strands and the fine linen.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡心中有智慧的妇女亲手纺线，把所纺的蓝色、紫色、朱红色线和细麻，都带了来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡心中有智慧的婦女親手紡線，把所紡的藍色、紫色、朱紅色線和細麻，都帶了來。

refs.text_gb: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦作衣服，使他分别为圣，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的靈所充滿的，給亞倫作衣服，使他分別為聖，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall speak to all who are wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron's garments to sanctify him, that he may serve Me as a priest.

verses.text_gb: 凡有智慧、心中受感的妇女，都纺山羊毛。
verses.text_big5: 凡有智慧、心中受感的婦女，都紡山羊毛。
verses.text_en: And all the women whose heart lifted them up in wisdom spun the goats' hair.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡有智慧、心中受感的妇女，都纺山羊毛。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡有智慧、心中受感的婦女，都紡山羊毛。

verses.text_gb: 众首领把红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的，都带了来；
verses.text_big5: 眾首領把紅瑪瑙與別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的，都帶了來；
verses.text_en: And the leaders brought the onyx stones and the stones for setting for the ephod and for the breastplate,
verses.text_gb_plain: 众首领把红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的，都带了来；
verses.text_big5_plain: 眾首領把紅瑪瑙與別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的，都帶了來；

verses.text_gb: 又把香料和油带来，用以点灯，并作膏油和馨香的香。
verses.text_big5: 又把香料和油帶來，用以點燈，並作膏油和馨香的香。
verses.text_en: And the spices and the oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又把香料和油带来，用以点灯，并作膏油和馨香的香。
verses.text_big5_plain: 又把香料和油帶來，用以點燈，並作膏油和馨香的香。

verses.text_gb: 以色列人无论男女，凡甘[Cra]心乐意带礼物来，用以作耶和华借摩西所吩咐一切工的，都把[Fn1]甘心祭带来给耶和华。
verses.text_big5: 以色列人無論男女，凡甘[Cra]心樂意帶禮物來，用以作耶和華藉摩西所吩咐一切工的，都把[Fn1]甘心祭帶來給耶和華。
verses.text_en: The children of Israel brought a freewill offering to Jehovah, every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Jehovah had commanded through Moses to be done.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以色列人无论男女，凡甘心乐意带礼物来，用以作耶和华借摩西所吩咐一切工的，都把甘心祭带来给耶和华。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以色列人無論男女，凡甘心樂意帶禮物來，用以作耶和華藉摩西所吩咐一切工的，都把甘心祭帶來給耶和華。

footnotes.zh: 我们是否经历基督，并将祂献给神，乃在于我们的自由意志。
footnotes.zh_big5: 我們是否經歷基督，並將祂獻給神，乃在於我們的自由意志。
footnotes.en: 35:29 1 freewill Whether or not we experience Christ and offer Him to God is a matter of our free will.

refs.text_gb: 你吩咐以色列人，当为我拿举祭来；凡甘心乐意的，你们就可以从他收下归我。
refs.text_big5: 你吩咐以色列人，當為我拿舉祭來；凡甘心樂意的，你們就可以從他收下歸我。
refs.text_en: Tell the children of Israel to take for Me a heave offering. From every man whose heart makes him willing you shall take My heave offering.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]摩西对以色列人说，看哪，犹大支派中，户珥的孙子，乌利的儿子[Crb]比撒列，耶和华已经提名召他，
verses.text_big5: [Cra]摩西對以色列人說，看哪，猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子，烏利的兒子[Crb]比撒列，耶和華已經題名召他，
verses.text_en: And Moses said to the children of Israel, See, Jehovah has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西对以色列人说，看哪，犹大支派中，户珥的孙子，乌利的儿子比撒列，耶和华已经提名召他，
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西對以色列人說，看哪，猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子，烏利的兒子比撒列，耶和華已經題名召他，

refs.text_gb: 耶和华告诉摩西说，
refs.text_big5: 耶和華告訴摩西說，
refs.text_en: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

refs.text_gb: 看哪，犹大支派中，户珥的孙子，乌利的儿子比撒列，我已经提名召他。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子，烏利的兒子比撒列，我已經題名召他。
refs.text_en: See, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

refs.text_gb: 我也已经以神的灵充满他，使他有智慧，有悟性，有知识，能作各样的工，
refs.text_big5: 我也已經以神的靈充滿他，使他有智慧，有悟性，有知識，能作各樣的工，
refs.text_en: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom and with understanding and with knowledge and with all kinds of workmanship,

refs.text_gb: 能设计奇巧的工，用金、银、铜制造各物；
refs.text_big5: 能設計奇巧的工，用金、銀、銅製造各物；
refs.text_en: To fashion skillful designs, to work in gold and in silver and in bronze,

refs.text_gb: 又能刻宝石，可以镶嵌，能雕木头，能作各样的工。
refs.text_big5: 又能刻寶石，可以鑲嵌，能雕木頭，能作各樣的工。
refs.text_en: And in the cutting of stones for setting and in the carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华使他们的心[Cra]满有智慧，能作各样的工，无论是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线和细麻绣花的工，并编织的工，他们都能作，也能设计巧工。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華使他們的心[Cra]滿有智慧，能作各樣的工，無論是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線和細麻繡花的工，並編織的工，他們都能作，也能設計巧工。
verses.text_en: He has filled them with wisdom of heart, to work all kinds of workmanship, of an engraver and of a skillful workman and of an embroiderer in blue and in purple and in scarlet strands and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do all kinds of workmanship and of those who fashion skillful designs.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华使他们的心满有智慧，能作各样的工，无论是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线和细麻绣花的工，并编织的工，他们都能作，也能设计巧工。

refs.text_gb: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦作衣服，使他分别为圣，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的靈所充滿的，給亞倫作衣服，使他分別為聖，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall speak to all who are wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron's garments to sanctify him, that he may serve Me as a priest.

refs.text_gb: 他是一个寡妇的儿子，属拿弗他利支派，他父亲是推罗人，作铜匠的。户兰满有智慧、悟性、技能，善于作各样铜工。他来到所罗门王那里，作王一切的工作。
refs.text_big5: 他是一個寡婦的兒子，屬拿弗他利支派，他父親是推羅人，作銅匠的。戶蘭滿有智慧、悟性、技能，善於作各樣銅工。他來到所羅門王那裏，作王一切的工作。
refs.text_en: He was the son of a widow and of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a bronze worker; and he was full of wisdom and understanding and skill to do all kinds of work in bronze. And he came to King Solomon and did all his work.

refs.text_gb: 现在我打发一个精巧、满有悟性的人去，就是户兰亚比，
refs.text_big5: 現在我打發一個精巧、滿有悟性的人去，就是戶蘭亞比，
refs.text_en: And now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,

refs.text_gb: 他是但支派一个妇人的儿子，父亲是推罗人；他善用金、银、铜、铁、石、木，和紫色、蓝色线、细麻与朱红色线制造各物，并精于各种雕刻，又能设计各样交托给他的巧工；他可以与你的巧匠和你父亲我主大卫的巧匠一同作工。
refs.text_big5: 他是但支派一個婦人的兒子，父親是推羅人；他善用金、銀、銅、鐵、石、木，和紫色、藍色線、細麻與朱紅色線製造各物，並精於各種雕刻，又能設計各樣交託給他的巧工；他可以與你的巧匠和你父親我主大衛的巧匠一同作工。
refs.text_en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, whose father is a man of Tyre, who knows how to work in gold and in silver and in bronze and in iron, in stones and in wood, in purple, in blue cloth, and in fine linen and in crimson cloth and who knows how to make all kinds of engraving, and to fashion any design which is given to him, to work with your skillful men and the skillful men of my lord David your father.

verses.text_en: And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab and every man who was wise in heart, in whose heart Jehovah had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart lifted him up to come to the work to do it.

refs.text_en: And Bezalel and Oholiab and every man who is wise in heart, in whom Jehovah has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, shall work according to all that Jehovah has commanded.

verses.text_gb: 这些人就从摩西收了以色列人为供圣所事奉使用之工，所带来的各样[Cra]举祭，好作这工。每早晨百姓仍不断地把甘心祭带给摩西。
verses.text_big5: 這些人就從摩西收了以色列人為供聖所事奉使用之工，所帶來的各樣[Cra]舉祭，好作這工。每早晨百姓仍不斷的把甘心祭帶給摩西。
verses.text_en: And they received from Moses every heave offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to carry it out. And they still kept bringing to him freewill offerings every morning.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这些人就从摩西收了以色列人为供圣所事奉使用之工，所带来的各样举祭，好作这工。每早晨百姓仍不断地把甘心祭带给摩西。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這些人就從摩西收了以色列人為供聖所事奉使用之工，所帶來的各樣舉祭，好作這工。每早晨百姓仍不斷的把甘心祭帶給摩西。

refs.text_gb: 凡心中受感并灵里乐意的，都将耶和华的举祭带来，用以造会幕，并供其中一切事奉之用，又用以作圣衣。
refs.text_big5: 凡心中受感並靈裏樂意的，都將耶和華的舉祭帶來，用以造會幕，並供其中一切事奉之用，又用以作聖衣。
refs.text_en: And they came, everyone whose heart lifted him up and everyone whose spirit made him willing, and brought the heave offering of Jehovah for the work of the Tent of Meeting and for all its service and for the holy garments.

refs.text_gb: 凡献银和铜给耶和华为举祭的，都带了来；凡有皂荚木可作什么事奉用的，也带了来。
refs.text_big5: 凡獻銀和銅給耶和華為舉祭的，都帶了來；凡有皂莢木可作甚麼事奉用的，也帶了來。
refs.text_en: Everyone who offered a heave offering of silver and bronze brought the heave offering of Jehovah, and every man with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service brought it.

verses.text_gb: 凡作圣所一切工的智慧人，各都离开自己所作的工，
verses.text_big5: 凡作聖所一切工的智慧人，各都離開自己所作的工，
verses.text_en: And all the wise men who did all the work of the sanctuary came, every man from his work which he was doing,
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡作圣所一切工的智慧人，各都离开自己所作的工，
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡作聖所一切工的智慧人，各都離開自己所作的工，

verses.text_gb: 来告诉摩西说，百姓为耶和华所吩咐，为事奉之工所拿来的，绰绰有余。
verses.text_big5: 來告訴摩西說，百姓為耶和華所吩咐，為事奉之工所拿來的，綽綽有餘。
verses.text_en: And spoke to Moses, saying, The people are bringing much more than enough for the service of the work which Jehovah commanded us to do.
verses.text_gb_plain: 来告诉摩西说，百姓为耶和华所吩咐，为事奉之工所拿来的，绰绰有余。
verses.text_big5_plain: 來告訴摩西說，百姓為耶和華所吩咐，為事奉之工所拿來的，綽綽有餘。

verses.text_gb: 摩西发命令，他们就在全营中宣告说，无论男女，不必再为圣所拿什么举祭来；这样才拦住百姓不再拿来了。
verses.text_big5: 摩西發命令，他們就在全營中宣告說，無論男女，不必再為聖所拿甚麼舉祭來；這樣纔攔住百姓不再拿來了。
verses.text_en: And Moses gave commandment; and a proclamation was passed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman produce any more material for the heave offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西发命令，他们就在全营中宣告说，无论男女，不必再为圣所拿什么举祭来；这样才拦住百姓不再拿来了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西發命令，他們就在全營中宣告說，無論男女，不必再為聖所拿甚麼舉祭來；這樣纔攔住百姓不再拿來了。

verses.text_gb: 因为他们所有的材料，够作一切当作的工，而且有余。
verses.text_big5: 因為他們所有的材料，彀作一切當作的工，而且有餘。
verses.text_en: For the material they had was sufficient and more than enough for all the work, to do it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为他们所有的材料，够作一切当作的工，而且有余。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為他們所有的材料，彀作一切當作的工，而且有餘。

verses.text_gb: [Cra]他们中间，凡[Crb]心里有智慧作工的，用十幅[Fn1]幕幔作[Fn2]帐幕；这些幕幔是[Fn3][Crc]比撒列用捻的细麻，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线制造的，并用巧匠的手工，绣上基路伯。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]他們中間，凡[Crb]心裏有智慧作工的，用十幅[Fn1]幕幔作[Fn2]帳幕；這些幕幔是[Fn3][Crc]比撒列用撚的細麻，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線製造的，並用巧匠的手工，繡上基路伯。
verses.text_en: And all the wise in heart among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains, of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet strands, with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman. Bezalel made them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们中间，凡心里有智慧作工的，用十幅幕幔作帐幕；这些幕幔是比撒列用捻的细麻，和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线制造的，并用巧匠的手工，绣上基路伯。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們中間，凡心裏有智慧作工的，用十幅幕幔作帳幕；這些幕幔是比撒列用撚的細麻，和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線製造的，並用巧匠的手工，繡上基路伯。
